 23: #[tonic::async_trait]
 24: impl VmService for GrpcVmService {
 25:     async fn create_vm(
 26:         &self,
 27:         request: Request<CreateVmRequest>,
 28:     ) -> Result<Response<CreateVmResponse>, Status> {
 29:         let req = request.into_inner();
 30:         info!("gRPC: Request to create VM: {} (image: {})", req.name, req.image);
 31:         // Convert protobuf types to internal types with validation
 32:         let ports: Vec<PortMapping> = req.ports.into_iter().map(|p| {
 33:             let host_port = u16::try_from(p.host)
 34:                 .map_err(|_| Status::invalid_argument(format!("host port {} out of range", p.host)))?;
 35:             let vm_port = u16::try_from(p.vm)
 36:                 .map_err(|_| Status::invalid_argument(format!("vm port {} out of range", p.vm)))?;
 37:             Ok(PortMapping { host_port, vm_port })
 38:         }).collect::<Result<Vec<_>, Status>>()?;
 39:         let volumes: Vec<VolumeMount> = req.volumes.into_iter().map(|v| VolumeMount {
 40:             host_path: v.host_path,
 41:             vm_path: v.vm_path,
 42:             read_only: false, // default to read-write for CRI
 43:         }).collect();
 44:         // Build labels - include name as a label
 45:         let mut labels = std::collections::HashMap::new();
 46:         if !req.name.is_empty() {
 47:             labels.insert("name".to_string(), req.name.clone());
 48:             labels.insert("vyoma.service".to_string(), req.name.clone());
 49:         }
 50:         let vm_request = VmRunRequest {
 51:             image: req.image.clone(),
 52:             vcpu: req.vcpus as u32,
 53:             mem_size_mib: req.memory_mb as u32,
 54:             ports,
 55:             volumes,
 56:             hostname: if req.name.is_empty() { None } else { Some(req.name.clone()) },
 57:             networks: req.networks.clone(),
 58:             labels,
 59:             base_image_path: String::new(), // will be resolved during creation
 60:         };
 61:         let state = Arc::clone(&self.state);
 62:         match vm_service::run_vm(state, vm_request).await {
 63:             Ok(result) => {
 64:                 info!("gRPC: VM created successfully: {}", result.vm_id);
 65:                 Ok(Response::new(CreateVmResponse {
 66:                     vm_id: result.vm_id,
 67:                 }))
 68:             }
 69:             Err(e) => {
 70:                 error!("gRPC: Failed to create VM: {}", e);
 71:                 Err(Status::internal(format!("Failed to create VM: {}", e)))
 72:             }
 73:         }
 74:     }

 86:         };

 96:     async fn stop_vm(
 97:         &self,
 98:         request: Request<VmIdRequest>,
 99:     ) -> Result<Response<VmStatusResponse>, Status> {
100:         let req = request.into_inner();
101:         let id = req.vm_id;
102:         info!("gRPC: Request to stop VM: {}", id);
103:         let vm_arc = {
104:             let mut vms = self.state.vms.lock().await;
105:             vms.remove(&id)
106:         };
107:         if let Some(vm_mutex) = vm_arc {
108:             let mut vm = vm_mutex.lock().await;
109:             vm.cleanup(&self.state.cni_manager).await;
110:             if let Err(e) = self.state.wal.append(&crate::state::wal::WalEntry::vm_stop(id.clone())) {
111:                 error!("Failed to write WAL entry: {}", e);
112:             }
113:             let _ = self.state.events_tx.send(serde_json::json!({
114:                 "type": "vm_stop",
115:                 "id": id
116:             }).to_string());
117:             Ok(Response::new(VmStatusResponse {
118:                 vm_id: id,
119:                 status: "stopped".to_string()
120:             }))
121:         } else {
122:             Err(Status::not_found("VM not found"))
123:         }
124:     }

209:         let vm_id = req.vm_id;
210:         let vm_arc = {
211:             let vms = self.state.vms.lock().await;
212:             vms.get(&vm_id).cloned()
213:         };
214:         let vm_arc = vm_arc.ok_or_else(|| Status::not_found("VM not found"))?;
215:         let rx = {
216:             let vm = vm_arc.lock().await;
217:             vm.vmm.subscribe_logs()
218:         };
219:         let stream = BroadcastStream::new(rx).filter_map(|result| {
220:             match result {
221:                 Ok(msg) => Some(Ok(LogLine {
222:                     line: msg,
223:                     timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
224:                 })),
225:                 Err(_) => None,
226:             }
227:         });
228:         Ok(Response::new(Box::pin(stream) as Self::StreamLogsStream))
229:     }
230:     async fn create_snapshot(
231:         &self,
232:         request: Request<SnapshotRequest>,
233:     ) -> Result<Response<SnapshotInfo>, Status> {
234:         Err(Status::unimplemented("Not implemented"))
235:     }
236:     async fn restore_snapshot(
237:         &self,
238:         request: Request<RestoreRequest>,
239:     ) -> Result<Response<ProtoVmInfo>, Status> {
240:         Err(Status::unimplemented("Not implemented"))
241:     }
242:     type MigrateVmStream = tonic::codegen::BoxStream<MigrationProgress>;
243:     async fn migrate_vm(
244:         &self,
245:         request: Request<MigrateRequest>,
246:     ) -> Result<Response<Self::MigrateVmStream>, Status> {
247:         Err(Status::unimplemented("Not implemented"))
248:     }
249: }

================
File: crates/vyomad/src/privdrop.rs
================
  1: use anyhow::{Context, Result};
  2: use caps::{Capability, CapSet, CapsHashSet};
  3: use libc::{getpwnam, passwd, setgid, setuid, gid_t, uid_t};
  4: use std::collections::HashSet;
  5: use tracing::{info, error, warn};
  6: const TARGET_USER: &str = "vyoma";
  7: #[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
  8: pub enum PrivDropError {
  9:     #[error("User '{0}' not found. Please ensure the vyoma user exists.")]
 10:     UserNotFound(String),
 11:     #[error("Failed to get user info: {0}")]
 12:     UserInfoError(String),
 13:     #[error("Failed to set capabilities: {0}")]
 14:     CapabilityError(String),
 15:     #[error("Failed to set groups: {0}")]
 16:     SetgroupsError(String),
 17:     #[error("Failed to setgid: {0}")]
 18:     SetgidError(String),
 19:     #[error("Failed to setuid: {0}")]
 20:     SetuidError(String),
 21:     #[error("Privilege drop verification failed: still running as root")]
 22:     VerificationFailed,
 23: }
 24: fn get_pwentry(username: &str) -> Result<*const passwd> {
 25:     let c_str = std::ffi::CString::new(username)
 26:         .context("Failed to create C string for username")?;
 27:     let pw = unsafe { getpwnam(c_str.as_ptr()) };
 28:     if pw.is_null() {
 29:         return Err(PrivDropError::UserNotFound(username.to_string()).into());
 30:     }
 31:     Ok(pw)
 32: }
 33: pub fn drop_privileges() -> Result<()> {
 34:     let pw = get_pwentry(TARGET_USER)
 35:         .context("Failed to resolve vyoma user")?;
 36:     let vyoma_uid: uid_t = unsafe { (*pw).pw_uid };
 37:     let vyoma_gid: gid_t = unsafe { (*pw).pw_gid };
 38:     info!("Resolved vyoma user: uid={}, gid={}", vyoma_uid, vyoma_gid);
 39:     let allowed_caps: CapsHashSet = [
 40:         Capability::CAP_SYS_ADMIN,
 41:         Capability::CAP_NET_ADMIN,
 42:         Capability::CAP_NET_RAW,
 43:         Capability::CAP_SETUID,
 44:         Capability::CAP_SETGID,
 45:         Capability::CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE,
 46:     ].iter().cloned().collect();
 47:     info!("Setting PR_SET_KEEPCAPS to preserve capabilities across setuid...");
 48:     unsafe {
 49:         if libc::prctl(libc::PR_SET_KEEPCAPS, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0 {
 50:             warn!("Failed to set PR_SET_KEEPCAPS: {}", std::io::Error::last_os_error());
 51:         }
 52:     }
 53:     // Note: Preserving supplementary groups (kvm, disk) for access to /dev/kvm and /dev/mapper/control
 54:     info!("Initializing supplementary groups for vyoma...");
 55:     unsafe {
 56:         let username_c = std::ffi::CString::new(TARGET_USER).unwrap();
 57:         if libc::initgroups(username_c.as_ptr(), vyoma_gid) != 0 {
 58:             warn!("Failed to initialize supplementary groups: {}", std::io::Error::last_os_error());
 59:         }
 60:     }
 61:     info!("Setting group to vyoma ({})...", vyoma_gid);
 62:     unsafe {
 63:         if setgid(vyoma_gid) != 0 {
 64:             return Err(PrivDropError::SetgidError(
 65:                 std::io::Error::last_os_error().to_string()
 66:             ).into());
 67:         }
 68:     }
 69:     info!("Setting user to vyoma ({})...", vyoma_uid);
 70:     unsafe {
 71:         if setuid(vyoma_uid) != 0 {
 72:             return Err(PrivDropError::SetuidError(
 73:                 std::io::Error::last_os_error().to_string()
 74:             ).into());
 75:         }
 76:     }
 77:     info!("Applying capabilities after setuid...");
 78:     info!("Setting inheritable capabilities...");
 79:     if let Err(e) = caps::set(None, CapSet::Inheritable, &allowed_caps) {
 80:         warn!("Inheritable set not supported (containerized?): {:?}", e);
 81:     }
 82:     info!("Setting effective capabilities...");
 83:     if let Err(e) = caps::set(None, CapSet::Effective, &allowed_caps) {
 84:         warn!("Effective set not supported (containerized?): {:?}", e);
 85:     }
 86:     info!("Setting ambient capabilities...");
 87:     if let Err(e) = caps::set(None, CapSet::Ambient, &allowed_caps) {
 88:         warn!("Ambient set not supported (containerized?): {:?}", e);
 89:     }
 90:     let current_uid = unsafe { libc::geteuid() };
 91:     if current_uid == 0 {
 92:         error!("Privilege drop verification failed: still running as root (uid=0)");
 93:         return Err(PrivDropError::VerificationFailed.into());
 94:     }
 95:     info!(
 96:         "Privilege drop successful: now running as uid={}, euid={}",
 97:         current_uid,
 98:         unsafe { libc::geteuid() }
 99:     );
100:     Ok(())
101: }

  1: #!/bin/bash
  2: # Vyoma Complete Cleanup Script
  3: # This script removes every trace of Vyoma from the system
  4: # Must be run as root (or with sudo)
  5: set -e
  6: RED='\033[0;31m'
  7: GREEN='\033[0;32m'
  8: YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
  9: NC='\033[0m'
 10: if [ "$EUID" -ne 0 ]; then
 11:     echo -e "${RED}Error: This script must be run as root. Use sudo or run as root.${NC}"
 12:     exit 1
 13: fi
 14: echo "=========================================="
 15: echo "Vyoma Complete Cleanup"
 16: echo "=========================================="
 17: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 1: Stopping all Vyoma services...${NC}"
 18: systemctl stop vyomad 2>/dev/null || true
 19: systemctl disable vyomad 2>/dev/null || true
 20: pkill -9 -f "vyomad" 2>/dev/null || true
 21: echo -e "${GREEN}Services stopped${NC}"
 22: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 2: Removing Vyoma package...${NC}"
 23: dpkg -P vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
 24: dpkg -P vyomad 2>/dev/null || true
 25: rpm -e vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
 26: rpm -e vyomad 2>/dev/null || true
 27: apt-get autoremove -y 2>/dev/null || true
 28: echo -e "${GREEN}Package removed${NC}"
 29: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 3: Deleting Vyoma user and group...${NC}"
 30: userdel -r vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
 31: groupdel vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
 32: echo -e "${GREEN}User and group removed${NC}"
 33: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 4: Cleaning up directories...${NC}"
 34: rm -rf /var/lib/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
 35: rm -rf /run/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
 36: rm -f /tmp/vyoma.sock 2>/dev/null || true
 37: rm -rf /run/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
 38: rm -rf /home/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
 39: rm -rf /root/.vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
 40: rm -rf /var/run/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
 41: echo -e "${GREEN}Directories cleaned${NC}"
 42: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 5: Removing Vyoma network interfaces...${NC}"
 43: ip link del vyoma0 2>/dev/null || true
 44: ip link del vyoma-br0 2>/dev/null || true
 45: ip link del vmbr0 2>/dev/null || true
 46: for iface in $(ip -o link show 2>/dev/null | awk -F': ' '{print $2}' | grep -E '^tap' 2>/dev/null || true); do
 47:     echo "Removing TAP interface: $iface"
 48:     ip link del "$iface" 2>/dev/null || true
 49: done
 50: for iface in $(ip -o link show 2>/dev/null | awk -F': ' '{print $2}' | grep -E 'vyoma' 2>/dev/null || true); do
 51:     echo "Removing Vyoma interface: $iface"
 52:     ip link del "$iface" 2>/dev/null || true
 53: done
 54: echo -e "${GREEN}Network interfaces removed${NC}"
 55: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 6: Removing device mapper devices...${NC}"
 56: if [ -d "/dev/mapper" ]; then
 57:     for dev in $(ls /dev/mapper/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^vyoma-|^vm-' || true); do
 58:         echo "Removing DM device: $dev"
 59:         dmsetup remove "$dev" 2>/dev/null || true
 60:     done
 61: fi
 62: echo -e "${GREEN}Device mapper devices removed${NC}"
 63: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 7: Detaching loop devices...${NC}"
 64: for loop in $(losetup -a 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'vyoma|vm-' | awk -F: '{print $1}' || true); do
 65:     echo "Detaching loop device: $loop"
 66:     losetup -d "$loop" 2>/dev/null || true
 67: done
 68: echo -e "${GREEN}Loop devices detached${NC}"
 69: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 8: Removing network namespaces...${NC}"
 70: for ns in $(ip netns list 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -E 'vyoma-|vm-' || true); do
 71:     echo "Removing network namespace: $ns"
 72:     ip netns del "$ns" 2>/dev/null || true
 73: done
 74: echo -e "${GREEN}Network namespaces removed${NC}"
 75: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 9: Removing cgroups...${NC}"
 76: for controller in cpu memory devices pids io hugetlb; do
 77:     if [ -d "/sys/fs/cgroup/$controller" ]; then
 78:         for cgroup in $(ls /sys/fs/cgroup/$controller/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^-' | grep -E 'vyoma-|vm-' || true); do
 79:             echo "Removing cgroup: $controller/$cgroup"
 80:             rmdir "/sys/fs/cgroup/$controller/$cgroup" 2>/dev/null || true
 81:         done
 82:     fi
 83: done
 84: for cgroup in $(ls /sys/fs/cgroup/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^vyoma-|^vm-' || true); do
 85:     echo "Removing unified cgroup: $cgroup"
 86:     rmdir "/sys/fs/cgroup/$cgroup" 2>/dev/null || true
 87: done
 88: echo -e "${GREEN}Cgroups removed${NC}"
 89: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 10: Killing any leftover Vyoma processes...${NC}"
 90: pkill -9 -f "vyomad" 2>/dev/null || true
 91: pkill -9 -f "cloud-hypervisor" 2>/dev/null || true
 92: pkill -9 -f "vyoma-agent-vm" 2>/dev/null || true
 93: pkill -9 -f "virtiofsd" 2>/dev/null || true
 94: echo -e "${GREEN}Processes killed${NC}"
 95: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 11: Reloading systemd...${NC}"
 96: systemctl daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true
 97: echo -e "${GREEN}Systemd reloaded${NC}"
 98: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 12: Cleaning up temporary test files...${NC}"
 99: rm -rf /tmp/vyoma-tests-* 2>/dev/null || true
100: rm -rf /tmp/vyoma-smoke-test-* 2>/dev/null || true
101: echo -e "${GREEN}Temporary files cleaned${NC}"
102: echo -e "${GREEN}==========================================${NC}"
103: echo -e "${GREEN}Vyoma has been completely removed!${NC}"
104: echo -e "${GREEN}==========================================${NC}"
105: exit 0

  4: #

  9: #   ./run-all-tests.sh --chaos     # Run only Chaos tests
 10: #   ./run-all-tests.sh --smoke     # Run only Smoke test

 38:     echo "  -h, --help Show this help message"
 39:     echo ""
 40:     echo "Examples:"
 41:     echo "  $0                   # Run all tests"

File: tests/e2e/01_lifecycle.sh
================
 1: #!/bin/bash
 2: set -e
 3: source tests/e2e/common.sh
 4: echo "=== Test 01: VM Lifecycle ==="
 5: check_root
 6: setup_env
 7: # Start Daemon
 8: echo "Starting Daemon..."
 9: sudo -E $VYOMAD_BIN --data-dir $TEST_HOME/.vyoma --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3001 > $TEST_HOME/daemon.log 2>&1 &
10: DAEMON_PID=$!
11: sleep 3
12: # Helper
13: VYOMA="$VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3001"
14: # 1. Pull
15: echo "Pulling image..."
16: $VYOMA pull alpine:latest || { echo "Pull failed (network issue?)"; exit 1; }
17: assert_success "Image Pull"
18: # 2. Run
19: echo "Running VM..."
20: # We need to capture ID. The CLI might print a message.
21: # For Test Script reliability, having CLI output JSON is better, but currently it prints text.
22: # We will just run it and check PS.
23: # Use a long-running command to keep VM alive for pause/resume tests
24: $VYOMA run alpine:latest --vcpu 1 --memory 128 --hostname test-vm
25: assert_success "Run Request"
26: # Quick pause/resume (within 2 seconds - Alpine's /bin/sh exits quickly)
27: sleep 1
28: # 5. Pause/Resume (Must be done quickly before VM exits)
29: echo "Pausing VM..."
30: VM_ID=$($VYOMA ps | grep "test-vm" | awk '{print $1}')
31: echo "VM ID: $VM_ID"
32: if [ -n "$VM_ID" ]; then
33:     $VYOMA pause $VM_ID
34:     assert_success "Pause VM"
35:     echo "Resuming VM..."
36:     $VYOMA resume $VM_ID
37:     assert_success "Resume VM"
38: fi
39: sleep 4
40: # 3. PS
41: echo "Listing VMs..."
42: $VYOMA ps
43: if [ -n "$VM_ID" ] && $VYOMA ps | grep -q "$VM_ID"; then
44:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: VM Running${NC}"
45: else
46:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: VM not found${NC}"
47:     cat $TEST_HOME/daemon.log
48:     exit 1
49: fi
50: # 4. Logs (Check output)
51: # $VYOMA logs <id> ... need ID.
52: # Extract ID from PS
53: VM_ID=$($VYOMA ps | grep "test-vm" | awk '{print $1}')
54: echo "VM ID: $VM_ID"
55: echo "Checking Logs (Timeout 5s)..."
56: timeout 5s $VYOMA logs $VM_ID || true
57: assert_success "Logs Retrieval"
58: # 6. Restart (Disabled: Issue #101 - Restart tries to pull local path)
59: # echo "Restarting VM..."
60: # $VYOMA restart $VM_ID
61: # assert_success "Restart VM"
62: # sleep 5
63: # Verify Restart (New PID or VM ID might change? Logic says Restart replaces VM)
64: # VYOMA restart command replaces VM. ID might stay same?
65: # Check PS again.
66: # if $VYOMA ps | grep -q "test-vm"; then
67: #      echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: VM Restarted${NC}"
68: # else
69: #      echo -e "${RED}Fail: VM missing after restart${NC}"
70: #      exit 1
71: # fi
72: # 7. Stop
73: echo "Stopping VM..."
74: $VYOMA stop $VM_ID
75: # Note: If ID changed during restart, we might need to re-fetch ID.
76: # Restart logic in CLI: "Stopping VM... Starting replacement VM".
77: # It prints new VM ID?
78: # We should use Hostname to stop to be safe.
79: $VYOMA stop test-vm || $VYOMA stop $VM_ID || true
80: assert_success "Stop Request"
81: sleep 2
82: if $VYOMA ps | grep -q "$VM_ID"; then
83:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: VM still running${NC}"
84:     # exit 1 (Soft fail, might take time to stop)
85: else 
86:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: VM stopped${NC}"
87: fi
88: # Cleanup
89: cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
90: echo "=== Test 01 Passed ==="

================
File: tests/e2e/02_volumes_ports.sh
================
 1: #!/bin/bash
 2: set -e
 3: source tests/e2e/common.sh
 4: echo "=== Test 02: Volumes & Ports ==="
 5: check_root
 6: setup_env
 7: # Start Daemon
 8: echo "Starting Daemon (Port 3002)..."
 9: sudo -E $VYOMAD_BIN --data-dir $TEST_HOME/.vyoma --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3002 > $TEST_HOME/daemon.log 2>&1 &
10: DAEMON_PID=$!
11: sleep 3
12: VYOMA="$VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3002"
13: # Prepare Volume
14: HOST_VOL=$(mktemp -d)
15: echo "test-data" > $HOST_VOL/host_file.txt
16: # 1. Run with Volume & Port
17: echo "Running VM with Volume & Port..."
18: # -v host:vm -p host:vm
19: $VYOMA run alpine:latest -v $HOST_VOL:/data -p 8081:80 --hostname vol-vm
20: assert_success "Run with Vol/Port"
21: sleep 3
22: # 2. Verify
23: if $VYOMA ps | grep -q "vol-vm"; then
24:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: VM Running${NC}"
25: else
26:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: VM Failed to Start${NC}"
27:     tail -n 20 $TEST_HOME/daemon.log
28:     exit 1
29: fi
30: # 3. Verify Port Binding (Host Side)
31: # Check if something is listening on 8081
32: if ss -tuln | grep -q ":8081"; then
33:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: Port 8081 Listening${NC}"
34: else
35:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Port 8081 not bound${NC}"
36:     # exit 1 (Soft fail for now as ss might differ)
37: fi
38: # 4. Verify Volume (Requires Exec/SSH - Skipping Deep Verification)
39: # We assume if VM started, VirtioFS is attached.
40: $VYOMA stop "$($VYOMA ps | grep vol-vm | awk '{print $1}')"
41: cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
42: rm -rf $HOST_VOL
43: echo "=== Test 02 Passed ==="

File: tests/e2e/04_compose.sh
================
 1: #!/bin/bash
 2: set -e
 3: source tests/e2e/common.sh
 4: echo "=== Test 04: Compose (vyoma up) ==="
 5: check_root
 6: setup_env
 7: # Start Daemon
 8: echo "Starting Daemon (3004)..."
 9: sudo -E $VYOMAD_BIN --data-dir $TEST_HOME/.vyoma --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3004 > $TEST_HOME/daemon.log 2>&1 &
10: DAEMON_PID=$!
11: sleep 3
12: VYOMA="$VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3004"
13: # 1. Setup Compose File
14: mkdir -p $TEST_HOME/compose_test
15: cd $TEST_HOME/compose_test
16: cat <<EOF > vyoma-compose.yml
17: version: '1'
18: services:
19:   web:
20:     image: alpine:latest
21:     cpus: 1
22:     memory: 128
23:   db:
24:     image: alpine:latest
25:     cpus: 1
26:     memory: 128
27: EOF
28: # 2. Up
29: echo "Running vyoma up..."
30: $VYOMA up -d
31: assert_success "Compose Up"
32: sleep 5
33: # 3. Verify
34: echo "Verifying Services..."
35: PS=$($VYOMA ps)
36: echo "$PS"
37: if echo "$PS" | grep -q "web" && echo "$PS" | grep -q "db"; then
38:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: Services Running${NC}"
39: else
40:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Services missing${NC}"
41:     exit 1
42: fi
43: # 3.5 Scale
44: echo "Scaling web=2..."
45: # Command: vyoma scale web=2
46: $VYOMA scale web=2
47: assert_success "Scale Request"
48: sleep 5
49: PS_SCALE=$($VYOMA ps)
50: # grep -c "web" should be 2?
51: # The service name might be "compose_test_web_1", "compose_test_web_2".
52: # Labels will prevent collision?
53: # Implementation of "scale" CLI was: "vyoma scale <service>=<count>".
54: # It calls "vyoma run" repeatedly?
55: # Let's verify scaling took effect.
56: if [ $(echo "$PS_SCALE" | grep -c "web") -ge 2 ]; then
57:      echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: Scaled to 2 instances${NC}"
58: else
59:      echo -e "${RED}Fail: Scale failed${NC}"
60: fi
61: # 4. Down
62: echo "Running vyoma down..."
63: $VYOMA down
64: assert_success "Compose Down"
65: sleep 2
66: if $VYOMA ps | grep -q "web"; then
67:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Services still running${NC}"
68:     # exit 1
69: else
70:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: Services Removed${NC}"
71: fi
72: # cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
73: echo "=== Test 04 Passed ==="

22: # 1. Init Swarm
23: echo "Initializing Swarm on Node 1..."
24: $VYOMA1 swarm init
25: assert_success "Swarm Init"
26: # 2. Join Swarm
27: echo "Joining Node 2 to Node 1..."
28: # Syntax: vyoma swarm join <IP>

32: echo "Listing Nodes..."

34: echo "$NODES"

37: else
38:      echo -e "${RED}Fail: No nodes found${NC}"
39: fi
40: # Cleanup
41: echo "Cleaning up..."
42: kill $PID1 $PID2 || true
43: wait $PID1 $PID2 || true
44: rm -rf $HOME1 $HOME2

 6: setup_env

19:     VM_ID=$($VYOMA ps | grep snap-vm | awk '{print $1}')

23: sleep 1
24: echo "Snapshotting $VM_ID..."
25: $VYOMA snapshot $VM_ID
26: assert_success "Snapshot Request"
27: # 3. Export (Skip on low-memory systems - 2GB disk causes hangs)
28: echo "Skipping export/import test (heavy on low-RAM systems)"
29: echo "Note: Snapshot functionality verified via pause/resume above"
30: cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
31: echo "=== Test 07 Passed ==="

File: tests/e2e/14_volumes.sh
================
 1: #!/bin/bash
 2: set -e
 3: source "$(dirname "$0")/common.sh"
 4: echo "Running 14_volumes.sh..."
 5: check_root
 6: setup_env
 7: mkdir -p "$TEST_HOME/host_vol"
 8: echo "Hello from host" > "$TEST_HOME/host_vol/hello.txt"
 9: chmod 777 "$TEST_HOME/host_vol"
10: # Start Daemon
11: echo "Starting Daemon..."
12: sudo -E $VYOMAD_BIN --data-dir $TEST_HOME/.vyoma --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3014 > $TEST_HOME/daemon.log 2>&1 &
13: DAEMON_PID=$!
14: sleep 3
15: VYOMA="$VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3014"
16: echo "Running VM with volume mount..."
17: $VYOMA run -v "$TEST_HOME/host_vol:/mnt" alpine:latest --hostname vol-test
18: sleep 2
19: VM_ID=$($VYOMA ps | grep "vol-test" | awk '{print $1}')
20: echo "Started VM: $VM_ID"
21: if [ -z "$VM_ID" ]; then
22:     echo "ERROR: Failed to get VM ID"
23:     cleanup_env
24:     exit 1
25: fi
26: sleep 5
27: echo "Testing file readability in VM..."
28: OUTPUT=$(RUST_LOG=error $VYOMA exec "$VM_ID" cat /mnt/hello.txt)
29: if [ "$OUTPUT" != "Hello from host" ]; then
30:     echo "ERROR: File content mismatch. Expected 'Hello from host', got: $OUTPUT"
31:     cleanup_env 14
32:     exit 1
33: fi
34: echo "File content match!"
35: echo "Testing write from VM to host..."
36: RUST_LOG=error $VYOMA exec "$VM_ID" sh -c "echo 'Hello from VM' > /mnt/vm.txt"
37: if [ ! -f "$TEST_HOME/host_vol/vm.txt" ]; then
38:     echo "ERROR: File vm.txt not found on host!"
39:     cleanup_env 14
40:     exit 1
41: fi
42: HOST_READ=$(cat "$TEST_HOME/host_vol/vm.txt")
43: if [ "$HOST_READ" != "Hello from VM" ]; then
44:     echo "ERROR: File content mismatch on host. Expected 'Hello from VM', got: $HOST_READ"
45:     cleanup_env 14
46:     exit 1
47: fi
48: echo "Host read matched VM write!"
49: echo "Cleaning up..."
50: cleanup_env
51: echo "14_volumes.sh completed successfully."

19:     'w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-200',
20:     active
21:       ? 'bg-primary/10 text-primary shadow-sm border border-primary/10'
22:       : 'text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground'
23:   );
24:   if (to) {
25:     return (
26:       <Link to={to} className={className} onClick={onClick}>
27:         {content}
28:       </Link>
29:     );
30:   }
31:   return (
32:     <button onClick={onClick} className={className}>
33:       {content}
34:     </button>
35:   );
36: }

File: ui/src/features/compose/ComposePage.tsx
================
 1: import { useState } from 'react';
 2: import Editor from '@monaco-editor/react';
 3: import yaml from 'js-yaml';
 4: import { Upload } from 'lucide-react';
 5: import { Button } from '../../components/ui';
 6: import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
 7: import { apiFetch } from '../../lib/api-client';
 8: const defaultYaml = `services:
 9:   web:
10:     image: nginx:alpine
11:     ports:
12:       - "8080:80"
13:     vm:
14:       vcpus: 2
15:       memory: 1024
16:   api:
17:     image: node:20-alpine
18:     environment:
19:       - NODE_ENV=production
20:     vm:
21:       vcpus: 1
22:       memory: 512
23: `;
24: export function ComposePage() {
25:   const [yamlContent, setYamlContent] = useState(defaultYaml);
26:   const [errors, setErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);
27:   const [deployStatus, setDeployStatus] = useState('');
28:   const deployMutation = useMutation({
29:     mutationFn: (content: string) => 
30:       apiFetch('/up', { 
31:         method: 'POST', 
32:         body: content, 
33:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-yaml' } 
34:       }),
35:     onSuccess: () => {
36:       setDeployStatus('Deployed!');
37:       setTimeout(() => setDeployStatus(''), 3000);
38:     },
39:     onError: () => {
40:       setDeployStatus('Deploy failed');
41:       setTimeout(() => setDeployStatus(''), 3000);
42:     }
43:   });
44:   const handleValidation = (value: string | undefined) => {
45:     if (value !== undefined) setYamlContent(value);
46:     if (!value) return;
47:     try {
48:       yaml.load(value);
49:       setErrors([]);
50:     } catch (e: any) {
51:       setErrors([e.message]);
52:     }
53:   };
54:   const handleDeploy = () => {
55:     if (errors.length > 0) return;
56:     setDeployStatus('Deploying...');
57:     deployMutation.mutate(yamlContent);
58:   };
59:   return (
60:     <div className="p-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] flex flex-col">
61:       <header className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
62:         <div>
63:           <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1">Compose Editor</h2>
64:           <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Monaco editor with YAML validation. Click Deploy to run.</p>
65:         </div>
66:         <Button onClick={handleDeploy} disabled={errors.length > 0 || deployMutation.isPending}>
67:           <Upload size={16} className="mr-2" /> {deployMutation.isPending ? 'Deploying...' : 'Deploy'}
68:         </Button>
69:       </header>
70:       {deployStatus && (
71:         <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-green-500/10 border border-green-500/20 text-green-400 text-sm">
72:           {deployStatus}
73:         </div>
74:       )}
75:       {errors.length > 0 && (
76:         <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20 text-destructive text-sm">
77:           {errors[0]}
78:         </div>
79:       )}
80:       <div className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-border overflow-hidden">
81:         <Editor
82:           height="100%"
83:           defaultLanguage="yaml"
84:           value={yamlContent}
85:           onChange={handleValidation}
86:           theme="vs-dark"
87:           options={{
88:             minimap: { enabled: false },
89:             fontSize: 13,
90:             padding: { top: 16 },
91:             scrollBeyondLastLine: false,
92:           }}
93:         />
94:       </div>
95:     </div>
96:   );
97: }

 2: import { Clock, Play, Trash2, Plus } from 'lucide-react';

13:   const formatTime = (ts: number) => new Date(ts * 1000).toLocaleString();
14:   const formatSize = (b: number) => (b < 1024 * 1024 ? `${(b / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB` : `${(b / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB`);
15:   const handleRestore = (snapId: string) => {
16:     if (!confirm(`Restore to snapshot ${snapId.slice(0, 8)}?`)) return;
17:     restoreSnapshot.mutate({ vmId: selectedVm, snapshotId: snapId });
18:   };
19:   const handleCreateSnapshot = () => {
20:     if (!selectedVm) return;
21:     const name = prompt('Snapshot name (optional):');
22:     createSnapshot.mutate({ vmId: selectedVm, name: name || undefined });
23:   };
24:   return (
25:     <div className="p-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
26:       <header className="mb-8">
27:         <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1">TimeMachine</h2>

29:       </header>
30:       <div className="flex gap-4 mb-6">

32:           <SelectTrigger className="w-[280px]">

34:           </SelectTrigger>

36:             {vmsData?.vms?.map((v) => (

39:               </SelectItem>
40:             ))}
41:           </SelectContent>
42:         </Select>
43:         <Button onClick={handleCreateSnapshot} disabled={!selectedVm || createSnapshot.isPending}>
44:           <Plus size={16} className="mr-2" /> Create Snapshot
45:         </Button>
46:       </div>
47:       {!selectedVm ? (
48:         <EmptyState title="Select a VM" description="Choose a VM to view its snapshot timeline." icon={<Clock size={48} />} />
49:       ) : isLoading ? (
50:         <Loading text="Loading snapshots..." />
51:       ) : snapshots.length === 0 ? (
52:         <EmptyState title="No snapshots" description="Create a snapshot to start TimeMachine." icon={<Clock size={48} />} />
53:       ) : (
54:         <div className="relative">
55:           <div className="absolute left-8 top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-border" />

71:                       <button
72:                         onClick={() => handleRestore(snap.id)}
73:                         className="p-2 hover:bg-muted rounded text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
74:                         title="Restore"
75:                         disabled={restoreSnapshot.isPending}
76:                       >
77:                         <Play size={16} />
78:                       </button>
79:                       <button className="p-2 hover:bg-destructive/20 rounded text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive" title="Delete">
80:                         <Trash2 size={16} />
81:                       </button>
82:                     </div>
83:                   </div>
84:                   {snap.label && <div className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">{snap.label}</div>}
85:                 </div>
86:               </div>
87:             ))}
88:           </div>
89:         </div>
90:       )}
91:     </div>
92:   );
93: }

================
File: ui/src/features/topology/TopologyPage.tsx
================
  1: import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
  2: import * as d3 from 'd3';
  3: import { useVmList } from '../../hooks/queries/useVmList';
  4: import { useNetworks } from '../../hooks/queries/useNetworks';
  5: interface TopologyNode {
  6:   id: string;
  7:   type: 'vm' | 'network';
  8:   label: string;
  9:   x?: number;
 10:   y?: number;
 11: }
 12: interface TopologyLink {
 13:   source: string;
 14:   target: string;
 15: }
 16: export function TopologyPage() {
 17:   const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null);
 18:   const { data: vmsData } = useVmList();
 19:   const { data: netsData } = useNetworks();
 20:   const [nodes, setNodes] = useState<TopologyNode[]>([]);
 21:   const [links, setLinks] = useState<TopologyLink[]>([]);
 22:   useEffect(() => {
 23:     if (!vmsData?.vms || !netsData?.networks) return;
 24:     const topoNodes: TopologyNode[] = [
 25:       ...vmsData.vms.map((v) => ({ id: v.id, type: 'vm' as const, label: v.labels['vyoma.service'] || v.id.slice(0, 8) })),
 26:       ...netsData.networks.map((n) => ({ id: n.name, type: 'network' as const, label: n.name })),
 27:     ];
 28:     const topoLinks: TopologyLink[] = vmsData.vms.map((v) => ({ source: v.id, target: v.labels['network'] || 'default' }));
 29:     setNodes(topoNodes);
 30:     setLinks(topoLinks);
 31:   }, [vmsData, netsData]);
 32:   useEffect(() => {
 33:     if (!svgRef.current || nodes.length === 0) return;
 34:     const svg = d3.select(svgRef.current);
 35:     svg.selectAll('*').remove();
 36:     const width = svgRef.current.clientWidth || 800;
 37:     const height = svgRef.current.clientHeight || 500;
 38:     const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(nodes as any)
 39:       .force('link', d3.forceLink(links).id((d: any) => d.id).distance(120))
 40:       .force('charge', d3.forceManyBody().strength(-400))
 41:       .force('center', d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2))
 42:       .force('collision', d3.forceCollide().radius(40));
 43:     const link = svg.append('g')
 44:       .selectAll('line')
 45:       .data(links)
 46:       .enter()
 47:       .append('line')
 48:       .attr('stroke', '#334155')
 49:       .attr('stroke-width', 2);
 50:     const node = svg.append('g')
 51:       .selectAll('g')
 52:       .data(nodes)
 53:       .enter()
 54:       .append('g')
 55:       .call(d3.drag<any, any>()
 56:         .on('start', (event, d) => {
 57:           if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0.3).restart();
 58:           d.fx = d.x;
 59:           d.fy = d.y;
 60:         })
 61:         .on('drag', (event, d) => {
 62:           d.fx = event.x;
 63:           d.fy = event.y;
 64:         })
 65:         .on('end', (event, d) => {
 66:           if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0);
 67:           delete d.fx;
 68:           delete d.fy;
 69:         })
 70:       );
 71:     node.append('circle')
 72:       .attr('r', 24)
 73:       .attr('fill', (d) => d.type === 'vm' ? '#2fd9f4' : '#f6be39') // Use Vyoma accent/secondary
 74:       .attr('stroke', '#1e293b')
 75:       .attr('stroke-width', 2);
 76:     node.append('text')
 77:       .text((d) => d.label.slice(0, 8))
 78:       .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
 79:       .attr('dy', 40)
 80:       .attr('fill', '#64748b')
 81:       .attr('font-size', '11px');
 82:     simulation.on('tick', () => {
 83:       link
 84:         .attr('x1', (d: any) => d.source.x)
 85:         .attr('y1', (d: any) => d.source.y)
 86:         .attr('x2', (d: any) => d.target.x)
 87:         .attr('y2', (d: any) => d.target.y);
 88:       node.attr('transform', (d: any) => `translate(${d.x},${d.y})`);
 89:     });
 90:   }, [nodes, links]);
 91:   return (
 92:     <div className="p-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto h-[600px] flex flex-col">
 93:       <header className="mb-4">
 94:         <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1">Network Topology</h2>
 95:         <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Interactive graph of VMs and networks. Drag nodes to reposition.</p>
 96:       </header>
 97:       <div className="flex-1 bg-card rounded-xl border border-border overflow-hidden relative">
 98:         {nodes.length === 0 ? (
 99:           <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground">
100:             No topology data. Run some VMs first.
101:           </div>
102:         ) : (
103:           <svg ref={svgRef} className="w-full h-full" />
104:         )}
105:       </div>
106:     </div>
107:   );
108: }

File: ui/src/hooks/queries/useSnapshots.ts
================
 1: import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
 2: import { api } from '../../lib/api-client';
 3: export interface Snapshot {
 4:   id: string;
 5:   label?: string;
 6:   created_at: number;
 7:   size_bytes: number;
 8: }
 9: export function useSnapshots(vmId: string | null) {
10:   return useQuery({
11:     queryKey: ['snapshots', vmId],
12:     queryFn: () => api.get<{ snapshots: Snapshot[] }>(`/snapshots/${vmId}`),
13:     enabled: !!vmId,
14:   });
15: }
16: export function useCreateSnapshot() {
17:   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
18:   return useMutation({
19:     mutationFn: ({ vmId, name }: { vmId: string; name?: string }) => 
20:       api.post(`/snapshots/${vmId}`, { name }),
21:     onSuccess: (_, { vmId }) => {
22:       queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['snapshots', vmId] });
23:     },
24:   });
25: }
26: export function useRestoreSnapshot() {
27:   return useMutation({
28:     mutationFn: ({ vmId, snapshotId }: { vmId: string; snapshotId: string }) => 
29:       api.post(`/snapshots/${vmId}/restore`, { snapshot_id: snapshotId }),
30:   });
31: }

 18:     dm_name: Option<String>,

 23:     fn new(
 24:         loop_devices: Vec<vyoma_storage::cow::LoopDevice>,
 25:         dm_name: Option<String>,

 37: impl Drop for BuildResourceGuard {
 38:     fn drop(&mut self) {
 39:         info!("BuildResourceGuard: cleaning up build resources");
 40:         let loop_mgr = match vyoma_storage::cow::LoopManager::new() {
 41:             Ok(mgr) => mgr,
 42:             Err(e) => {
 43:                 warn!("BuildResourceGuard: failed to create loop manager: {}", e);
 44:                 return;
 45:             }
 46:         };
 47:         for device in self.loop_devices.drain(..) {
 48:             if let Err(e) = loop_mgr.detach(&device) {
 49:                 warn!("BuildResourceGuard: failed to detach loop device {}: {}", device.path.display(), e);
 50:             } else {
 51:                 info!("BuildResourceGuard: detached loop device {}", device.path.display());
 52:             }
 53:         }
 54:         if let Some(ref dm_name) = self.dm_name {
 55:             let dm_mgr = match vyoma_storage::dm::DmManager::new() {
 56:                 Ok(mgr) => mgr,
 57:                 Err(e) => {
 58:                     warn!("BuildResourceGuard: failed to create DM manager: {}", e);
 59:                     return;
 60:                 }
 61:             };
 62:             if let Err(e) = dm_mgr.remove_snapshot(dm_name) {
 63:                 warn!("BuildResourceGuard: failed to remove DM snapshot {}: {}", dm_name, e);
 64:             } else {
 65:                 info!("BuildResourceGuard: removed DM snapshot {}", dm_name);
 66:             }
 67:         }
 68:         if let Some(ref cgroup_vm_id) = self.cgroup_vm_id {
 69:             let cgroup_mgr = CgroupManager::new();
 70:             if let Err(e) = cgroup_mgr.remove_vm_cgroup(cgroup_vm_id) {
 71:                 warn!("BuildResourceGuard: failed to remove cgroup {}: {}", cgroup_vm_id, e);
 72:             } else {
 73:                 info!("BuildResourceGuard: removed cgroup {}", cgroup_vm_id);
 74:             }
 75:         }
 76:         info!("BuildResourceGuard: cleanup complete");
 77:     }
 78: }
 79: /// Core build engine that executes Vyomafile instructions in isolated VMs
 80: pub struct BuildRunner {
 81:     pub work_dir: PathBuf,
 82:     temp_dir: PathBuf,
 83:     /// If true, perform measured build: launch ephemeral VM, capture PCRs, sign manifest.
 84:     pub measured: bool,
 85:     /// Optional path to a signing key for manifest signing.
 86:     pub signing_key_path: Option<String>,
 87:     /// Cache of converted ext4 base images (image name -> ext4 path)
 88:     ext4_cache: std::collections::HashMap<String, PathBuf>,
 89:     /// Optional cgroup manager for resource limits
 90:     cgroups: Option<Arc<CgroupManager>>,
 91: }
 92: impl BuildRunner {
 93:     pub fn new(work_dir: PathBuf) -> Self {
 94:         let temp_dir = work_dir.join("temp");
 95:         Self {
 96:             work_dir,
 97:             temp_dir,
 98:             measured: false,
 99:             signing_key_path: None,
100:             ext4_cache: std::collections::HashMap::new(),
101:             cgroups: None,
102:         }
103:     }
104:     pub fn with_measured(mut self, measured: bool, signing_key_path: Option<String>) -> Self {
105:         self.measured = measured;
106:         self.signing_key_path = signing_key_path;
107:         self
108:     }
109:     pub fn with_cgroups(mut self, cgroups: Arc<CgroupManager>) -> Self {
110:         self.cgroups = Some(cgroups);
111:         self
112:     }
113:     /// Execute a complete build from Vyomafile
114:     pub async fn build(
115:         &mut self,
116:         vyomafile_path: &Path,
117:         context_dir: &Path,
118:         image_name: &str,
119:     ) -> Result<BuildResult, BuildError> {
120:         info!("Starting VM-isolated build for {} (measured={})", image_name, self.measured);
121:         // Parse Vyomafile
122:         let vyomafile = Vyomafile::parse(vyomafile_path)
123:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ParseError(e.to_string()))?;
124:         // Initialize build state
125:         let mut current_rootfs: Option<PathBuf> = None;
126:         let mut current_config = OciImageConfig {
127:             entrypoint: None,
128:             cmd: None,
129:             env: Some(Vec::new()),
130:             working_dir: None,
131:             exposed_ports: None,
132:             user: None,
133:         };
134:         // Process each instruction
135:         for instruction in &vyomafile.instructions {
136:             match instruction {
137:                 Instruction::From { image } => {
138:                     info!("Processing FROM {}", image);
139:                     current_rootfs = Some(self.handle_from(&image).await?);
140:                 }
141:                 Instruction::Run { command } => {
142:                     info!("Processing RUN {}", command);
143:                     if let Some(ref rootfs) = current_rootfs {
144:                         let new_rootfs = self.handle_run(rootfs, &command).await?;
145:                         current_rootfs = Some(new_rootfs);
146:                     } else {
147:                         return Err(BuildError::ExecutionError(
148:                             "RUN instruction without FROM".to_string()
149:                         ));
150:                     }
151:                 }
152:                 Instruction::Copy { src, dst } => {
153:                     info!("Processing COPY {} -> {}", src, dst);
154:                     if let Some(ref rootfs) = current_rootfs {
155:                         self.handle_copy(rootfs, context_dir, &src, &dst).await?;
156:                     } else {
157:                         return Err(BuildError::ExecutionError(
158:                             "COPY instruction without FROM".to_string()
159:                         ));
160:                     }
161:                 }
162:                 Instruction::Cmd { args } => {
163:                     info!("Processing CMD {:?}", args);
164:                     current_config.cmd = Some(args.clone());
165:                 }
166:                 Instruction::Entrypoint { args } => {
167:                     info!("Processing ENTRYPOINT {:?}", args);
168:                     current_config.entrypoint = Some(args.clone());
169:                 }
170:                 Instruction::Env { key, value } => {
171:                     info!("Processing ENV {}={}", key, value);
172:                     if let Some(ref mut env_vars) = current_config.env {
173:                         env_vars.push(format!("{}={}", key, value));
174:                     } else {
175:                         current_config.env = Some(vec![format!("{}={}", key, value)]);
176:                     }
177:                 }
178:                 Instruction::Workdir { path } => {
179:                     info!("Processing WORKDIR {}", path);
180:                     current_config.working_dir = Some(path.clone());
181:                 }
182:                 Instruction::VmMeasuredBoot => {
183:                     info!("Processing VM_MEASURED_BOOT directive - measured boot enabled");
184:                     // The measured flag is already set at the build runner level,
185:                     // so we just log here for clarity
186:                 }
187:             }
188:         }
189:         // Finalize the image
190:         if let Some(final_rootfs) = current_rootfs {
191:             self.finalize_image(&final_rootfs, image_name, &current_config).await
192:         } else {
193:             Err(BuildError::ExecutionError(
194:                 "No FROM instruction found".to_string()
195:             ))
196:         }
197:     }
198:     /// Launch an ephemeral VM to pre-compute expected PCR values.
199:     /// The VM boots the final rootfs with OVMF firmware and a vTPM.
200:     /// After boot, PCR values are read and the VM is destroyed.
201:     async fn measure_boot_pcr(&self, rootfs_path: &Path) -> Result<HashMap<u32, String>, BuildError> {
202:         info!("Starting ephemeral measurement VM for PCR pre-computation");
203:         let measure_vm_dir = self.temp_dir.join("measure-vm");
204:         std::fs::create_dir_all(&measure_vm_dir)
205:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create measure VM dir: {}", e)))?;
206:         // Find kernel and initrd from the built rootfs or use defaults
207:         let kernel_path = self.find_kernel_path()
208:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Kernel not found: {}", e)))?;
209:         // 1. Start vTPM
210:         let mut vtpm = VtpmManager::new("measure-vm", &self.temp_dir)
211:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create vTPM: {}", e)))?;
212:         vtpm.start()
213:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to start vTPM: {}", e)))?;
214:         info!("vTPM started at {}", vtpm.socket_path());
215:         let tpm_socket = vtpm.socket_path().to_string();
216:         // 2. Build Cloud Hypervisor config for the measurement VM
217:         let ch_socket_path = measure_vm_dir.join("ch.sock");
218:         // We'll build the CH args manually for the measurement VM
219:         let mut ch_args = vec![
220:             "--kernel".to_string(),
221:             kernel_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
222:             "--memory".to_string(),
223:             "size=512M".to_string(),
224:             "--cpus".to_string(),
225:             "1".to_string(),
226:             "--console".to_string(),
227:             "off".to_string(),
228:             "--serial".to_string(),
229:             "tty".to_string(),
230:             "--api-socket".to_string(),
231:             ch_socket_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
232:             "--rng".to_string(),
233:             "src=/dev/urandom".to_string(),
234:             "--tpm".to_string(),
235:             format!("socket={}", tpm_socket),
236:         ];
237:         // Add rootfs drive
238:         let rootfs_str = rootfs_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
239:         ch_args.extend_from_slice(&[
240:             "--disk".to_string(),
241:             format!("path={},readonly=on", rootfs_str),
242:         ]);
243:         // Check if OVMF firmware exists
244:         let ovmf_paths = [
245:             Path::new("/usr/share/OVMF/OVMF_CODE.fd"),
246:             Path::new("/usr/share/qemu/ovmf-x64/OVMF_CODE.fd"),
247:             Path::new("/usr/share/edk2/ovmf/x64/OVMF_CODE.fd"),
248:         ];
249:         if let Some(fw_path) = ovmf_paths.iter().find(|p| p.exists()) {
250:             ch_args.extend_from_slice(&[
251:                 "--firmware".to_string(),
252:                 fw_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
253:             ]);
254:             info!("Using OVMF firmware: {:?}", fw_path);
255:         } else {
256:             warn!("OVMF firmware not found in standard locations, measurement VM will use direct boot");
257:         }
258:         info!("Launching measurement VM with args: {:?}", ch_args);
259:         // 3. Launch Cloud Hypervisor
260:         let mut child = Command::new("cloud-hypervisor")
261:             .args(&ch_args)
262:             .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
263:             .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
264:             .spawn()
265:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to start cloud-hypervisor: {}", e)))?;
266:         // Wait for socket
267:         let timeout_duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
268:         let start = std::time::Instant::now();
269:         while !ch_socket_path.exists() {
270:             if start.elapsed() > timeout_duration {
271:                 let _ = child.kill();
272:                 return Err(BuildError::ExecutionError(
273:                     "Timed out waiting for Cloud Hypervisor socket".to_string()
274:                 ));
275:             }
276:             tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
277:         }
278:         // 4. Boot the VM via API
279:         let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
280:             .unix_socket(ch_socket_path)
281:             .build()
282:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to build HTTP client: {}", e)))?;
283:         // Create VM
284:         let vm_config = serde_json::json!({
285:             "vcpu": { "boot_vcpus": 1, "max_vcpus": 1 },
286:             "memory": { "size": 512 * 1024 * 1024, "shared": true },
287:             "payload": {
288:                 "kernel": kernel_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
289:                 "cmdline": "console=ttyS0 reboot=k panic=1 root=/dev/vda rw init=/bin/sh"
290:             },
291:             "disks": [{
292:                 "path": rootfs_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
293:                 "readonly": true
294:             }],
295:             "tpm": {
296:                 "socket": tpm_socket
297:             }
298:         });
299:         // Allow time for firmware measurement during boot
300:         // Use a generous boot timeout since firmware + kernel + initrd need to be measured
301:         let boot_timeout = Duration::from_secs(30);
302:         let _ = timeout(boot_timeout, async {
303:             // Try to create and boot the VM
304:             let _ = client
305:                 .put("http://localhost/api/v1/vm.create")
306:                 .json(&vm_config)
307:                 .send()
308:                 .await;
309:             let _ = client
310:                 .put("http://localhost/api/v1/vm.boot")
311:                 .json(&serde_json::json!({}))
312:                 .send()
313:                 .await;
314:         }).await;
315:         // 5. Wait a bit more for measurements to settle
316:         tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(5)).await;
317:         // 6. Read PCR values from vTPM
318:         let pcrs = vtpm.read_pcrs(&[0, 1, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 14])
319:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to read PCRs: {}", e)))?;
320:         info!("Captured PCR values: {:?}", pcrs);
321:         // 7. Cleanup: kill the measurement VM and vTPM
322:         let _ = child.kill();
323:         let _ = child.wait();
324:         drop(vtpm);
325:         // Clean up measurement VM directory
326:         let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&measure_vm_dir);
327:         Ok(pcrs)
328:     }
329:     async fn handle_from(&self, image: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, BuildError> {
330:         // For now, we'll assume the image is already available locally
331:         // In a real implementation, this would call ensure_image_locally
332:         let image_path = self.work_dir.join("images").join(image.replace('/', "_").replace(':', "_"));
333:         let rootfs_path = image_path.join("rootfs.sqfs");
334:         if !rootfs_path.exists() {
335:             return Err(BuildError::ExecutionError(
336:                 format!("Base image {} not found", image)
337:             ));
338:         }
339:         Ok(rootfs_path)
340:     }
341:     async fn handle_run(&mut self, rootfs_path: &Path, command: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, BuildError> {
342:         info!("Executing RUN command in real VM: {}", command);
343:         let build_id = format!("build-{}", chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis());
344:         let build_dir = self.temp_dir.join(&build_id);
345:         std::fs::create_dir_all(&build_dir)
346:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create build dir: {}", e)))?;
347:         let result = self.execute_build_in_vm(rootfs_path, command, &build_dir).await;
348:         let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&build_dir);
349:         result
350:     }
351:     async fn execute_build_in_vm(
352:         &mut self,
353:         base_squashfs: &Path,
354:         command: &str,
355:         build_dir: &Path,
356:     ) -> Result<PathBuf, BuildError> {
357:         let cache_key = base_squashfs.to_string_lossy().to_string();
358:         let ext4_path = if let Some(cached_ext4) = self.ext4_cache.get(&cache_key) {
359:             if cached_ext4.exists() {
360:                 info!("Using cached ext4 base image: {:?}", cached_ext4);
361:                 cached_ext4.clone()
362:             } else {
363:                 self.create_cached_ext4(base_squashfs, &cache_key).await?
364:             }
365:         } else {
366:             self.create_cached_ext4(base_squashfs, &cache_key).await?
367:         };
368:         let cow_path = build_dir.join("cow.img");
369:         let dm_name = format!("vyoma-build-{}", std::process::id());
370:         let new_layer_path = build_dir.join("layer.sqfs");
371:         let cgroup_vm_id = format!("vyoma-build-{}", std::process::id());
372:         info!("Using ext4 base: {:?}", ext4_path);
373:         vyoma_storage::cow::LoopManager::create_cow_file(&cow_path, 1024)
374:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create COW file: {}", e)))?;
375:         let loop_mgr = vyoma_storage::cow::LoopManager::new()
376:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create loop manager: {}", e)))?;
377:         let base_loop = loop_mgr.attach(&ext4_path)
378:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to attach base ext4: {}", e)))?;
379:         let cow_loop = loop_mgr.attach(&cow_path)
380:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to attach COW: {}", e)))?;
381:         info!("Creating device mapper snapshot");
382:         let dm_mgr = vyoma_storage::dm::DmManager::new()
383:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create DM manager: {}", e)))?;
384:         let dm_dev = dm_mgr.create_snapshot(
385:             &dm_name,
386:             base_loop.path(),
387:             cow_loop.path(),
388:         ).map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create DM snapshot: {}", e)))?;
389:         let loop_devices = vec![base_loop, cow_loop];
390:         let cgroup_id = if self.cgroups.is_some() {
391:             Some(cgroup_vm_id.as_str())
392:         } else {
393:             None
394:         };
395:         let vm_result = self.run_command_in_ch(&dm_dev.path().to_path_buf(), command, build_dir, cgroup_id).await;
396:         let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&ext4_path);
397:         let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&cow_path);
398:         let cgroup_id_to_store = if self.cgroups.is_some() {
399:             Some(cgroup_vm_id)
400:         } else {
401:             None
402:         };
403:         let guard = BuildResourceGuard::new(
404:             loop_devices,
405:             Some(dm_name.clone()),
406:             cgroup_id_to_store,
407:             None,
408:         );
409:         drop(guard);
410:         match vm_result {
411:             Ok((0, _)) => {
412:                 info!("Creating new squashfs layer from DM device");
413:                 let dm_device_path = PathBuf::from(format!("/dev/mapper/{}", dm_name));
414:                 if dm_device_path.exists() {
415:                     self.ext4_to_squashfs(&dm_device_path, &new_layer_path).await?;
416:                     Ok(new_layer_path)
417:                 } else {
418:                     Err(BuildError::ExecutionError(
419:                         "DM device not found for layer creation".to_string()
420:                     ))
421:                 }
422:             }
423:             Ok((code, _)) => Err(BuildError::ExecutionError(
424:                 format!("Build command failed with exit code {}", code)
425:             )),
426:             Err(e) => Err(e),
427:         }
428:     }
429:     async fn squashfs_to_ext4(&self, squashfs: &Path, ext4: &Path) -> Result<(), BuildError> {
430:         let temp_dir = tempfile::tempdir()
431:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create temp dir: {}", e)))?;
432:         self.extract_squashfs(squashfs, temp_dir.path()).await?;
433:         let ext4_str = ext4.to_string_lossy();
434:         // Create a 2G sparse file
435:         let trunc_out = Command::new("truncate")
436:             .args(["-s", "2G", &ext4_str])
437:             .output()
438:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to run truncate: {}", e)))?;
439:         if !trunc_out.status.success() {
440:             return Err(BuildError::ExecutionError(
441:                 format!("truncate failed: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&trunc_out.stderr))
442:             ));
443:         }
444:         let output = Command::new("mkfs.ext4")
445:             .args([
446:                 "-F",
447:                 "-d",
448:                 &temp_dir.path().to_string_lossy(),
449:                 &ext4_str
450:             ])
451:             .output()
452:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to run mkfs.ext4: {}", e)))?;
453:         if !output.status.success() {
454:             return Err(BuildError::ExecutionError(
455:                 format!("mkfs.ext4 failed: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr))
456:             ));
457:         }
458:         Ok(())
459:     }
460:     async fn create_cached_ext4(&mut self, squashfs: &Path, cache_key: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, BuildError> {
461:         let cache_dir = self.work_dir.join("ext4-cache");
462:         std::fs::create_dir_all(&cache_dir)
463:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create cache dir: {}", e)))?;
464:         let safe_key = cache_key.replace('/', "_").replace(':', "_").replace('\\', "_");
465:         let ext4_path = cache_dir.join(format!("{}.ext4", safe_key));
466:         if !ext4_path.exists() {
467:             info!("Creating cached ext4 from {:?} -> {:?}", squashfs, ext4_path);
468:             self.squashfs_to_ext4(squashfs, &ext4_path).await?;
469:             self.ext4_cache.insert(cache_key.to_string(), ext4_path.clone());
470:             info!("Cached ext4 created and stored in cache");
471:         }
472:         Ok(ext4_path)
473:     }
474:     async fn ext4_to_squashfs(&self, ext4: &Path, squashfs: &Path) -> Result<(), BuildError> {
475:         let mount_dir = tempfile::tempdir()
476:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create mount dir: {}", e)))?;
477:         Command::new("mount")
478:             .arg(ext4)
479:             .arg(mount_dir.path())
480:             .output()
481:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to mount ext4: {}", e)))?;
482:         let output = Command::new("mksquashfs")
483:             .arg(mount_dir.path())
484:             .arg(squashfs)
485:             .arg("-comp")
486:             .arg("zstd")
487:             .arg("-quiet")
488:             .output();
489:         let _ = Command::new("umount")
490:             .arg(ext4)
491:             .output();
492:         output.map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("mksquashfs failed: {}", e)))?;
493:         Ok(())
494:     }
495:     async fn run_command_in_ch(
496:         &self,
497:         rootdisk: &Path,
498:         command: &str,
499:         vm_dir: &Path,
500:         cgroup_vm_id: Option<&str>,
501:     ) -> Result<(i32, Option<u32>), BuildError> {
502:         info!("Launching Cloud Hypervisor for build command: {}", command);
503:         let kernel_path = self.find_kernel_path()?;
504:         let initramfs_path = self.create_build_initramfs(command).await?;
505:         let socket_path = vm_dir.join("ch.sock");
506:         let ch_args = vec![
507:             "--kernel".to_string(),
508:             kernel_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
509:             "--initramfs".to_string(),
510:             initramfs_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
511:             "--disk".to_string(),
512:             format!("path={}", rootdisk.to_string_lossy()),
513:             "--console".to_string(),
514:             "off".to_string(),
515:             "--serial".to_string(),
516:             "tty".to_string(),
517:             "--api-socket".to_string(),
518:             socket_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
519:             "--cpus".to_string(),
520:             "1".to_string(),
521:             "--memory".to_string(),
522:             "size=512M".to_string(),
523:         ];
524:         let mut child = Command::new("cloud-hypervisor")
525:             .args(&ch_args)
526:             .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
527:             .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())
528:             .spawn()
529:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::VmError(format!("Failed to start cloud-hypervisor: {}", e)))?;
530:         let pid = child.id();
531:         if let Some(cgroup_id) = cgroup_vm_id {
532:             if let Some(ref cgroups) = self.cgroups {
533:                 let cgroup_id_only = cgroup_id.trim_start_matches("vyoma-build-");
534:                 if let Err(e) = cgroups.create_vm_cgroup(cgroup_id_only) {
535:                     warn!("Failed to create cgroup {}: {}", cgroup_id, e);
536:                 } else {
537:                     if let Err(e) = cgroups.set_cpu_limit(cgroup_id_only, 100) {
538:                         warn!("Failed to set CPU limit: {}", e);
539:                     }
540:                     if let Err(e) = cgroups.set_memory_limit(cgroup_id_only, 512 * 1024 * 1024) {
541:                         warn!("Failed to set memory limit: {}", e);
542:                     }
543:                     if let Err(e) = cgroups.add_process(cgroup_id_only, pid) {
544:                         warn!("Failed to add process to cgroup: {}", e);
545:                     }
546:                     info!("Added build VM {} to cgroup with PID {}", cgroup_id, pid);
547:                 }
548:             }
549:         }
550:         info!("Starting Cloud Hypervisor with rootdisk: {:?}", rootdisk);
551:         let timeout_duration = Duration::from_secs(300);
552:         let exit_status = timeout(timeout_duration, async {
553:             child.wait()
554:         }).await
555:         .map_err(|_| BuildError::VmError("VM execution timed out".to_string()))?
556:         .map_err(|e| BuildError::VmError(format!("VM process error: {}", e)))?;
557:         let code = exit_status.code().unwrap_or(1);
558:         info!("Build VM exited with code: {}", code);
559:         Ok((code, Some(pid)))
560:     }
561:     async fn execute_in_vm(&self, command: &str) -> Result<i32, BuildError> {
562:         info!("Launching Cloud Hypervisor VM to execute: {}", command);
563:         // Create build-specific initramfs
564:         let initramfs_path = self.create_build_initramfs(command).await?;
565:         // Find kernel path (assume default for now)
566:         let kernel_path = self.find_kernel_path()?;
567:         // Create temporary VM directory
568:         let vm_id = format!("build-{}", std::process::id());
569:         let vm_dir = self.temp_dir.join(&vm_id);
570:         std::fs::create_dir_all(&vm_dir)?;
571:         // Build Cloud Hypervisor configuration
572:         let socket_path = vm_dir.join("ch.sock");
573:         let rootfs_path = self.temp_dir.join("temp_root.sqfs"); // Placeholder rootfs
574:         let ch_args = self.build_ch_args(&rootfs_path, &kernel_path, &initramfs_path, &socket_path);
575:         // Launch Cloud Hypervisor
576:         info!("Starting Cloud Hypervisor with args: {:?}", ch_args);
577:         let mut child = Command::new("cloud-hypervisor")
578:             .args(&ch_args)
579:             .spawn()
580:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::VmError(format!("Failed to start Cloud Hypervisor: {}", e)))?;
581:         // Wait for VM to complete with timeout (using tokio::time::timeout with async block)
582:         let timeout_duration = Duration::from_secs(300); // 5 minute timeout for builds
583:         let exit_status_result = timeout(timeout_duration, async {
584:             child.wait()
585:         }).await;
586:         let exit_status = match exit_status_result {
587:             Ok(result) => result.map_err(|e| BuildError::VmError(format!("VM process error: {}", e)))?,
588:             Err(_) => {
589:                 // Timeout - kill the process
590:                 let _ = child.kill();
591:                 return Err(BuildError::VmError("VM execution timed out".to_string()));
592:             }
593:         };
594:         // Clean up
595:         let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&vm_dir);
596:         let exit_code = exit_status.code().unwrap_or(1);
597:         info!("VM execution completed with exit code: {}", exit_code);
598:         Ok(exit_code)
599:     }
600:     async fn create_build_initramfs(&self, command: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, BuildError> {
601:         let initramfs_path = self.temp_dir.join("build-initramfs.cpio.gz");
602:         // Generate build-specific init script
603:         let init_script = format!(r#"#!/bin/sh
604: # Build init script - runs command and exits
605: set -e
606: # Mount basic filesystems
607: mount -t proc proc /proc 2>/dev/null || true
608: mount -t sysfs sys /sys 2>/dev/null || true
609: mount -t devtmpfs dev /dev 2>/dev/null || true
610: # Mount the target root filesystem (which is the ext4 disk)
611: mkdir -p /mnt/root
612: mount -t ext4 /dev/vda /mnt/root
613: # Bind mount essential filesystems into the chroot
614: mount --bind /proc /mnt/root/proc 2>/dev/null || true
615: mount --bind /sys /mnt/root/sys 2>/dev/null || true
616: mount --bind /dev /mnt/root/dev 2>/dev/null || true
617: # Execute the build command inside the chroot
618: echo "Build VM: Executing command: {}"
619: chroot /mnt/root /bin/sh -c "{}"
620: # Capture exit code
621: exit_code=$?
622: echo "Build VM: Command completed with exit code: $exit_code"
623: # Unmount filesystems safely
624: umount /mnt/root/proc 2>/dev/null || true
625: umount /mnt/root/sys 2>/dev/null || true
626: umount /mnt/root/dev 2>/dev/null || true
627: umount /mnt/root 2>/dev/null || true
628: sync
629: # Power off (this will cause Cloud Hypervisor to exit)
630: poweroff -f
631: "#, command, command);
632:         let busybox_binary_usr = PathBuf::from("/usr/bin/busybox");
633:         let busybox_binary_lib = PathBuf::from("/var/lib/vyoma/bin/busybox");
634:         let busybox_path = if busybox_binary_lib.exists() {
635:             Some(&busybox_binary_lib as &Path)
636:         } else if busybox_binary_usr.exists() {
637:             Some(&busybox_binary_usr as &Path)
638:         } else {
639:             None
640:         };
641:         if busybox_path.is_none() {
642:             warn!("Busybox not found at expected locations. Build VM may fail to boot.");
643:         }
644:         vyoma_core::initramfs::create_initramfs(&init_script, None, busybox_path, &initramfs_path)
645:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::VmError(format!("Failed to create build initramfs: {}", e)))?;
646:         info!("Created build initramfs at: {:?}", initramfs_path);
647:         Ok(initramfs_path)
648:     }
649:     fn find_kernel_path(&self) -> Result<PathBuf, BuildError> {
650:         // self.temp_dir is passed as data_dir
651:         let local_kernel_direct = self.temp_dir.join("bin").join("vmlinux");
652:         if local_kernel_direct.exists() {
653:             return Ok(local_kernel_direct);
654:         }
655:         // Also check if temp_dir is nested under temp/build-xxx
656:         if let Some(temp_dir_parent) = self.temp_dir.parent() {
657:             if let Some(data_dir) = temp_dir_parent.parent() {
658:                 let local_kernel_nested = data_dir.join("bin").join("vmlinux");
659:                 if local_kernel_nested.exists() {
660:                     return Ok(local_kernel_nested);
661:                 }
662:             }
663:         }
664:         let kernel_path = PathBuf::from("/usr/lib/vyoma/vmlinux");
665:         if kernel_path.exists() {
666:             Ok(kernel_path)
667:         } else {
668:             Err(BuildError::VmError("Kernel not found at /usr/lib/vyoma/vmlinux or local bin".to_string()))
669:         }
670:     }

687:             "--serial".to_string(),
