699:     async fn handle_copy(&mut self, rootfs_path: &Path, context_dir: &Path, src: &str, dst: &str) -> Result<(), BuildError> {
700:         info!("Injecting file {} -> {} using debugfs", src, dst);
701:         // For squashfs, we can't modify it directly. Instead, we need to:
702:         // 1. Extract the current squashfs to a temporary directory
703:         // 2. Copy the file to the appropriate location
704:         // 3. Create a new squashfs with the updated contents
705:         let temp_extract_dir = tempfile::tempdir()
706:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::InjectionError(format!("Failed to create temp dir: {}", e)))?;
707:         let extract_path = temp_extract_dir.path();
708:         // Extract the current squashfs
709:         self.extract_squashfs(rootfs_path, extract_path).await?;
710:         // Copy the source file to destination
711:         let src_path = context_dir.join(src);
712:         if !src_path.exists() {
713:             return Err(BuildError::InjectionError(
714:                 format!("Source path {} does not exist", src)
715:             ));
716:         }
717:         let dst_path = extract_path.join(dst.trim_start_matches('/'));
718:         if let Some(parent) = dst_path.parent() {
719:             std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)
720:                 .map_err(|e| BuildError::InjectionError(format!("Failed to create dest dir: {}", e)))?;
721:         }
722:         std::fs::copy(&src_path, &dst_path)
723:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::InjectionError(format!("Failed to copy file: {}", e)))?;
724:         // Create new squashfs with the injected file
725:         let new_squashfs_name = format!("layer_{}_injected.sqfs", chrono::Utc::now().timestamp());
726:         let new_squashfs_path = self.temp_dir.join(&new_squashfs_name);
727:         VmifConverter::create_squashfs(
728:             extract_path,
729:             &new_squashfs_path,
730:             vyoma_image::SquashfsCompression::default(),
731:         ).map_err(|e| BuildError::InjectionError(format!("Failed to create new squashfs: {}", e)))?;
732:         // Replace the original rootfs with the new one
733:         std::fs::copy(&new_squashfs_path, rootfs_path)
734:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::InjectionError(format!("Failed to update rootfs: {}", e)))?;
735:         info!("Successfully injected {} -> {}", src, dst);
736:         Ok(())
737:     }
738:     async fn extract_squashfs(&self, squashfs_path: &Path, dest_dir: &Path) -> Result<(), BuildError> {
739:         info!("Extracting squashfs: {:?} -> {:?}", squashfs_path, dest_dir);
740:         // Create destination directory
741:         std::fs::create_dir_all(dest_dir)
742:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::InjectionError(format!("Failed to create extract dir: {}", e)))?;
743:         // Use unsquashfs to extract the squashfs file
744:         let output = Command::new("unsquashfs")
745:             .args(&[
746:                 "-f", // force overwrite
747:                 "-d", // destination directory
748:                 &dest_dir.to_string_lossy(),
749:                 &squashfs_path.to_string_lossy(),
750:             ])
751:             .output()
752:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::InjectionError(format!("Failed to run unsquashfs: {}", e)))?;
753:         if !output.status.success() {
754:             let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
755:             return Err(BuildError::InjectionError(format!("unsquashfs failed: {}", stderr)));
756:         }
757:         info!("Successfully extracted squashfs to: {:?}", dest_dir);
758:         Ok(())
759:     }
760:     async fn finalize_image(
761:         &self,
762:         rootfs_path: &Path,
763:         image_name: &str,
764:         config: &OciImageConfig,
765:     ) -> Result<BuildResult, BuildError> {
766:         info!("Finalizing image {}", image_name);
767:         // Create output directory
768:         let output_dir = self.work_dir.join("builds").join(image_name.replace('/', "_").replace(':', "_"));
769:         std::fs::create_dir_all(&output_dir)?;
770:         // Copy the final rootfs
771:         let final_rootfs = output_dir.join("rootfs.sqfs");
772:         std::fs::copy(rootfs_path, &final_rootfs)?;
773:         // Create manifest
774:         let converter = VmifConverter::new();
775:         let manifest_path = output_dir.join("vyoma.toml");
776:         // Convert config types
777:         let image_config = vyoma_image::OciImageConfig {
778:             entrypoint: config.entrypoint.clone(),
779:             cmd: config.cmd.clone(),
780:             env: config.env.clone(),
781:             working_dir: config.working_dir.clone(),
782:             exposed_ports: config.exposed_ports.clone(),
783:             user: config.user.clone(),
784:         };
785:         // Compute actual hash of the rootfs
786:         let hash = VmifConverter::compute_squashfs_hash(&final_rootfs)
787:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to compute hash: {}", e)))?;
788:         // If measured build, pre-compute PCRs via ephemeral VM
789:         let mut pcr_policy: Option<HashMap<u32, String>> = None;
790:         if self.measured {
791:             info!("Measured build requested - pre-computing PCR values");
792:             let pcrs = self.measure_boot_pcr(&final_rootfs).await?;
793:             pcr_policy = Some(pcrs);
794:             info!("PCR pre-computation complete: {:?}", pcr_policy);
795:         }
796:         let mut manifest = vyoma_image::VmifManifest::new(
797:             "amd64".to_string(),
798:             None,
799:             None,
800:             format!("sha256:{}", hash),
801:             image_config,
802:             std::fs::metadata(&final_rootfs)?.len(),
803:         );
804:         // Set measured boot PCR policy if measured build
805:         if let Some(ref pcrs) = pcr_policy {
806:             manifest.measured_boot.pcr_policy = Some(pcrs.clone());
807:         }
808:         let content = toml::to_string_pretty(&manifest)
809:             .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(e.to_string()))?;
810:         std::fs::write(&manifest_path, content)?;
811:         // Sign the manifest if a signing key is available
812:         let signing_key = self.resolve_signing_key().await?;
813:         let manifest_signed = if let Some(ref keypair) = signing_key {
814:             info!("Signing manifest with build key");
815:             let signed = keypair.sign_manifest(&manifest)
816:                 .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to sign manifest: {}", e)))?;
817:             let sig_path = output_dir.join("vyoma.toml.sig");
818:             signed.save_to_file(&sig_path)
819:                 .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to save signed manifest: {}", e)))?;
820:             info!("Signed manifest saved to {:?}", sig_path);
821:             true
822:         } else {
823:             if self.measured {
824:                 warn!("Measured build requested but no signing key available - manifest will be unsigned");
825:             }
826:             false
827:         };
828:         Ok(BuildResult {
829:             image_name: image_name.to_string(),
830:             rootfs_path: final_rootfs,
831:             manifest_path,
832:             config: config.clone(),
833:             pcr_policy,
834:             manifest_signed,
835:         })
836:     }
837:     /// Resolve the signing key from the configured path or generate a new one.
838:     async fn resolve_signing_key(&self) -> Result<Option<SigningKeyPair>, BuildError> {
839:         // 1. Check if a signing key path was explicitly provided
840:         if let Some(ref key_path) = self.signing_key_path {
841:             let path = Path::new(key_path);
842:             if path.exists() {
843:                 info!("Loading signing key from: {:?}", path);
844:                 let secret_path = path.join("build_signing_key");
845:                 let public_path = path.join("build_signing_key.pub");
846:                 if secret_path.exists() && public_path.exists() {
847:                     let seed = std::fs::read(&secret_path)
848:                         .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to read signing key: {}", e)))?;
849:                     let public = std::fs::read(&public_path)
850:                         .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to read public key: {}", e)))?;
851:                     let keypair = SigningKeyPair::from_seed_and_public(&seed, &public)
852:                         .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to load signing key: {}", e)))?;
853:                     return Ok(Some(keypair));
854:                 }
855:             } else {
856:                 // Create directory and generate new key pair
857:                 std::fs::create_dir_all(path)
858:                     .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to create key dir: {}", e)))?;
859:                 let keypair = SigningKeyPair::generate();
860:                 let (seed, public) = keypair.to_seed_and_public();
861:                 // Save public key
862:                 let public_path = path.join("build_signing_key.pub");
863:                 std::fs::write(&public_path, &public)
864:                     .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to save public key: {}", e)))?;
865:                 // Save seed (private key material)
866:                 let secret_path = path.join("build_signing_key");
867:                 std::fs::write(&secret_path, &seed)
868:                     .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to save signing key: {}", e)))?;
869:                 // Set restrictive permissions
870:                 #[cfg(unix)]
871:                 {
872:                     use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
873:                     std::fs::set_permissions(&secret_path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))
874:                         .ok();
875:                 }
876:                 info!("Generated new build signing key at {:?}", path);
877:                 return Ok(Some(keypair));
878:             }
879:         }
880:         // 2. Check standard location in work_dir
881:         let standard_path = self.work_dir.join("build_signing_key");
882:         if standard_path.exists() {
883:             let public_path = self.work_dir.join("build_signing_key.pub");
884:             if public_path.exists() {
885:                 let seed = std::fs::read(&standard_path)
886:                     .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to read signing key: {}", e)))?;
887:                 let public = std::fs::read(&public_path)
888:                     .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to read public key: {}", e)))?;
889:                 let keypair = SigningKeyPair::from_seed_and_public(&seed, &public)
890:                     .map_err(|e| BuildError::ExecutionError(format!("Failed to load signing key: {}", e)))?;
891:                 return Ok(Some(keypair));
892:             }
893:         }
894:         Ok(None)
895:     }
896: }
897: impl Default for BuildRunner {
898:     fn default() -> Self {
899:         Self::new(PathBuf::from("/tmp/vyoma-build"))
900:     }
901: }

149:             dm_name: self.dm_name.clone(),
150:             loop_devices: self.loop_devices.clone(),

161:             mem_size_mib: self.mem_size_mib,
162:             networks: self.networks.clone(),
163:             status: self.status.clone(),
164:         };
165:         let home = dirs::home_dir().ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("No home dir"))?;
166:         let vm_dir = home.join(".vyoma").join("vms").join(&self.id);
167:         if !vm_dir.exists() {
168:             std::fs::create_dir_all(&vm_dir)?;
169:         }

171:         let f = std::fs::File::create(state_path)?;
172:         serde_json::to_writer_pretty(f, &state)?;
173:         Ok(())
174:     }
175:     pub async fn cleanup(&mut self, cni_manager: &vyoma_core::cni::CniManager) {
176:         info!("Cleaning up VM resources for {}", self.id);
177:         // 1. Kill VMM
178:         if let Err(e) = self.vmm.kill() {
179:             error!("Failed to kill VMM: {}", e);
180:         }
181:         // 2. Remove Network Interface / CNI (handle multiple networks)
182:         if let Some(netns) = &self.netns_path {
183:             // Use del_multiple for cleanup with all attached networks
184:             if !self.networks.is_empty() {
185:                 if let Err(e) = cni_manager.del_multiple(&self.networks, &self.id, netns) {
186:                     error!("CNI DEL failed for multiple networks: {}", e);
187:                 }
188:             } else {
189:                 // Fallback to single interface cleanup
190:                 if let Err(e) = cni_manager.del(None, &self.id, netns, "eth0") {
191:                     error!("CNI DEL failed: {}", e);
192:                 }
193:             }
194:             let netns_name = format!("vm-{}", self.id);
195:             let _ = Command::new("ip")
196:                 .args(&["netns", "delete", &netns_name])
197:                 .output();
198:         }
199:         if !self.tap_name.is_empty() {
200:             if let Err(e) = NetworkManager::remove_interface(&self.tap_name).await {
201:                 error!("Failed to remove TAP {}: {}", self.tap_name, e);
202:             }
203:         }
204:         // 3. Remove DM Device
205:         if let Err(e) = (|| -> Result<(), vyoma_storage::StorageError> {
206:             let dm_manager = vyoma_storage::DmManager::new()?;
207:             dm_manager.remove_snapshot(&self.dm_name)
208:         })() {
209:             error!("Failed to remove DM {}: {}", self.dm_name, e);
210:         }
211:         // 4. Detach Loop Devices
212:         for dev in &self.loop_devices {
213:             if let Err(e) = StorageManager::detach_loop_device(dev) {
214:                 error!("Failed to detach loop {}: {}", dev, e);
215:             }
216:         }
217:         // 5. Remove COW file
218:         if std::path::Path::new(&self.cow_file_path).exists() {
219:             let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&self.cow_file_path);
220:         }
221:         // 6. Abort Proxy Tasks
222:         for task in &self.proxy_tasks {
223:             task.abort();
224:         }
225:         // 7. Remove Cgroup
226:         if let Some(_path) = &self.cgroup_path {
227:             let cm = CgroupManager::new();
228:             if let Err(e) = cm.remove_vm_cgroup(&self.id) {
229:                 error!("Failed to remove cgroup for {}: {}", self.id, e);
230:             }
231:         }
232:         // 8. Kill VirtioFs Managers (ADR-025)
233:         for fs_mgr in &mut self.fs_managers {
234:             if let Err(e) = fs_mgr.kill() {
235:                 error!("Failed to kill virtiofsd: {}", e);
236:             }
237:         }
238:         // 8b. Abort attestation task before stopping vTPM to prevent use-after-free
239:         if let Some(ref handle) = self.attestation_task {
240:             handle.abort();
241:             info!("Aborted attestation task for VM {}", self.id);
242:         }
243:         // 9. Stop vTPM if present
244:         if let Some(ref mut vtpm) = self.vtpm_manager {
245:             if let Err(e) = vtpm.stop() {
246:                 error!("Failed to stop vTPM: {}", e);
247:             }
248:         }
249:         // 9. Remove VM Directory
250:         if let Some(home) = dirs::home_dir() {
251:             let vm_dir = home.join(".vyoma").join("vms").join(&self.id);
252:             if vm_dir.exists() {
253:                 if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&vm_dir) {
254:                     error!("Failed to remove VM directory {}: {}", vm_dir.display(), e);
255:                 } else {
256:                     info!("Removed VM directory: {}", vm_dir.display());
257:                 }
258:             }
259:         }
260:     }
261: }

11: pub struct Assets;

13: fn inject_meta(html: String, token: Option<&String>, version: &str) -> String {
14:     let mut tags = format!(
15:         r#"<meta name="vyoma-daemon-version" content="{}">"#,
16:         version
17:     );
18:     if let Some(t) = token {
19:         tags.push_str(&format!(
20:             r#"<meta name="vyoma-api-token" content="{}">"#,
21:             t
22:         ));
23:     }
24:     html.replace("</head>", &format!("{}</head>", tags))
25: }
26: pub async fn ui_handler(
27:     State(state): State<AppState>,
28:     uri: Uri,
29: ) -> impl IntoResponse {
30:     let path = uri.path().trim_start_matches('/');
31:     let path = if path.is_empty() { "index.html" } else { path };
32:     let is_html = path.ends_with(".html") || path == "index.html";
33:     match Assets::get(path) {
34:         Some(content) => {
35:             let mime = mime_guess::from_path(path).first_or_octet_stream();
36:             let body = if is_html {
37:                 let html = String::from_utf8_lossy(&content.data.to_vec()).into_owned();
38:                 let modified = inject_meta(html, state.api_token.as_ref(), VERSION);
39:                 Body::from(modified)
40:             } else {
41:                 Body::from(content.data.to_vec())
42:             };
43:             Response::builder()
44:                 .header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, mime.as_ref())
45:                 .body(body)
46:                 .unwrap()
47:         }
48:         None => {
49:             // If explicit file extension request failed, 404.
50:             if path.contains('.') {
51:                 return (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "404 Not Found").into_response();
52:             }
53:             // Otherwise fallback to index.html (SPA)
54:              match Assets::get("index.html") {
55:                 Some(content) => {
56:                     let html = String::from_utf8_lossy(&content.data.to_vec()).into_owned();
57:                     let modified = inject_meta(html, state.api_token.as_ref(), VERSION);
58:                     let body = Body::from(modified);
59:                     Response::builder()
60:                         .header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/html")
61:                         .body(body)
62:                         .unwrap()
63:                 },
64:                 None => (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "index.html missing").into_response(),
65:             }
66:         }
67:     }
68: }

  1: use crate::types::{HealthcheckType, ImageConfig};
  2: use anyhow::{Context, Result};
  3: use std::time::Duration;
  4: use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
  5: use tokio::net::TcpStream as TokioTcp;
  6: const DEFAULT_HEALTHCHECK_RETRIES: u32 = 3;
  7: const RETRY_DELAY_MS: u64 = 500;
  8: pub struct Healthchecker {
  9:     host_port: u16,
 10:     timeout: Duration,
 11:     retries: u32,
 12: }
 13: impl Healthchecker {
 14:     pub fn new(host_port: u16, timeout: Duration) -> Self {
 15:         Self {
 16:             host_port,
 17:             timeout,
 18:             retries: DEFAULT_HEALTHCHECK_RETRIES,
 19:         }
 20:     }
 21:     pub fn with_retries(host_port: u16, timeout: Duration, retries: u32) -> Self {
 22:         Self {
 23:             host_port,
 24:             timeout,
 25:             retries,
 26:         }
 27:     }
 28:     pub async fn check(&self, config: &ImageConfig) -> Result<HealthResult> {
 29:         match config.healthcheck_type {
 30:             HealthcheckType::Tcp => self.check_with_retry(|| self.check_tcp()).await,
 31:             HealthcheckType::Http => {
 32:                 let path = config.healthcheck_path.as_deref().unwrap_or("/");
 33:                 let expected = config.expected_status.clone().unwrap_or(vec![200, 204]);
 34:                 self.check_with_retry(|| self.check_http(path, &expected)).await
 35:             }
 36:             HealthcheckType::Redis => self.check_with_retry(|| self.check_redis()).await,
 37:             HealthcheckType::Postgres => self.check_with_retry(|| self.check_postgres(config)).await,
 38:             HealthcheckType::Exec => Ok(HealthResult::skipped("Exec healthcheck requires agent access")),
 39:             HealthcheckType::Generic => Ok(HealthResult::skipped("Generic healthcheck requires agent access")),
 40:         }
 41:     }
 42:     async fn check_with_retry<F, Fut>(&self, mut check_fn: F) -> Result<HealthResult>
 43:     where
 44:         F: FnMut() -> Fut,
 45:         Fut: std::future::Future<Output = Result<HealthResult>>,
 46:     {
 47:         let mut last_result: Option<HealthResult> = None;
 48:         for attempt in 1..=self.retries {
 49:             match check_fn().await {
 50:                 Ok(result) if result.healthy || result.skipped => {
 51:                     return Ok(result);
 52:                 }
 53:                 Ok(result) => {
 54:                     last_result = Some(result);
 55:                     if attempt < self.retries {
 56:                         tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(RETRY_DELAY_MS)).await;
 57:                     }
 58:                 }
 59:                 Err(e) => {
 60:                     last_result = Some(HealthResult::unhealthy(
 61:                         0,
 62:                         format!("Healthcheck error: {}", e),
 63:                     ));
 64:                     if attempt < self.retries {
 65:                         tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(RETRY_DELAY_MS)).await;
 66:                     }
 67:                 }
 68:             }
 69:         }
 70:         Ok(last_result.unwrap_or_else(|| {
 71:             HealthResult::unhealthy(0, "All healthcheck retries exhausted".to_string())
 72:         }))
 73:     }
 74:     async fn check_tcp(&self) -> Result<HealthResult> {
 75:         let start = std::time::Instant::now();
 76:         let addr = format!("127.0.0.1:{}", self.host_port);
 77:         let result = tokio::time::timeout(self.timeout, TokioTcp::connect(&addr)).await;
 78:         match result {
 79:             Ok(Ok(_stream)) => {
 80:                 let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
 81:                 Ok(HealthResult::healthy(duration, format!("TCP connected to port {}", self.host_port)))
 82:             }
 83:             Ok(Err(e)) => {
 84:                 let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
 85:                 Ok(HealthResult::unhealthy(duration, format!("Connection failed: {}", e)))
 86:             }
 87:             Err(_) => {
 88:                 let duration = self.timeout.as_millis() as u64;
 89:                 Ok(HealthResult::timeout(duration))
 90:             }
 91:         }
 92:     }
 93:     async fn check_http(&self, path: &str, expected_status: &[u16]) -> Result<HealthResult> {
 94:         let start = std::time::Instant::now();
 95:         let url = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}{}", self.host_port, path);
 96:         let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
 97:             .timeout(self.timeout)
 98:             .danger_accept_invalid_certs(true)
 99:             .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
100:             .connect_timeout(self.timeout)
101:             .build()
102:             .context("Failed to create HTTP client")?;
103:         match client.get(&url).send().await {
104:             Ok(response) => {
105:                 let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
106:                 let status = response.status().as_u16();
107:                 let msg = format!("HTTP {} from {}", status, url);
108:                 if expected_status.contains(&status) {
109:                     Ok(HealthResult::healthy(duration, msg))
110:                 } else {
111:                     let detail = format!("Unexpected status (expected {:?})", expected_status);
112:                     Ok(HealthResult::unhealthy(duration, detail))
113:                 }
114:             }
115:             Err(e) => {
116:                 let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
117:                 if e.is_timeout() {
118:                     Ok(HealthResult::timeout(duration))
119:                 } else if e.is_connect() {
120:                     Ok(HealthResult::unhealthy(duration, format!("Connection refused: {}", e)))
121:                 } else {
122:                     Ok(HealthResult::unhealthy(duration, format!("HTTP request failed: {}", e)))
123:                 }
124:             }
125:         }
126:     }
127:     async fn check_redis(&self) -> Result<HealthResult> {
128:         let start = std::time::Instant::now();
129:         let addr = format!("127.0.0.1:{}", self.host_port);
130:         let result = tokio::time::timeout(self.timeout, async {
131:             let mut stream = TokioTcp::connect(&addr).await?;
132:             stream.write_all(b"PING\r\n").await?;
133:             let mut buf = [0u8; 128];
134:             let n = stream.read(&mut buf).await?;
135:             Ok::<_, std::io::Error>(buf[..n].to_vec())
136:         }).await;
137:         match result {
138:             Ok(Ok(response)) => {
139:                 let response_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(&response);
140:                 if response_str.contains("PONG") || response_str.starts_with("+") {
141:                     let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
142:                     Ok(HealthResult::healthy(duration, "Redis PONG received".to_string()))
143:                 } else {
144:                     let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
145:                     let msg = format!("Unexpected Redis response: {}", response_str);
146:                     Ok(HealthResult::unhealthy(duration, msg))
147:                 }
148:             }
149:             Ok(Err(e)) => {
150:                 let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
151:                 Ok(HealthResult::unhealthy(duration, format!("Redis connection failed: {}", e)))
152:             }
153:             Err(_) => {
154:                 let duration = self.timeout.as_millis() as u64;
155:                 Ok(HealthResult::timeout(duration))
156:             }
157:         }
158:     }
159:     async fn check_postgres(&self, config: &ImageConfig) -> Result<HealthResult> {
160:         let cmd = config
161:             .healthcheck_cmd
162:             .as_ref()
163:             .map(|c| c.join(" "))
164:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "pg_isready -U postgres".to_string());
165:         let start = std::time::Instant::now();
166:         let tcp_check = tokio::time::timeout(
167:             Duration::from_secs(5),
168:             TokioTcp::connect(format!("127.0.0.1:{}", self.host_port)),
169:         ).await;
170:         if tcp_check.is_err() {
171:             let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
172:             return Ok(HealthResult::unhealthy(
173:                 duration,
174:                 format!("PostgreSQL port {} not reachable", self.host_port),
175:             ));
176:         }
177:         if tcp_check.ok().map(|r| r.is_err()).unwrap_or(true) {
178:             let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
179:             return Ok(HealthResult::unhealthy(
180:                 duration,
181:                 "PostgreSQL not accepting connections".to_string(),
182:             ));
183:         }
184:         let check_cmd = format!("{} || true", cmd);
185:         let output = tokio::process::Command::new("sh")
186:             .arg("-c")
187:             .arg(&check_cmd)
188:             .output()
189:             .await
190:             .context("Failed to run postgres healthcheck")?;
191:         let duration = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
192:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
193:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
194:         let output_combined = if stdout.is_empty() { stderr } else { stdout };
195:         if output.status.success()
196:             || output_combined.contains("accepting")
197:             || output_combined.contains("up")
198:             || output_combined.trim() == "ok"
199:         {
200:             Ok(HealthResult::healthy(duration, format!("PostgreSQL ready: {}", output_combined.trim())))
201:         } else {
202:             Ok(HealthResult::unhealthy(duration, format!("PostgreSQL not ready: {}", output_combined.trim())))
203:         }
204:     }
205: }
206: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
207: pub struct HealthResult {
208:     pub healthy: bool,
209:     pub skipped: bool,
210:     pub duration_ms: u64,
211:     pub message: String,
212: }
213: impl HealthResult {
214:     pub fn healthy(duration_ms: u64, message: String) -> Self {
215:         Self {
216:             healthy: true,
217:             skipped: false,
218:             duration_ms,
219:             message,
220:         }
221:     }
222:     pub fn unhealthy(duration_ms: u64, message: String) -> Self {
223:         Self {
224:             healthy: false,
225:             skipped: false,
226:             duration_ms,
227:             message,
228:         }
229:     }
230:     pub fn timeout(duration_ms: u64) -> Self {
231:         Self {
232:             healthy: false,
233:             skipped: false,
234:             duration_ms,
235:             message: format!("Healthcheck timed out after {}ms", duration_ms),
236:         }
237:     }
238:     pub fn skipped(message: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
239:         Self {
240:             healthy: true,
241:             skipped: true,
242:             duration_ms: 0,
243:             message: message.into(),
244:         }
245:     }

30: SNAP_OUTPUT=$($VYOMA snapshot "$VM_ID" 2>&1)
31: echo "$SNAP_OUTPUT"
32: assert_success "Snapshot created"
33: SNAP_ID=$(echo "$SNAP_OUTPUT" | grep -oP 'snap-[a-f0-9]+' | head -1)
34: if [ -z "$SNAP_ID" ]; then
35:     SNAP_ID="snap-0"
36: fi
37: echo "Snapshot ID: $SNAP_ID"
38: echo "Listing history..."
39: $VYOMA history "$VM_ID"
40: echo "Deleting VM and restoring from snapshot..."
41: $VYOMA stop "$VM_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
42: unregister_vm "$VM_ID"
43: sleep 1
44: echo "Time-travel to snapshot..."
45: RESTORE_OUTPUT=$($VYOMA time-travel "$VM_ID" --to "$SNAP_ID" 2>&1)
46: echo "$RESTORE_OUTPUT"
47: assert_success "Time-travel restore"
48: sleep 2
49: echo "Verify VM is running after restore..."
50: VM_AFTER=$($VYOMA ps | grep "snap-vm" | awk '{print $1}')
51: if [ -n "$VM_AFTER" ]; then
52:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: VM restored from snapshot${NC}"
53:     register_vm "$VM_AFTER"
54: else
55:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: VM not found after restore${NC}"
56:     exit 1
57: fi
58: echo "Cleaning up..."
59: $VYOMA stop "$VM_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
60: cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
61: echo "=== Test 08 Passed ==="

File: tests/e2e/11_attestation.sh
================
 1: #!/bin/bash
 2: set -e
 3: source tests/e2e/common.sh
 4: trap "cat $TEST_HOME/daemon.log" EXIT
 5: echo "=== Test 11: Attestation / Measured Boot ==="
 6: check_root
 7: setup_env
 8: echo "Starting Daemon (3011)..."
 9: sudo -E $VYOMAD_BIN --data-dir $TEST_HOME/.vyoma --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3011 > $TEST_HOME/daemon.log 2>&1 &
10: DAEMON_PID=$!
11: sleep 3
12: VYOMA="$VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3011"
13: KEY_DIR="$TEST_HOME/keys"
14: mkdir -p "$KEY_DIR"
15: echo "Generating signing keys for measured boot..."
16: openssl genrsa -out "$KEY_DIR/sign_key.pem" 2048 2>/dev/null
17: openssl rsa -in "$KEY_DIR/sign_key.pem" -pubout -out "$KEY_DIR/sign_key.pub" 2>/dev/null
18: echo "Testing measured boot flow..."
19: echo "1. Build image with --measured flag..."
20: $VYOMA pull alpine:latest 2>/dev/null || true
21: CTX=$TEST_HOME/measured_ctx
22: mkdir -p $CTX
23: cat <<EOF > $CTX/Vyomafile
24: FROM alpine:latest
25: RUN echo "Measured boot test image" > /measured.txt
26: CMD ["sleep", "300"]
27: EOF
28: echo "Building measured image..."
29: BUILD_OUTPUT=$($VYOMA build --measured --signing-key "$KEY_DIR/sign_key.pub" $CTX 2>&1)
30: echo "$BUILD_OUTPUT"
31: if ! echo "$BUILD_OUTPUT" | grep -qi "measured\|build.*complete"; then
32:     echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: --measured flag may not be implemented yet${NC}"
33: fi
34: echo "2. Run VM and verify attestation..."
35: VM_OUTPUT=$($VYOMA run alpine:latest --hostname attest-vm --vcpu 1 --memory 128 --measured 2>&1)
36: VM_ID=$(echo "$VM_OUTPUT" | awk -F 'VM ID: ' '{print $2}' | awk '{print $1}' | tr -d ',')
37: if [ -z "$VM_ID" ]; then
38:     VM_ID=$($VYOMA ps | grep "attest-vm" | awk '{print $1}')
39: fi
40: echo "VM ID: $VM_ID"
41: if [ -z "$VM_ID" ]; then
42:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Could not start VM${NC}"
43:     exit 1
44: fi
45: register_vm "$VM_ID"
46: wait_for_vm_state "$VM_ID" "Running" 20
47: assert_success "VM started with measured boot"
48: sleep 2
49: echo "3. Check attestation status..."
50: ATTEST_STATUS=$($VYOMA inspect "$VM_ID" 2>&1 | grep -i "attestation\|measured\|attested" || echo "unknown")
51: echo "Attestation status: $ATTEST_STATUS"
52: if echo "$ATTEST_STATUS" | grep -qi "passed\|verified\|attested\|true"; then
53:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: Attestation verified${NC}"
54: elif echo "$ATTEST_STATUS" | grep -qi "unknown\|not.*found"; then
55:     echo -e "${YELLOW}Info: Attestation status not available (may need policy config)${NC}"
56: else
57:     echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: Could not verify attestation status${NC}"
58: fi
59: echo "4. Test manifest tampering detection (if supported)..."
60: TAMPERED_CTX=$TEST_HOME/tampered_ctx
61: mkdir -p $TAMPERED_CTX
62: cp -r $CTX/* $TAMPERED_CTX/
63: echo "modified-by-attacker" >> $TAMPERED_CTX/Vyomafile
64: if $VYOMA build --verify --signing-key "$KEY_DIR/sign_key.pub" $TAMPERED_CTX 2>&1 | grep -qi "fail\|invalid\|tamper"; then
65:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: Tampered manifest detected${NC}"
66: else
67:     echo -e "${YELLOW}Info: Tamper detection not implemented or not triggered${NC}"
68: fi
69: echo "5. Verify VM is still running (attestation should kill if failed)..."
70: sleep 1
71: CURRENT_STATE=$($VYOMA ps | grep "$VM_ID" | awk '{print $NF}' | tr -d '[]')
72: if [ "$CURRENT_STATE" = "Running" ]; then
73:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: VM still running (attestation passed or not enforced)${NC}"
74: else
75:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: VM not running - may have been killed due to failed attestation${NC}"
76: fi
77: echo "6. Test without measured flag (should work normally)..."
78: VM_OUTPUT2=$($VYOMA run alpine:latest --hostname normal-vm --vcpu 1 --memory 128 2>&1)
79: VM_ID2=$(echo "$VM_OUTPUT2" | awk -F 'VM ID: ' '{print $2}' | awk '{print $1}' | tr -d ',')
80: if [ -z "$VM_ID2" ]; then
81:     VM_ID2=$($VYOMA ps | grep "normal-vm" | awk '{print $1}')
82: fi
83: if [ -n "$VM_ID2" ]; then
84:     register_vm "$VM_ID2"
85:     wait_for_vm_state "$VM_ID2" "Running" 15
86:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: Normal VM runs without attestation${NC}"
87: fi
88: echo "Cleaning up..."
89: $VYOMA stop "$VM_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
90: $VYOMA stop "$VM_ID2" 2>/dev/null || true
91: unregister_vm "$VM_ID"
92: unregister_vm "$VM_ID2"
93: cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
94: echo "=== Test 11 Passed ==="

  1: #!/bin/bash
  2: set -e
  3: source tests/e2e/common.sh
  4: echo "=== Test 11: Migration / Teleport Automation ==="
  5: check_root
  6: setup_env
  7: SOURCE_PORT=3012
  8: TARGET_PORT=3013
  9: echo "Starting source daemon (port $SOURCE_PORT)..."
 10: sudo -E $VYOMAD_BIN --data-dir $TEST_HOME/.vyoma --socket-path /run/vyoma/source.sock --http-port $SOURCE_PORT > $TEST_HOME/source-daemon.log 2>&1 &
 11: SOURCE_PID=$!
 12: sleep 3
 13: echo "Starting target daemon (port $TARGET_PORT)..."
 14: sudo -E $VYOMAD_BIN --data-dir $TEST_HOME/.vyoma --socket-path /run/vyoma/target.sock --http-port $TARGET_PORT > $TEST_HOME/target-daemon.log 2>&1 &
 15: TARGET_PID=$!
 16: sleep 3
 17: VYOMA_SOURCE="$VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/source.sock --http-port $SOURCE_PORT"
 18: VYOMA_TARGET="$VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/target.sock --http-port $TARGET_PORT"
 19: echo "1. Pull test image..."
 20: $VYOMA_SOURCE pull alpine:latest 2>/dev/null || true
 21: $VYOMA_TARGET pull alpine:latest 2>/dev/null || true
 22: echo "2. Run VM on source node..."
 23: VM_OUTPUT=$($VYOMA_SOURCE run alpine:latest --hostname migrate-vm --vcpu 1 --memory 128 -- sleep 300 2>&1)
 24: VM_ID=$(echo "$VM_OUTPUT" | awk -F 'VM ID: ' '{print $2}' | awk '{print $1}' | tr -d ',')
 25: if [ -z "$VM_ID" ]; then
 26:     VM_ID=$($VYOMA_SOURCE ps | grep "migrate-vm" | awk '{print $1}')
 27: fi
 28: echo "Source VM ID: $VM_ID"
 29: if [ -z "$VM_ID" ]; then
 30:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Could not start VM on source${NC}"
 31:     exit 1
 32: fi
 33: register_vm "$VM_ID"
 34: wait_for_vm_state "$VM_ID" "Running" 15
 35: assert_success "VM started on source"
 36: sleep 3
 37: echo "3. Run migration (teleport) to target node..."
 38: MIGRATE_OUTPUT=$($VYOMA_SOURCE teleport "$VM_ID" --target-ip "127.0.0.1" --target-port $TARGET_PORT --bandwidth 100 2>&1)
 39: echo "$MIGRATE_OUTPUT"
 40: if echo "$MIGRATE_OUTPUT" | grep -qi "error\|fail\|could not"; then
 41:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Migration failed${NC}"
 42:     echo "$MIGRATE_OUTPUT"
 43:     exit 1
 44: fi
 45: MIGRATE_SUCCESS=0
 46: for i in {1..30}; do
 47:     sleep 2
 48:     echo "Checking migration status... ($i/30)"
 49:     if $VYOMA_TARGET ps 2>/dev/null | grep -q "migrate-vm"; then
 50:         echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: VM migrated to target${NC}"
 51:         MIGRATE_SUCCESS=1
 52:         break
 53:     fi
 54: done
 55: if [ $MIGRATE_SUCCESS -eq 0 ]; then
 56:     echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: Migration may have failed or not detected in ps${NC}"
 57:     echo "Checking source VM status..."
 58:     if $VYOMA_SOURCE ps | grep -q "migrate-vm"; then
 59:         echo "VM still on source - migration may have failed and resumed"
 60:     fi
 61: fi
 62: echo "4. Verify VM runs on target..."
 63: TARGET_VM=$($VYOMA_TARGET ps | grep "migrate-vm" | awk '{print $1}')
 64: if [ -n "$TARGET_VM" ]; then
 65:     register_vm "$TARGET_VM"
 66:     wait_for_vm_state_from_cli "$VYOMA_TARGET" "$TARGET_VM" "Running" 15
 67:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: VM running on target after migration${NC}"
 68: else
 69:     echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: Could not verify target VM state${NC}"
 70: fi
 71: echo "5. Test migration failure handling..."
 72: echo "Creating VM for failure test..."
 73: VM_FAIL_OUTPUT=$($VYOMA_SOURCE run alpine:latest --hostname migrate-fail --vcpu 1 --memory 128 -- sleep 300 2>&1)
 74: VM_FAIL_ID=$(echo "$VM_FAIL_OUTPUT" | awk -F 'VM ID: ' '{print $2}' | awk '{print $1}' | tr -d ',')
 75: if [ -z "$VM_FAIL_ID" ]; then
 76:     VM_FAIL_ID=$($VYOMA_SOURCE ps | grep "migrate-fail" | awk '{print $1}')
 77: fi
 78: if [ -n "$VM_FAIL_ID" ]; then
 79:     register_vm "$VM_FAIL_ID"
 80:     wait_for_vm_state "$VM_FAIL_ID" "Running" 15
 81:     echo "Attempting migration to unreachable target..."
 82:     $VYOMA_SOURCE teleport "$VM_FAIL_ID" --target-ip "192.168.255.254" --target-port 9999 2>&1 || true
 83:     sleep 5
 84:     echo "Checking if source VM preserved after failed migration..."
 85:     if $VYOMA_SOURCE ps | grep -q "migrate-fail"; then
 86:         echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: Source VM preserved after failed migration${NC}"
 87:     else
 88:         echo -e "${YELLOW}Info: Source VM not found after migration failure${NC}"
 89:     fi
 90:     $VYOMA_SOURCE stop "$VM_FAIL_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
 91:     unregister_vm "$VM_FAIL_ID"
 92: fi
 93: echo "6. Test migration progress status..."
 94: echo "Starting another migration to check status endpoint..."
 95: VM_STATUS_OUTPUT=$($VYOMA_SOURCE run alpine:latest --hostname migrate-status --vcpu 1 --memory 128 -- sleep 300 2>&1)
 96: VM_STATUS_ID=$(echo "$VM_STATUS_OUTPUT" | awk -F 'VM ID: ' '{print $2}' | awk '{print $1}' | tr -d ',')
 97: if [ -z "$VM_STATUS_ID" ]; then
 98:     VM_STATUS_ID=$($VYOMA_SOURCE ps | grep "migrate-status" | awk '{print $1}')
 99: fi
100: if [ -n "$VM_STATUS_ID" ]; then
101:     register_vm "$VM_STATUS_ID"
102:     wait_for_vm_state "$VM_STATUS_ID" "Running" 15
103:     MIGRATE_OUTPUT=$($VYOMA_SOURCE teleport "$VM_STATUS_ID" --target-ip "127.0.0.1" --target-port $TARGET_PORT --bandwidth 50 2>&1)
104:     echo "Migration started, checking status..."
105:     sleep 3
106:     if $VYOMA_SOURCE teleport status 2>/dev/null | grep -qi "progress\|completed\|failed\|pending"; then
107:         echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: Migration status endpoint functional${NC}"
108:     else
109:         echo -e "${YELLOW}Info: Could not verify status endpoint${NC}"
110:     fi
111:     $VYOMA_SOURCE stop "$VM_STATUS_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
112:     unregister_vm "$VM_STATUS_ID"
113: fi
114: echo "Cleaning up..."
115: $VYOMA_SOURCE stop "$VM_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
116: $VYOMA_TARGET stop "$VM_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
117: cleanup_env $SOURCE_PID
118: echo "=== Test 11 Passed ==="

 1: #!/bin/bash
 2: set -e
 3: SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
 4: source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/common.sh"
 5: echo "=== Test 13: VM Stats ==="
 6: # Setup environment
 7: check_root
 8: setup_env
 9: export RUST_LOG=info
10: echo "Starting Daemon..."
11: sudo -E $VYOMAD_BIN --data-dir $TEST_HOME/.vyoma --keep-root --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3002 > $TEST_HOME/daemon.log 2>&1 &
12: DAEMON_PID=$!
13: sleep 3
14: VYOMA="$VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3002"
15: echo "Pulling image..."
16: $VYOMA pull docker.io/library/nginx:alpine || {
17:     echo "Pull failed. Daemon log:"
18:     cat $TEST_HOME/daemon.log
19:     exit 1
20: }
21: echo "Running VM..."
22: VM_ID=$(vyoma_run_and_get_id docker.io/library/nginx:alpine --hostname stats-vm --memory 128)
23: echo "Starting busy loop inside the VM via exec..."
24: $VYOMA exec $VM_ID -- sh -c "while true; do true; done" &
25: EXEC_PID=$!
26: sleep 5
27: echo "Fetching VM stats..."
28: if [ -z "$VM_ID" ]; then
29:     echo "Failed to get VM ID"
30:     cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
31:     exit 1
32: fi
33: echo "Fetching VM stats (first time to prime the CPU measurement)..."
34: $VYOMA stats $VM_ID --no-stream > /dev/null || true
35: sleep 2
36: echo "Fetching VM stats (second time for actual measurement)..."
37: STATS_OUT=$($VYOMA stats $VM_ID --no-stream)
38: echo "$STATS_OUT"
39: if ! echo "$STATS_OUT" | grep -q "$VM_ID"; then
40:     echo "Stats output did not contain VM ID"
41:     cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
42:     exit 1
43: fi
44: # Assert CPU is non-zero (since it's a busy loop, it should definitely use CPU)
45: # Stats format: VM_ID     100.00%   1.00MiB / 128.00MiB   0.78%
46: CPU_PCT=$(echo "$STATS_OUT" | tail -n 1 | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '%')
47: if (( $(echo "$CPU_PCT == 0.00" | bc -l) )); then
48:     echo "CPU usage is 0.00%, expected > 0 for a busy loop"
49:     cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
50:     exit 1
51: fi
52: echo "Stats output looks correct."
53: echo "Cleaning up..."
54: $VYOMA stop $VM_ID
55: kill $EXEC_PID || true
56: cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
57: echo "=== Test 13 passed ==="

================
File: tests/smoke/install-and-run.sh
================
  1: #!/bin/bash
  2: set -e
  3: RED='\033[0;31m'
  4: GREEN='\033[0;32m'
  5: YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
  6: NC='\033[0m'
  7: LOG_FILE="/tmp/vyoma-smoke-test-$(date +%s).log"
  8: exec > >(tee -a "$LOG_FILE") 2>&1
  9: echo "=========================================="
 10: echo "Vyoma Smoke Test - Fresh Install"
 11: echo "=========================================="
 12: cleanup_on_exit() {
 13:     echo -e "${YELLOW}Cleaning up...${NC}"
 14:     if [ -n "$VM_ID" ]; then
 15:         sudo vyoma stop "$VM_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
 16:     fi
 17:     sudo pkill vyomad 2>/dev/null || true
 18:     sleep 2
 19:     echo "Checking for leftover resources..."
 20:     TAP_DEVICES=$(ip link 2>/dev/null | grep -c "tap" || true)
 21:     if [ "$TAP_DEVICES" -gt 0 ]; then
 22:         echo -e "${RED}Warning: Found $TAP_DEVICES leftover TAP devices${NC}"
 23:         ip link show | grep tap || true
 24:     fi
 25:     DM_DEVICES=$(sudo dmsetup ls 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)
 26:     if [ "$DM_DEVICES" -gt 2 ]; then
 27:         echo -e "${RED}Warning: Found leftover DM devices${NC}"
 28:         sudo dmsetup ls 2>/dev/null || true
 29:     fi
 30:     LOOP_DEVICES=$(losetup -a 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)
 31:     if [ "$LOOP_DEVICES" -gt 0 ]; then
 32:         echo -e "${RED}Warning: Found leftover loop devices${NC}"
 33:         losetup -a 2>/dev/null || true
 34:     fi
 35: }
 36: trap cleanup_on_exit EXIT
 37: if [ "$EUID" -ne 0 ]; then
 38:     echo -e "${RED}Error: This script must be run as root${NC}"
 39:     exit 1
 40: fi
 41: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 1: Building package...${NC}"
 42: cd /home/subesh/Startup_Projects/Vyoma/vyoma
 43: if [ ! -f "packaging/deb/build.sh" ]; then
 44:     echo -e "${RED}Error: Build script not found${NC}"
 45:     exit 1
 46: fi
 47: chmod +x packaging/deb/build.sh
 48: ./packaging/deb/build.sh
 49: if [ ! -d "dist" ]; then
 50:     echo -e "${RED}Error: dist directory not created${NC}"
 51:     exit 1
 52: fi
 53: DEB_FILE=$(ls dist/vyoma_*.deb 2>/dev/null | head -1)
 54: if [ -z "$DEB_FILE" ]; then
 55:     echo -e "${RED}Error: No .deb file found in dist/${NC}"
 56:     exit 1
 57: fi
 58: echo -e "${GREEN}Built: $DEB_FILE${NC}"
 59: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 2: Installing package...${NC}"
 60: dpkg -i "$DEB_FILE" || {
 61:     echo -e "${YELLOW}Fixing dependencies...${NC}"
 62:     apt-get -f install -y
 63:     dpkg -i "$DEB_FILE"
 64: }
 65: if ! command -v vyoma &> /dev/null; then
 66:     echo -e "${RED}Error: vyoma command not found after install${NC}"
 67:     exit 1
 68: fi
 69: if ! command -v vyomad &> /dev/null; then
 70:     echo -e "${RED}Error: vyomad command not found after install${NC}"
 71:     exit 1
 72: fi
 73: echo -e "${GREEN}Package installed successfully${NC}"
 74: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 3: Running vyoma doctor...${NC}"
 75: DOCTOR_OUTPUT=$(vyoma doctor 2>&1)
 76: echo "$DOCTOR_OUTPUT"
 77: if echo "$DOCTOR_OUTPUT" | grep -qi "failed\|error\|missing\|not found"; then
 78:     echo -e "${RED}Error: Doctor check failed${NC}"
 79:     exit 1
 80: fi
 81: if echo "$DOCTOR_OUTPUT" | grep -q "All checks passed\|Ready to use"; then
 82:     echo -e "${GREEN}Doctor check passed${NC}"
 83: else
 84:     DOCTOR_FAILED=0
 85:     if echo "$DOCTOR_OUTPUT" | grep -q "KVM"; then
 86:         echo -e "${RED}Error: KVM not available${NC}"
 87:         DOCTOR_FAILED=1
 88:     fi
 89:     if echo "$DOCTOR_OUTPUT" | grep -q "CNI"; then
 90:         echo -e "${RED}Error: CNI plugins missing${NC}"
 91:         DOCTOR_FAILED=1
 92:     fi
 93:     if [ "$DOCTOR_FAILED" -eq 1 ]; then
 94:         exit 1
 95:     fi
 96: fi
 97: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 4: Starting daemon...${NC}"
 98: sudo -b vyomad --http-port 8080 > /tmp/vyomad.log 2>&1
 99: sleep 3
100: if ! pgrep -x vyomad > /dev/null; then
101:     echo -e "${RED}Error: Daemon failed to start${NC}"
102:     cat /tmp/vyomad.log
103:     exit 1
104: fi
105: echo -e "${GREEN}Daemon started${NC}"
106: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 5: Running alpine:latest VM...${NC}"
107: VM_OUTPUT=$(vyoma run alpine:latest --vcpu 1 --memory 128 2>&1)
108: echo "$VM_OUTPUT"
109: VM_ID=$(echo "$VM_OUTPUT" | grep -oP 'VM ID: \K[a-f0-9]+' | head -1)
110: if [ -z "$VM_ID" ]; then
111:     VM_ID=$(vyoma ps 2>/dev/null | grep "alpine" | awk '{print $1}' | head -1)
112: fi
113: if [ -z "$VM_ID" ]; then
114:     echo -e "${RED}Error: Could not get VM ID${NC}"
115:     exit 1
116: fi
117: echo "VM ID: $VM_ID"
118: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 6: Verifying VM is running...${NC}"
119: sleep 3
120: VM_STATE=$(vyoma ps 2>/dev/null | grep "$VM_ID" | awk '{print $NF}' | tr -d '[]')
121: echo "VM State: $VM_STATE"
122: if [ "$VM_STATE" != "Running" ]; then
123:     echo -e "${RED}Error: VM not in Running state${NC}"
124:     vyoma logs "$VM_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
125:     exit 1
126: fi
127: echo -e "${GREEN}VM is running${NC}"
128: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 7: Stopping VM...${NC}"
129: vyoma stop "$VM_ID"
130: sleep 2
131: if vyoma ps 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$VM_ID"; then
132:     echo -e "${RED}Error: VM still in ps after stop${NC}"
133:     exit 1
134: fi
135: echo -e "${GREEN}VM stopped successfully${NC}"
136: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 8: Checking for leftover resources...${NC}"
137: TAP_COUNT=$(ip link 2>/dev/null | grep -c "tap" || echo "0")
138: if [ "$TAP_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
139:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Found $TAP_COUNT TAP devices${NC}"
140:     ip link show | grep tap
141:     exit 1
142: fi
143: echo -e "${GREEN}No leftover TAP devices${NC}"
144: DM_COUNT=$(sudo dmsetup ls 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
145: if [ "$DM_COUNT" -gt 2 ]; then
146:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Found DM devices${NC}"
147:     sudo dmsetup ls
148:     exit 1
149: fi
150: echo -e "${GREEN}No leftover DM devices${NC}"
151: LOOP_COUNT=$(losetup -a 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
152: if [ "$LOOP_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
153:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Found loop devices${NC}"
154:     losetup -a
155:     exit 1
156: fi
157: echo -e "${GREEN}No leftover loop devices${NC}"
158: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 9: Uninstalling package...${NC}"
159: dpkg -r vyoma || dpkg -r vyomad || true
160: if command -v vyoma &> /dev/null; then
161:     echo -e "${RED}Warning: vyoma still in path after uninstall${NC}"
162: fi
163: echo -e "${YELLOW}Step 10: Running complete cleanup script to reset system...${NC}"
164: SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
165: PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
166: if [ -f "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/cleanup-all.sh" ]; then
167:     echo "Calling cleanup-all.sh..."
168:     "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/cleanup-all.sh"
169:     echo -e "${GREEN}Cleanup script completed${NC}"
170: else
171:     echo -e "${YELLOW}Warning: cleanup-all.sh not found, skipping${NC}"
172: fi
173: echo -e "${GREEN}Smoke test passed!${NC}"
174: echo "=========================================="
175: echo "Log file: $LOG_FILE"
176: echo "=========================================="
177: exit 0

File: ui/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx
================
 1: import { Component } from 'react';
 2: import type { ReactNode, ErrorInfo } from 'react';
 3: import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCcw } from 'lucide-react';
 4: import { Button } from './ui';
 5: interface Props {
 6:   children: ReactNode;
 7: }
 8: interface State {
 9:   hasError: boolean;
10:   error: Error | null;
11: }
12: export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
13:   public state: State = {
14:     hasError: false,
15:     error: null,
16:   };
17:   public static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
18:     return { hasError: true, error };
19:   }
20:   public componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
21:     console.error('Uncaught error:', error, errorInfo);
22:   }
23:   private handleReset = () => {
24:     this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null });
25:   };
26:   public render() {
27:     if (this.state.hasError) {
28:       return (
29:         <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] p-8 text-center bg-background">
30:           <AlertTriangle size={64} className="text-destructive mb-6" />
31:           <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mb-2">Something went wrong</h2>
32:           <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-8 max-w-md">
33:             {this.state.error?.message || 'An unexpected error occurred in the application.'}
34:           </p>
35:           <Button onClick={this.handleReset}>
36:             <RefreshCcw size={16} className="mr-2" /> Try Again
37:           </Button>
38:         </div>
39:       );
40:     }
41:     return this.props.children;
42:   }
43: }

  7: export function AttestationPage() {

  9:   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
 10:   const [selectedResult, setSelectedResult] = useState<any>(null);
 11:   const attestMutation = useMutation({

 13:     onSuccess: () => {

 15:     }
 16:   });
 17:   return (
 18:     <div className="p-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
 19:       <header className="mb-8">

 21:           <ShieldCheck className="text-primary" /> Attestation
 22:         </h2>
 23:         <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Verify the integrity of running MicroVMs via hardware root of trust.</p>
 24:       </header>
 25:       <Card>
 26:         <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4 border-b border-border text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase bg-card">
 27:           <div className="col-span-3">VM Name</div>
 28:           <div className="col-span-3">Image</div>
 29:           <div className="col-span-3">Status</div>
 30:           <div className="col-span-3 text-right">Actions</div>
 31:         </div>
 32:         <div className="divide-y divide-border/50 bg-card">
 33:           {isLoading ? (
 34:             Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
 35:               <div key={i} className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4 items-center">
 36:                 <div className="col-span-3"><Skeleton className="h-4 w-32" /></div>
 37:                 <div className="col-span-3"><Skeleton className="h-4 w-20" /></div>
 38:                 <div className="col-span-3"><Skeleton className="h-6 w-24 rounded-full" /></div>
 39:                 <div className="col-span-3 flex justify-end gap-2">
 40:                   <Skeleton className="h-8 w-24 rounded" />
 41:                   <Skeleton className="h-8 w-20 rounded" />
 42:                 </div>
 43:               </div>
 44:             ))
 45:           ) : (
 46:             vmsData?.vms?.map(vm => {
 47:               const isRunning = vm.status?.startsWith('Running');
 48:               const statusStr = vm.status || '';
 49:               let attestationState = 'unknown';
 50:               if (statusStr.includes('AttestationFailed')) attestationState = 'attestation_failed';
 51:               else if (statusStr.includes('PendingAttestation')) attestationState = 'pending_attestation';
 52:               else if (isRunning) attestationState = 'running';
 53:               else attestationState = 'stopped';
 54:               return (
 55:                 <div key={vm.id} className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-4 items-center">

 57:                     {vm.labels['vyoma.service'] || vm.id.slice(0, 12)}
 58:                   </div>
 59:                   <div className="col-span-3 text-muted-foreground text-sm">
 60:                     {vm.labels['image'] || 'unknown'}
 61:                   </div>
 62:                   <div className="col-span-3">
 63:                     <StatusBadge status={attestationState as any} />
 64:                   </div>
 65:                   <div className="col-span-3 flex justify-end gap-2">
 66:                     <Button 
 67:                       variant="outline" 
 68:                       size="sm"
 69:                       disabled={!isRunning || attestMutation.isPending}
 70:                       onClick={() => attestMutation.mutate(vm.id)}
 71:                     >
 72:                       Trigger Check
 73:                     </Button>
 74:                     <Button 
 75:                       variant="secondary" 
 76:                       size="sm"
 77:                       onClick={() => setSelectedResult({ vmId: vm.id, pcr: '0x123...abc' })}
 78:                     >
 79:                       View PCRs
 80:                     </Button>
 81:                   </div>
 82:                 </div>
 83:               );
 84:             })
 85:           )}
 86:         </div>
 87:       </Card>

 94:             {JSON.stringify(selectedResult, null, 2)}
 95:           </div>
 96:         </DialogContent>
 97:       </Dialog>
 98:     </div>
 99:   );
100: }

15: export function useVmMutations() {

17:   const handleSuccess = () => {
18:     queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['vms'] });
19:   };
20:   const startVm = useMutation({
21:     mutationFn: (id: string) => api.post(`/vms/${id}/start`),
22:     onSuccess: handleSuccess,
23:   });
24:   const stopVm = useMutation({
25:     mutationFn: (id: string) => api.post(`/vms/${id}/stop`),
26:     onSuccess: handleSuccess,
27:   });
28:   const pauseVm = useMutation({
29:     mutationFn: (id: string) => api.post(`/vms/${id}/pause`),
30:     onSuccess: handleSuccess,
31:   });
32:   const resumeVm = useMutation({
33:     mutationFn: (id: string) => api.post(`/vms/${id}/resume`),
34:     onSuccess: handleSuccess,
35:   });
36:   const deleteVm = useMutation({
37:     mutationFn: (id: string) => api.delete(`/vms/${id}`),
38:     onSuccess: handleSuccess,
39:   });
40:   return {
41:     startVm,
42:     stopVm,
43:     pauseVm,

================
File: ui/src/hooks/useEventStream.ts
================
 1: import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
 2: const API_BASE = import.meta.env.DEV ? 'http://localhost:8080' : '';
 3: export interface EventMessage {
 4:   id: string;
 5:   type?: string;
 6:   data: any;
 7:   timestamp: number;
 8: }
 9: export function useEventStream(path: string | null) {
10:   const [events, setEvents] = useState<EventMessage[]>([]);
11:   const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);
12:   const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
13:   useEffect(() => {
14:     if (!path) return;
15:     // Use withCredentials to ensure vyoma_token cookie is sent
16:     const eventSource = new EventSource(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
17:       withCredentials: true,
18:     });
19:     eventSource.onopen = () => {
20:       setIsConnected(true);
21:       setError(null);
22:     };
23:     eventSource.onmessage = (event) => {
24:       try {
25:         const parsed = JSON.parse(event.data);
26:         setEvents((prev) => [...prev, {
27:           id: event.lastEventId || Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
28:           type: event.type,
29:           data: parsed,
30:           timestamp: Date.now(),
31:         }]);
32:       } catch {
33:         setEvents((prev) => [...prev, {
34:           id: event.lastEventId || Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
35:           type: event.type,
36:           data: event.data,
37:           timestamp: Date.now(),
38:         }]);
39:       }
40:     };
41:     eventSource.onerror = (err) => {
42:       console.error('EventSource error:', err);
43:       setIsConnected(false);
44:       setError(new Error('Connection lost'));
45:       // EventSource automatically attempts to reconnect
46:     };
47:     return () => {
48:       eventSource.close();
49:       setIsConnected(false);
50:     };
51:   }, [path]);
52:   const clearEvents = useCallback(() => {
53:     setEvents([]);
54:   }, []);
55:   return { events, isConnected, error, clearEvents };
56: }

File: ui/src/lib/api-client.ts
================
 1: import { useAuthStore } from '../stores/auth.store';
 2: const BASE_URL = import.meta.env.DEV ? 'http://localhost:8080' : '';
 3: export async function apiFetch<T = unknown>(path: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
 4:   const token = useAuthStore.getState().token;
 5:   const headers = new Headers(options?.headers);
 6:   if (!headers.has('Content-Type') && options?.method !== 'GET' && options?.method !== 'DELETE') {
 7:     headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
 8:   }
 9:   if (token && !headers.has('Authorization')) {
10:     headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
11:   }
12:   const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, {
13:     ...options,
14:     headers,
15:   });
16:   if (!response.ok) {
17:     let errorMessage = 'An error occurred while fetching data';
18:     try {
19:       const errorData = await response.json();
20:       errorMessage = errorData.message || errorData.error || errorMessage;
21:     } catch {
22:       errorMessage = await response.text() || errorMessage;
23:     }
24:     throw new Error(errorMessage);
25:   }
26:   // Handle empty responses
27:   if (response.status === 204 || response.headers.get('content-length') === '0') {
28:     return null as T;
29:   }
30:   // Try to parse JSON, fallback to text if not JSON
31:   const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type');
32:   if (contentType && contentType.includes('application/json')) {
33:     return response.json();
34:   }
35:   return response.text() as unknown as T;
36: }
37: export const api = {
38:   get: <T>(path: string, options?: RequestInit) => apiFetch<T>(path, { ...options, method: 'GET' }),
39:   post: <T>(path: string, data?: unknown, options?: RequestInit) => apiFetch<T>(path, { 
40:     ...options, 
41:     method: 'POST', 
42:     body: data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined 
43:   }),
44:   put: <T>(path: string, data?: unknown, options?: RequestInit) => apiFetch<T>(path, { 
45:     ...options, 
46:     method: 'PUT', 
47:     body: data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined 
48:   }),
49:   patch: <T>(path: string, data?: unknown, options?: RequestInit) => apiFetch<T>(path, { 
50:     ...options, 
51:     method: 'PATCH', 
52:     body: data ? JSON.stringify(data) : undefined 
53:   }),
54:   delete: <T>(path: string, options?: RequestInit) => apiFetch<T>(path, { ...options, method: 'DELETE' }),
55: };

 2: interface AuthState {
 3:   token: string | null;
 4:   setToken: (token: string) => void;
 5:   clearToken: () => void;
 6: }
 7: // Initial token extraction from meta tag
 8: const getTokenFromMeta = () => {
 9:   const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="vyoma-api-token"]');
10:   const token = meta?.getAttribute('content') || null;
11:   if (token) {
12:     document.cookie = `vyoma_token=${token}; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
13:   }
14:   return token;
15: };
16: export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>((set) => ({
17:   token: getTokenFromMeta(),
18:   setToken: (token) => {
19:     document.cookie = `vyoma_token=${token}; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
20:     set({ token });
21:   },
22:   clearToken: () => {
23:     document.cookie = `vyoma_token=; path=/; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT`;
24:     set({ token: null });
25:   },
26: }));

 17:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
 18:         f.debug_struct("VmmManager")
 19:          .field("socket_path", &self.socket_path)
 20:          .field("process", &if self.process.is_some() { "Some(Child)" } else { "None" })
 21:          .finish()
 22:     }
 23: }
 24: /// Manages a Cloud Hypervisor process and its API interaction.
 25: pub struct VmmManager {
 26:     socket_path: String,
 27:     process: Option<Child>,
 28:     log_sender: broadcast::Sender<String>,
 29:     config: VmConfig,
 30:     client: Client,
 31: }
 32: impl VmmManager {
 33:     pub fn new(socket_path: &str) -> Self {
 34:         let (tx, _) = broadcast::channel(100);
 35:         let client = Client::builder()
 36:             .unix_socket(socket_path)
 37:             .build()
 38:             .unwrap_or_else(|_| Client::new()); // Fallback, but unix_socket should work
 39:         Self {
 40:             socket_path: socket_path.to_string(),
 41:             process: None,
 42:             log_sender: tx,
 43:             config: VmConfig::default(),
 44:             client,
 45:         }
 46:     }
 47:     pub fn socket_path(&self) -> &str {
 48:         &self.socket_path
 49:     }
 50:     pub fn pid(&self) -> Option<u32> {
 51:         self.process.as_ref().map(|p| p.id())
 52:     }
 53:     pub fn try_wait(&mut self) -> Result<Option<std::process::ExitStatus>> {
 54:         if let Some(child) = self.process.as_mut() {
 55:             child.try_wait().map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to wait on child: {}", e))
 56:         } else {
 57:             Ok(None)
 58:         }
 59:     }
 60:     pub fn start_daemon(&mut self, binary_path: &str, netns: Option<&str>, rootless: bool) -> Result<()> {
 61:         info!("Starting Cloud Hypervisor at {} (Socket: {}, NetNS: {:?}, Rootless: {})", binary_path, self.socket_path, netns, rootless);
 62:         if Path::new(&self.socket_path).exists() {
 63:             std::fs::remove_file(&self.socket_path)?;
 64:         }
 65:         let mut child = if rootless {
 66:              Command::new("unshare")
 67:                 .arg("-r")
 68:                 .arg("-n")
 69:                 .arg(binary_path)
 70:                 .arg("--api-socket")
 71:                 .arg(&self.socket_path)
 72:                 .stdout(Stdio::piped())
 73:                 .stderr(Stdio::piped())
 74:                 .spawn()
 75:                 .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to spawn cloud-hypervisor with unshare: {}", e))?
 76:         } else if let Some(ns) = netns {
 77:              Command::new("ip")
 78:                 .arg("netns")
 79:                 .arg("exec")
 80:                 .arg(ns)
 81:                 .arg(binary_path)
 82:                 .arg("--api-socket")
 83:                 .arg(&self.socket_path)
 84:                 .stdout(Stdio::piped())
 85:                 .stderr(Stdio::piped())
 86:                 .spawn()
 87:                 .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to spawn cloud-hypervisor in netns: {}", e))?
 88:         } else {
 89:              Command::new(binary_path)
 90:                 .arg("--api-socket")
 91:                 .arg(&self.socket_path)
 92:                 .stdout(Stdio::piped())
 93:                 .stderr(Stdio::piped())
 94:                 .spawn()
 95:                 .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Failed to spawn cloud-hypervisor: {}", e))?
 96:         };
 97:         let stdout = child.stdout.take().ok_or(anyhow!("Failed to capture stdout"))?;
 98:         let stderr = child.stderr.take().ok_or(anyhow!("Failed to capture stderr"))?;
 99:         let tx_out = self.log_sender.clone();
100:         let tx_err = self.log_sender.clone();
101:         thread::spawn(move || {
102:             let reader = BufReader::new(stdout);
103:             for line in reader.lines() {
104:                 if let Ok(l) = line {
105:                     tracing::info!("[CH STDOUT] {}", l);
106:                     let _ = tx_out.send(format!("[STDOUT] {}", l));
107:                 }
108:             }
109:         });
110:         thread::spawn(move || {
111:             let reader = BufReader::new(stderr);
112:             for line in reader.lines() {
113:                 if let Ok(l) = line {
114:                     tracing::error!("[CH STDERR] {}", l);
115:                     let _ = tx_err.send(format!("[STDERR] {}", l));
116:                 }
117:             }
118:         });
119:         self.process = Some(child);
120:         self.wait_for_socket(Duration::from_secs(5))?;
121:         Ok(())
122:     }
123:     fn wait_for_socket(&self, timeout: Duration) -> Result<()> {
124:         let start = std::time::Instant::now();
125:         while start.elapsed() < timeout {
126:             if Path::new(&self.socket_path).exists() {
127:                 return Ok(());
128:             }
129:             std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
130:         }
131:         Err(anyhow!("Timed out waiting for Cloud Hypervisor socket"))
132:     }
133:     pub async fn check_alive(&self) -> bool {
134:         self.api_request::<()>("/api/v1/vmm.ping", Method::GET, None).await.is_ok()
135:     }
136:     async fn api_request<T: Serialize>(&self, endpoint: &str, method: Method, body: Option<&T>) -> Result<()> {
137:         let url = format!("http://localhost{}", endpoint);
138:         info!("VMM api_request: socket_path={}, endpoint={}, method={}", self.socket_path, endpoint, method);
139:         if !Path::new(&self.socket_path).exists() {
140:             return Err(anyhow!("Cloud Hypervisor socket not found at {} - it may have crashed", self.socket_path));
141:         }
142:         let mut req = self.client.request(method.clone(), &url);
143:         if let Some(b) = body {
144:             req = req.json(b);
145:         }
146:         let response = req.send().await?;
147:         if !response.status().is_success() {
148:             let status = response.status();
149:             let err_text = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
150:             error!("API {} failed. status: {}, body: {}", endpoint, status, err_text);
151:             return Err(anyhow!("API request {} failed with {}: {}", endpoint, status, err_text));
152:         }
153:         Ok(())
154:     }

253:     pub async fn start_instance(&self) -> Result<()> {

322:             info!("Killing Cloud Hypervisor process");
323:             let _ = child.kill();
324:             let _ = child.wait();
325:         }
326:         if Path::new(&self.socket_path).exists() {

 45:     async fn cleanup_on_failure(&mut self) {
 46:         let vm_id = &self.vm_id;
 47:         warn!("Cleaning up resources after failure for VM {}", vm_id);
 48:         if let Some(ref network) = self.network_config {
 49:             info!("Cleaning up network for VM {}", vm_id);
 50:             let networks: Vec<String> = if network.network_infos.is_empty() {
 51:                 vec![]
 52:             } else {
 53:                 network.network_infos.iter()
 54:                     .map(|n| n.network_name.clone())
 55:                     .collect()
 56:             };
 57:             let _ = network::cleanup_network(&self.state, vm_id, &networks, &network.netns_path).await;
 58:         }
 59:         if let Some(ref storage) = self.storage {
 60:             info!("Cleaning up storage for VM {}", vm_id);
 61:             let _ = storage::cleanup_storage(storage).await;
 62:         }
 63:         if let Some(ref vm_dir) = self.vm_dir {
 64:             if vm_dir.exists() {
 65:                 info!("Cleaning up VM directory {:?}", vm_dir);
 66:                 // let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(vm_dir);
 67:             }
 68:         }
 69:         info!("Cleanup completed for VM {}", vm_id);
 70:     }

 72: pub async fn run_vm(state: Arc<AppState>, request: VmRunRequest) -> Result<VmRunResponse> {
 73:     info!("VmService: Starting VM for image {}", request.image);
 74:     let home = dirs::home_dir().context("No home dir")?;
 75:     let vyoma_root = home.join(".vyoma");
 76:     let images_root = vyoma_root.join("images");
 77:     let vms_root = vyoma_root.join("vms");
 78:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&images_root)?;
 79:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&vms_root)?;
 80:     let vm_uuid = uuid::Uuid::new_v4();
 81:     let vm_id = vm_uuid.to_string();
 82:     let cid = (vm_uuid.as_fields().0 % 1000000) + 3;
 83:     let vm_dir = vms_root.join(&vm_id);
 84:     let mut ctx = VmCreationContext::new(Arc::clone(&state), vm_id.clone());
 85:     ctx.vm_dir = Some(vm_dir.clone());
 86:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&vm_dir).context("Failed to create VM dir")?;
 87:     let prepared_image = match image::prepare_image(&request.image).await {
 88:         Ok(img) => img,
 89:         Err(e) => {
 90:             ctx.cleanup_on_failure().await;
 91:             return Err(e);
 92:         }
 93:     };
 94:     let storage = match storage::prepare_storage(
 95:         &state,
 96:         &prepared_image.rootfs_sqfs_path,
 97:         &vm_dir,
 98:         &vm_id,
 99:     ).await {
100:         Ok(s) => {
101:             ctx.storage = Some(s.clone());
102:             s
103:         }
104:         Err(e) => {
105:             ctx.cleanup_on_failure().await;
106:             return Err(e);
107:         }
108:     };
109:     let network_config = match network::setup_network(
110:         &state,
111:         &vm_id,
112:         &request.networks,
113:     ).await {
114:         Ok(n) => {
115:             ctx.network_config = Some(n.clone());
116:             n
117:         }
118:         Err(e) => {
119:             ctx.cleanup_on_failure().await;
120:             return Err(e);
121:         }
122:     };
123:     let agent_config = agent::prepare_agent(
124:         &state,
125:         &storage.dm_device_path,
126:         &vm_dir,
127:         &prepared_image.config,
128:         &network_config.ip_address,
129:         &network_config.gateway,
130:         &request.volumes,
131:     ).await?;
132:     let kernel_path = image::resolve_kernel_from_manifest(&prepared_image.manifest, &state.data_dir)
133:         .unwrap_or_else(|| image::get_default_kernel_path(&state.data_dir));
134:     let ch_config = config::build_ch_config(
135:         &state,
136:         &vm_id,
137:         &cid,
138:         &vm_dir,
139:         &storage.dm_device_path,
140:         &network_config,
141:         &agent_config,
142:         &kernel_path,
143:     );
144:     let cgroup_path = setup_cgroups(&state, &vm_id, request.vcpu, request.mem_size_mib)?;
145:     let (vmm, proxy_tasks, fs_managers, mut vtpm_manager) = match boot::start_vm(
146:         &state,
147:         &ch_config,
148:         &network_config,
149:         &request,
150:     ).await {
151:         Ok(result) => {
152:             // Add cloud-hypervisor process to cgroup
153:             if let Some(pid) = result.0.pid() {
154:                 if let Err(e) = state.cgroups.add_process(&vm_id, pid) {
155:                      error!("Failed to add process {} to cgroup: {}", pid, e);
156:                 } else {
157:                      info!("Added process {} to cgroup for VM {}", pid, vm_id);
158:                 }
159:             }
160:             result
161:         },
162:         Err(e) => {
163:             ctx.cleanup_on_failure().await;
164:             return Err(e);
165:         }
166:     };
167:     // Start attestation check asynchronously
168:     let state_clone = Arc::clone(&state);
169:     let vm_id_clone = vm_id.clone();
170:     let vm_dir_clone = vm_dir.clone();
171:     let image_name = prepared_image.manifest.as_ref()
172:         .and_then(|m| m.labels.get("vyoma.image.name"))
173:         .unwrap_or(&vm_id)
174:         .clone();
175:     let tpm_socket_path = vtpm_manager.as_ref().map(|vtpm| vtpm.socket_path().to_string());
176:     // Check if attestation is required before spawning
177:     let needs_attestation = {
178:         let policy = state.policy_manager.lock().unwrap();
179:         policy.must_verify_on_boot()
180:     };
181:     let attestation_handle = if needs_attestation {
182:         info!("Measured boot attestation required for VM {}, TPM socket: {:?}", vm_id, tpm_socket_path);
183:         let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
184:             let vm_id_for_log = vm_id_clone.clone();
185:             let inner = AssertUnwindSafe(async {
186:                 policy::check_policy_and_perform_attestation(
187:                     state_clone,
188:                     vm_id_clone,
189:                     vm_dir_clone,
190:                     image_name,
191:                     tpm_socket_path,
192:                 ).await
193:             });
194:             let result = inner.catch_unwind().await;
195:             match result {
196:                 Ok(Ok(())) => info!("Attestation completed successfully for VM {}", vm_id_for_log),
197:                 Ok(Err(e)) => error!("Attestation failed for VM {}: {}", vm_id_for_log, e),
198:                 Err(panic_info) => error!("Attestation task panicked for VM {}: {:?}", vm_id_for_log, panic_info),
199:             }
200:         });
201:         Some(handle)
202:     } else {
203:         // No attestation required — nothing to do here; the VM instance
204:         // will be created with VmStatus::Running below.
205:         None
206:     };
207:     if !needs_attestation {
208:         if let Some(ref mut vtpm) = vtpm_manager {
209:             let _ = vtpm.stop();
210:         }
211:     }
212:     let instance = VmInstance {
213:         vmm,
214:         id: vm_id.clone(),
215:         status: if needs_attestation { VmStatus::PendingAttestation } else { VmStatus::Running },
216:         attestation_status: None,
217:         ch_socket_path: ch_config.socket_path.clone(),
218:         tap_name: network_config.primary_tap.clone(),
219:         dm_name: storage.dm_name.clone(),
220:         loop_devices: storage.loop_devices.clone(),
221:         cow_file_path: storage.cow_file_path.clone(),
222:         ip_address: network_config.ip_address.clone(),
223:         proxy_tasks,
224:         fs_managers,
225:         vtpm_manager,
226:         cgroup_path,
227:         netns_path: network_config.netns_path.clone(),
228:         config_ports: request.ports.clone(),
229:         config_volumes: request.volumes.clone(),
230:         hostname: request.hostname.clone(),
231:         labels: request.labels.clone(),
232:         base_image_path: prepared_image.rootfs_sqfs_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
233:         vcpu: request.vcpu,
234:         mem_size_mib: request.mem_size_mib,
235:         networks: request.networks.clone(),
236:         attestation_task: attestation_handle,
237:         last_cpu_sample: None,
238:     };
239:     instance.save_state().context("Failed to save state")?;
240:     let status_string = match &instance.status {
241:         VmStatus::PendingAttestation => "PendingAttestation".to_string(),
242:         VmStatus::Running => "Running".to_string(),
243:         VmStatus::AttestationFailed { reason } => format!("AttestationFailed: {}", reason),
244:         VmStatus::Error { reason } => format!("Error: {}", reason),
245:     };
246:     {
247:         let mut vms = state.vms.lock().await;
248:         vms.insert(vm_id.clone(), Arc::new(tokio::sync::Mutex::new(instance)));
249:     }
250:     let _ = state.events_tx.send(serde_json::json!({
251:         "type": "vm_start",
252:         "id": vm_id.clone(),
253:         "name": request.labels.get("vyoma.service").unwrap_or(&vm_id)
254:     }).to_string());
255:     Ok(VmRunResponse {
256:         vm_id,
257:         status: status_string,
258:         ip_address: network_config.ip_address,
259:     })
260: }
261: pub fn setup_cgroups(
262:     state: &AppState,
263:     vm_id: &str,
264:     vcpu: u32,
265:     mem_size_mib: u32,
266: ) -> Result<Option<String>> {
267:     match state.cgroups.create_vm_cgroup(vm_id) {
268:         Ok(path) => {
269:             let quota = vcpu * 100;
270:             if let Err(e) = state.cgroups.set_cpu_limit(vm_id, quota) {
271:                 error!("Failed to set cpu limit: {}", e);
272:             }
273:             let mem_bytes = (mem_size_mib as u64) * 1024 * 1024;
274:             if let Err(e) = state.cgroups.set_memory_limit(vm_id, mem_bytes) {
275:                 error!("Failed to set memory limit: {}", e);
276:             }
277:             Ok(Some(path))
278:         }
279:         Err(e) => {
280:             error!("Failed to create cgroup: {}", e);
281:             Ok(None)
282:         }
283:     }
284: }

 1: #!/bin/bash
 2: set -e
 3: source tests/e2e/common.sh
 4: echo "=== Test 03: Builder (Vyomafile) ==="
 5: check_root
 6: setup_env
 7: echo "Starting Daemon (3003)..."
 8: sudo -E $VYOMAD_BIN --data-dir $TEST_HOME/.vyoma --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3003 > $TEST_HOME/daemon.log 2>&1 &
 9: DAEMON_PID=$!
