11: VYOMA="$VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock --http-port 3003"
12: CTX=$TEST_HOME/build_ctx
13: mkdir -p $CTX
14: cat <<EOF > $CTX/Vyomafile
15: FROM alpine:latest
16: RUN echo "Vyoma Build Test" > /build_test.txt
17: CMD ["sleep", "60"]
18: EOF
19: echo "Pulling base image..."
20: $VYOMA pull alpine:latest 2>/dev/null || true
21: echo "Building Image..."
22: OUTPUT=$($VYOMA build $CTX 2>&1)
23: echo "$OUTPUT"
24: assert_success "Build Command"
25: if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "Build complete"; then
26:     echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: Build completed successfully${NC}"
27: else
28:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Build did not complete${NC}"
29:     exit 1
30: fi
31: BUILT_IMAGE_NAME="vyoma:builder-test-$(date +%s)"
32: echo "Tagging built image for testing..."
33: $VYOMA tag "$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -oP 'sha256:[a-f0-9]+' | head -1)" "$BUILT_IMAGE_NAME" 2>/dev/null || \
34:     $VYOMA tag "vyoma:local-build" "$BUILT_IMAGE_NAME" 2>/dev/null || true
35: echo "Running built image as VM..."
36: VM_ID=$($VYOMA run "$BUILT_IMAGE_NAME" --hostname built-vm --vcpu 1 --memory 128 2>&1)
37: VM_ID=$(echo "$VM_ID" | awk -F 'VM ID: ' '{print $2}' | awk '{print $1}' | tr -d ',')
38: if [ -z "$VM_ID" ]; then
39:     VM_ID=$($VYOMA ps | grep "built-vm" | awk '{print $1}')
40: fi
41: echo "VM ID: $VM_ID"
42: if [ -n "$VM_ID" ]; then
43:     register_vm "$VM_ID"
44:     wait_for_vm_state "$VM_ID" "Running" 15
45:     assert_success "Built image runs as VM"
46: else
47:     echo -e "${RED}Fail: Could not start VM from built image${NC}"
48:     exit 1
49: fi
50: echo "Stopping test VM..."
51: $VYOMA stop "$VM_ID" 2>/dev/null || true
52: unregister_vm "$VM_ID"
53: cleanup_env $DAEMON_PID
54: echo "=== Test 03 Passed ==="

  1: use std::fs::File;
  2: #[cfg(unix)]
  3: use std::os::unix::fs::FileTypeExt;
  4: use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
  5: use tracing::{info, warn, error};
  6: use loopdev::LoopControl;
  7: use crate::error::{StorageError, Result};
  8: pub struct LoopDevice {
  9:     pub path: PathBuf,
 10:     // Store the underlying loopdev device so we can detach it natively
 11:     device: Option<loopdev::LoopDevice>,
 12: }
 13: impl LoopDevice {
 14:     pub fn new(path: PathBuf, device: Option<loopdev::LoopDevice>) -> Self {
 15:         Self { path, device }
 16:     }
 17:     pub fn path(&self) -> &Path {
 18:         &self.path
 19:     }
 20: }
 21: pub struct LoopManager {
 22:     control: LoopControl,
 23: }
 24: impl LoopManager {
 25:     pub fn new() -> Result<Self> {
 26:         info!("Initializing Loop manager");
 27:         let control = LoopControl::open().map_err(|e| StorageError::Io(e))?;
 28:         Ok(Self { control })
 29:     }
 30:     pub fn attach(&self, file: &Path) -> Result<LoopDevice> {
 31:         self.attach_internal(file, false)
 32:     }
 33:     pub fn attach_readonly(&self, file: &Path) -> Result<LoopDevice> {
 34:         self.attach_internal(file, true)
 35:     }
 36:     fn attach_internal(&self, file: &Path, readonly: bool) -> Result<LoopDevice> {
 37:         info!("Attaching loop device to {:?} (readonly: {})", file, readonly);
 38:         if !file.exists() {
 39:             return Err(StorageError::NotFound(format!("File not found: {:?}", file)));
 40:         }
 41:         match std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(!readonly).open(file) {
 42:             Ok(_) => info!("Successfully opened backing file {:?}", file),
 43:             Err(e) => error!("Failed to open backing file {:?} with write={}: {:?}", file, !readonly, e),
 44:         }
 45:         let mut retries = 0;
 46:         let _ld = loop {
 47:             let next_free_result = self.control.next_free();
 48:             let attach_result: std::io::Result<LoopDevice> = match next_free_result {
 49:                 Ok(ld) => {
 50:                     let res = ld.with().read_only(readonly).attach(file);
 51:                     match res {
 52:                         Ok(()) => return Ok(LoopDevice::new(ld.path().unwrap(), Some(ld))),
 53:                         Err(e) => Err(e),
 54:                     }
 55:                 },
 56:                 Err(e) => Err(e),
 57:             };
 58:             if let Err(e) = attach_result {
 59:                 if e.raw_os_error() == Some(13) {
 60:                     warn!("loopdev failed with EACCES, falling back to losetup...");
 61:                     let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new("losetup");
 62:                     cmd.arg("-f").arg("--show");
 63:                     if readonly {
 64:                         cmd.arg("-r");
 65:                     }
 66:                     cmd.arg(file);
 67:                     match cmd.output() {
 68:                         Ok(output) if output.status.success() => {
 69:                             let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
 70:                             let dev_path = stdout.trim();
 71:                             info!("losetup fallback succeeded: {}", dev_path);
 72:                             return Ok(LoopDevice::new(std::path::PathBuf::from(dev_path), None));
 73:                         }
 74:                         Ok(output) => {
 75:                             error!("losetup fallback failed: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr));
 76:                             if retries < 50 {
 77:                                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(20));
 78:                                 retries += 1;
 79:                                 continue;
 80:                             }
 81:                             return Err(StorageError::Io(e));
 82:                         }
 83:                         Err(err) => {
 84:                             error!("Failed to execute losetup: {}", err);
 85:                             return Err(StorageError::Io(e));
 86:                         }
 87:                     }
 88:                 } else {
 89:                     error!("loopdev operation failed: {:?}", e);
 90:                     return Err(StorageError::Io(e));
 91:                 }
 92:             }
 93:         };
 94:     }
 95:     pub fn detach(&self, device: &LoopDevice) -> Result<()> {
 96:         info!("Detaching loop device {:?}", device.path);
 97:         if let Some(ld) = &device.device {
 98:             ld.detach().map_err(|e| StorageError::Io(e))?;
 99:         } else {
100:             let path_str = match device.path.to_str() {
101:                 Some(s) => s,
102:                 None => {
103:                     warn!("Loop device path is not valid UTF-8; skipping detach");
104:                     return Ok(());
105:                 }
106:             };
107:             #[cfg(unix)]
108:             {
109:                 let path = std::path::Path::new(path_str);
110:                 let metadata = match std::fs::metadata(path) {
111:                     Ok(m) => m,
112:                     Err(_) => {
113:                         info!("Loop device {} already removed; nothing to detach", path_str);
114:                         return Ok(());
115:                     }
116:                 };
117:                 if !metadata.file_type().is_block_device() {
118:                     warn!("Path {} is not a block device; skipping detach", path_str);
119:                     return Ok(());
120:                 }
121:                 match loopdev::LoopDevice::open(path_str) {
122:                     Ok(ld) => {
123:                         if let Err(e) = ld.detach() {
124:                             warn!("Failed to detach loop device {} via fallback: {}; assuming it is already freed", path_str, e);
125:                         }
126:                     }
127:                     Err(e) => {
128:                         warn!("Failed to open loop device {} via fallback: {}; assuming already detached", path_str, e);
129:                     }
130:                 }
131:             }
132:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
133:             {
134:                 warn!("Loop device detachment not supported on non-Unix platforms");
135:             }
136:         }
137:         Ok(())
138:     }
139:     pub fn create_cow_file(path: &Path, size_mb: u64) -> Result<()> {
140:         info!("Creating COW file: {:?} ({} MB)", path, size_mb);
141:         if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
142:             std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
143:         }
144:         let file = File::create(path)?;
145:         file.set_len(size_mb * 1024 * 1024)?;
146:         info!("COW file created successfully");
147:         Ok(())
148:     }
149:     pub fn get_size(path: &Path) -> Result<u64> {
150:         let metadata = std::fs::metadata(path)?;
151:         Ok(metadata.len())
152:     }
153:     pub fn is_attached(&self, device: &LoopDevice) -> Result<bool> {
154:         Ok(device.path.exists()) // Proper check might involve interrogating LoopControl natively
155:     }
156:     pub fn list_devices(&self) -> Result<Vec<LoopDevice>> {
157:         info!("Listing loop devices");
158:         let devices = Vec::new();
159:         // Since list_devices isn't trivially exposed or needed safely right now, we keep it minimum
160:         Ok(devices)
161:     }
162: }

File: crates/vyomad/src/vm_service/agent.rs

  1: use anyhow::{Context, Result};
  2: use std::path::Path;
  3: use std::path::PathBuf;
  4: use std::sync::Arc;
  5: use tracing::info;
  6: use super::types::AgentConfig;
  7: use crate::state::AppState;
  8: pub async fn prepare_agent(
  9:     _state: &AppState,
 10:     _dm_path: &str,
 11:     vm_dir: &Path,
 12:     _config: &vyoma_core::oci::OciImageConfig,
 13:     ip_address: &str,
 14:     gateway: &str,
 15:     volumes: &[vyoma_core::api::VolumeMount],
 16: ) -> Result<AgentConfig> {
 17:     let initramfs_path = vm_dir.join("initramfs.cpio.gz");
 18:     let init_script = generate_init_script(_config, ip_address, gateway, volumes);
 19:     let agent_binary_usr = PathBuf::from("/usr/bin/vyoma-agent-vm");
 20:     let agent_binary_lib = PathBuf::from("/usr/lib/vyoma/vyoma-agent-vm");
 21:     let agent_binary_data = PathBuf::from(&_state.data_dir).join("bin").join("vyoma-agent-vm");
 22:     let busybox_binary_usr = PathBuf::from("/usr/bin/busybox");
 23:     let busybox_binary_lib = PathBuf::from("/var/lib/vyoma/bin/busybox");
 24:     let busybox_path = if busybox_binary_lib.exists() {
 25:         Some(&busybox_binary_lib as &Path)
 26:     } else if busybox_binary_usr.exists() {
 27:         Some(&busybox_binary_usr as &Path)
 28:     } else {
 29:         None
 30:     };
 31:     // Static musl build (preferred for local dev)
 32:     let agent_binary_musl = std::env::current_exe()
 33:         .ok()
 34:         .and_then(|p| p.parent().and_then(|parent| parent.parent().map(|target| target.join("x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/vyoma-agent-vm"))));
 35:     // Glibc build (fallback for local dev)
 36:     let agent_binary_exe_dir = std::env::current_exe()
 37:         .ok()
 38:         .and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|parent| parent.join("vyoma-agent-vm")));
 39:     let agent_path = if agent_binary_musl.as_ref().map_or(false, |p| p.exists()) {
 40:         agent_binary_musl.as_deref()
 41:     } else if agent_binary_exe_dir.as_ref().map_or(false, |p| p.exists()) {
 42:         agent_binary_exe_dir.as_deref()
 43:     } else if agent_binary_usr.exists() {
 44:         Some(&agent_binary_usr as &Path)
 45:     } else if agent_binary_lib.exists() {
 46:         Some(&agent_binary_lib as &Path)
 47:     } else if agent_binary_data.exists() {
 48:         Some(&agent_binary_data as &Path)
 49:     } else {
 50:         None
 51:     };
 52:     if agent_path.is_none() {
 53:         tracing::warn!("vyoma-agent-vm binary not found in expected locations. VM will boot without agent capabilities.");
 54:     }
 55:     // Try to find it in PATH using a simple which-like implementation if we really need it,
 56:     // but typically standard paths are enough. Let's add a basic PATH search.
 57:     let mut resolved_agent_path = agent_path;
 58:     let mut env_path_buf = PathBuf::new();
 59:     if resolved_agent_path.is_none() {
 60:         if let Ok(paths) = std::env::var("PATH") {
 61:             for p in std::env::split_paths(&paths) {
 62:                 let candidate = p.join("vyoma-agent-vm");
 63:                 if candidate.exists() {
 64:                     env_path_buf = candidate;
 65:                     resolved_agent_path = Some(&env_path_buf as &Path);
 66:                     break;
 67:                 }
 68:             }
 69:         }
 70:     }
 71:     vyoma_core::initramfs::create_initramfs(
 72:         &init_script,
 73:         resolved_agent_path,
 74:         busybox_path,
 75:         &initramfs_path,
 76:     )
 77:     .context("Failed to create initramfs")?;
 78:     info!("Agent prepared with initramfs at {:?}", initramfs_path);
 79:     std::fs::copy(&initramfs_path, "/tmp/initramfs.cpio.gz").ok();
 80:     Ok(AgentConfig {
 81:         initramfs_path: Some(initramfs_path),
 82:         cmd: vec!["/sbin/init".to_string()],
 83:         workdir: "/".to_string(),
 84:         envs: vec![],
 85:     })
 86: }
 87: /// Escapes a string for safe use in shell scripts.
 88: ///
 89: /// This function ensures that strings can be safely used in:
 90: /// - `export KEY=value` statements
 91: /// - Command arguments after `exec`
 92: ///
 93: /// - If the string contains only "safe" characters (alphanumeric, _, -, ., /, :),
 94: ///   it is returned unquoted.
 95: /// - Otherwise, it is wrapped in single quotes with embedded single quotes
 96: ///   escaped as '\'' (standard POSIX shell escaping).
 97: ///
 98: /// The safe character set is conservative and excludes shell metacharacters
 99: /// like `$`, `` ` ``, `;`, `|`, `&`, etc.
100: fn shell_escape(s: &str) -> String {
101:     if s.chars().all(|c| c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '_' || c == '-' || c == '.' || c == '/' || c == ':') {
102:         s.to_string()
103:     } else {
104:         format!("'{}'", s.replace('\'', "'\\''"))
105:     }
106: }
107: /// Generates the init script that runs as PID 1 inside the VM.
108: ///
109: /// # Security Considerations
110: ///
111: /// This script is part of the initramfs and is measured into PCR 10 during
112: /// measured boot. If a signed manifest is required by policy, the entire OCI
113: /// config (including these values) is signed, so tampering is detected.
114: ///
115: /// If unsigned images are allowed, the attacker already has arbitrary code
116: /// execution inside the VM, so there is no additional security boundary being
117: /// breached.
118: ///
119: /// The script uses defensive shell options:
120: /// - `set -e`: Exit on any error
121: /// - `set -u`: Treat unset variables as errors
122: /// - `trap ERR`: Power off on any error to prevent continuing with broken state
123: fn generate_init_script(config: &vyoma_core::oci::OciImageConfig, ip_address: &str, gateway: &str, volumes: &[vyoma_core::api::VolumeMount]) -> String {
124:     let mut script = String::new();
125:     script.push_str("#!/bin/busybox sh\n");
126:     // Defensive shell options: fail fast on errors and unset variables
127:     script.push_str("set -e\n");
128:     script.push_str("set -u\n");
129:     // Power off on any error to prevent continuing with broken state
130:     script.push_str("trap 'echo Init error at line $LINENO; /bin/busybox poweroff -f' ERR\n");
131:     script.push_str("\n");
132:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mkdir -p /proc /sys /dev\n");
133:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mount -t proc proc /proc 2>/dev/null || true\n");
134:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mount -t sysfs sys /sys 2>/dev/null || true\n");
135:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mount -t devtmpfs dev /dev 2>/dev/null || true\n");
136:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox ip link set lo up 2>/dev/null || true\n");
137:     script.push_str("# Wait for eth0 to appear (virtio-net driver might take a moment)\n");
138:     script.push_str("while ! /bin/busybox ip link show eth0 >/dev/null 2>&1; do\n");
139:     script.push_str("  /bin/busybox sleep 0.1\n");
140:     script.push_str("done\n");
141:     script.push_str("# Configure eth0 manually\n");
142:     script.push_str(&format!("/bin/busybox ip addr add {}/24 dev eth0 2>/dev/null || true\n", ip_address));
143:     script.push_str(&format!("/bin/busybox ip link set eth0 up 2>/dev/null || true\n"));
144:     script.push_str(&format!("/bin/busybox ip route add default via {} 2>/dev/null || true\n", gateway));
145:     if let Some(envs) = &config.env {
146:         for env in envs {
147:             if let Some((key, value)) = env.split_once('=') {
148:                 script.push_str(&format!("export {}={}\n", shell_escape(key), shell_escape(value)));
149:             }
150:         }
151:     }
152:     if let Some(workdir) = &config.working_dir {
153:         script.push_str(&format!("export VWORKDIR={}\n", shell_escape(workdir)));
154:     }
155:     script.push_str("# Mount container rootfs using overlayfs\n");
156:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mkdir -p /lower\n");
157:     script.push_str("# Wait for /dev/vda to appear\n");
158:     script.push_str("while [ ! -b /dev/vda ]; do /bin/busybox sleep 0.1; done\n");
159:     // Mount squashfs into /lower
160:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mount -r -t squashfs /dev/vda /lower 2>/dev/null || /bin/busybox mount -r /dev/vda /lower 2>/dev/null || /bin/busybox mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /lower\n");
161:     // Setup overlayfs
162:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mkdir -p /overlay\n");
163:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /overlay\n");
164:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mkdir -p /overlay/upper /overlay/work\n");
165:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mkdir -p /sysroot\n");
166:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/lower,upperdir=/overlay/upper,workdir=/overlay/work /sysroot\n");
167:     script.push_str("# Mount virtiofs volumes\n");
168:     for (idx, vol) in volumes.iter().enumerate() {
169:         let tag = format!("vol{}", idx);
170:         let vm_path = shell_escape(&vol.vm_path);
171:         script.push_str(&format!("/bin/busybox mkdir -p /sysroot{}\n", vm_path));
172:         script.push_str(&format!("/bin/busybox mount -t virtiofs {} /sysroot{} 2>/dev/null || true\n", tag, vm_path));
173:     }
174:     script.push_str("# Inject agent into container\n");
175:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mkdir -p /sysroot/mnt\n");
176:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox cp /sbin/vyoma-agent-vm /sysroot/mnt/vyoma-agent-vm\n");
177:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox chmod +x /sysroot/mnt/vyoma-agent-vm\n");
178:     // Copy busybox so the agent has a shell available in the container if needed
179:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mkdir -p /sysroot/bin\n");
180:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox cp /bin/busybox /sysroot/bin/busybox 2>/dev/null || true\n");
181:     // We must switch root to /sysroot, but before that, let's start the agent
182:     // Since switch_root replaces init, we must run the agent in the background inside the new root
183:     // But switch_root only runs ONE command. 
184:     // To solve this, we will write a wrapper script inside the new root!
185:     script.push_str("cat << 'EOF' > /sysroot/mnt/start.sh\n");
186:     script.push_str("#!/bin/busybox sh\n");
187:     // Create missing directories for essential filesystems in new root
188:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mkdir -p /proc /sys /dev\n");
189:     // Mount essential filesystems in new root
190:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mount -t proc proc /proc || true\n");
191:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mount -t sysfs sys /sys || true\n");
192:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox mount -t devtmpfs dev /dev || true\n");
193:     // Install busybox applets so 'echo', 'sh', etc. are available (especially if we are in tmpfs fallback)
194:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox --install -s /bin || true\n");
195:     // Start agent
196:     script.push_str("/mnt/vyoma-agent-vm > /dev/console 2>&1 &\n");
197:     // Execute original container command
198:     let full_cmd = config.full_command();
199:     if !full_cmd.is_empty() {
200:         let cmd_args: Vec<String> = full_cmd.iter().map(|s| shell_escape(s)).collect();
201:         // Run in foreground (no exec) so if it fails (not found), we can fallback to the sleep loop
202:         script.push_str(&format!("{} \n", cmd_args.join(" ")));
203:     } else {
204:         script.push_str("/bin/busybox sh\n");
205:     }
206:     // Fallback: If exec fails (e.g. command not found because squashfs failed to mount),
207:     // sleep forever to prevent the kernel from panicking. This keeps the agent alive!
208:     script.push_str("while true; do /bin/busybox sleep 3600; done\n");
209:     script.push_str("EOF\n");
210:     script.push_str("/bin/busybox chmod +x /sysroot/mnt/start.sh\n");
211:     // Now switch root to /sysroot and run our start script
212:     // Use -- to prevent getopt32 from parsing options inside the wrapper path
213:     script.push_str("exec /bin/busybox switch_root -- /sysroot /mnt/start.sh\n");
214:     script
215: }

251:     #[test]
252:     fn test_shell_escape_fuzz() {
253:         use rand::Rng;
254:         let mut rng = rand::thread_rng();
255:         for _ in 0..10000 {
256:             let len = rng.gen_range(0..50);
257:             let mut s = String::new();
258:             for _ in 0..len {
259:                 s.push(rng.gen_range(0u8..=127) as char);
260:             }
261:             let escaped = shell_escape(&s);
262:             let line = format!("export X={}", escaped);
263:             // Check for dangerous characters outside of quoted context
264:             let mut in_single = false;
265:             for (i, c) in line.char_indices() {
266:                 if c == '\'' && (i == 0 || line.as_bytes()[i-1] != b'\\') {
267:                     in_single = !in_single;
268:                     continue;
269:                 }
270:                 if !in_single {
271:                     if matches!(c, '`' | '$' | ';' | '|' | '&' | '(' | ')' | '{' | '}' | '#' | '!' | '~' | '\n' | '\r') {
272:                         panic!("Unsafe character '{}' found outside single quotes in: {}", c, line);
273:                     }
274:                 }
275:             }
276:             // Verify round-trip: unescape should yield original string
277:             let unescaped = unescape(&escaped);
278:             assert_eq!(unescaped, s, "Round-trip failed for {:?} -> {:?}", s, escaped);
279:         }
280:     }
281:     fn unescape(escaped: &str) -> String {
282:         if escaped.starts_with('\'') && escaped.ends_with('\'') {
283:             let inner = &escaped[1..escaped.len()-1];
284:             inner.replace("'\\''", "'")
285:         } else {
286:             escaped.to_string()
287:         }
288:     }

303:             "${whoami}",
304:             "; rm -rf /",
305:             "| cat /etc/passwd",

308:             "`echo pwned`",
309:             "newline\ncommand",
310:             "newline\rcommand",
311:             "dollar$HOME",
312:             "backtick`id`",
313:         ];
314:         for attempt in injection_attempts {
315:             let escaped = shell_escape(attempt);
316:             // Escaped string should either be quoted or not contain dangerous chars
317:             if !escaped.starts_with('\'') {
318:                 // Unquoted - check no dangerous chars
319:                 assert!(!escaped.contains('$'), "Unquoted string contains $: {} -> {}", attempt, escaped);
320:                 assert!(!escaped.contains('`'), "Unquoted string contains backtick: {} -> {}", attempt, escaped);
321:                 assert!(!escaped.contains(';'), "Unquoted string contains ;: {} -> {}", attempt, escaped);
322:             }
323:         }

 21: fn check_dependencies(data_dir: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 22:     let mut missing = Vec::new();
 23:     // Check for iptables
 24:     if std::process::Command::new("which")
 25:         .arg("iptables")
 26:         .output()
 27:         .map(|o| !o.status.success())
 28:         .unwrap_or(true)
 29:     {
 30:         // Try alternative paths
 31:         if !std::path::Path::new("/sbin/iptables").exists()
 32:             && !std::path::Path::new("/usr/sbin/iptables").exists()
 33:         {
 34:             missing.push("iptables (required for NAT networking)");
 35:         }
 36:     }
 37:     // Check for KVM device
 38:     if !std::path::Path::new("/dev/kvm").exists() {
 39:         missing.push("/dev/kvm (KVM kernel module required for virtualization)");
 40:     }
 41:     // Check for bundled cloud-hypervisor
 42:     let ch_path = std::path::Path::new(data_dir).join("bin/cloud-hypervisor");
 43:     println!("DEBUG: Checking if cloud-hypervisor exists at {:?}", ch_path);
 44:     println!("DEBUG: Metadata: {:?}", std::fs::metadata(&ch_path));
 45:     if !ch_path.exists() {
 46:         // Check in common fallback locations
 47:         let fallback_paths = vec![
 48:             "/usr/bin/cloud-hypervisor",
 49:             "/usr/local/bin/cloud-hypervisor",
 50:         ];
 51:         let found = fallback_paths.iter().any(|p| std::path::Path::new(p).exists());
 52:         if !found {
 53:             missing.push("cloud-hypervisor (not found in data_dir/bin or /usr/bin)");
 54:         }
 55:     }
 56:     if missing.is_empty() {
 57:         Ok(())
 58:     } else {
 59:         Err(missing.join("\n  - "))
 60:     }
 61: }

327:     let public_routes = Router::new()
328:         .route("/health", get(handlers::health_check));
329:     // Build allowed CORS origins from configuration
330:     let mut allowed_origins: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
331:     let http_port = args.http_port;
332:     // Default origin from the daemon's HTTP address
333:     let default_origin = format!("http://{}:{}", args.http_bind_ip, http_port);
334:     allowed_origins.push(default_origin);
335:     // Always add localhost origins for convenience
336:     if http_port > 0 {
337:         allowed_origins.push(format!("http://localhost:{}", http_port));
338:         allowed_origins.push(format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", http_port));
339:     }
340:     // Add user-specified origins
341:     if let Some(ref custom_origins) = args.cors_origins {
342:         for origin in custom_origins.split(',') {
343:             let origin = origin.trim().to_string();
344:             if !origin.is_empty() {
345:                 allowed_origins.push(origin);
346:             }
347:         }
348:     }
349:     // Build CORS layer
350:     let cors_layer = if allowed_origins.iter().any(|o| o == "*") {
351:         warn!("CORS is configured to allow any origin. This is insecure and should only be used in development.");
352:         CorsLayer::permissive()
353:     } else {
354:         let header_values: Vec<http::HeaderValue> = allowed_origins
355:             .iter()
356:             .filter_map(|s| s.parse().ok())
357:             .collect();
358:         info!("CORS allowed origins: {:?}", allowed_origins);
359:         CorsLayer::new()
360:             .allow_origin(AllowOrigin::list(header_values))
361:             .allow_methods([Method::GET, Method::POST, Method::DELETE])
362:             .allow_headers(vec![
363:                 http::header::AUTHORIZATION,
364:                 http::header::CONTENT_TYPE,
365:             ])
366:     };
367:     // Combine: public routes + API routes (with auth) + UI fallback (public)
368:     let app = public_routes
369:         .merge(api_routes)
370:         .fallback(ui::ui_handler)
371:         .layer(cors_layer)
372:         .with_state(state.clone());
373:     let socket_path = args.socket_path;
374:     let path = std::path::Path::new(&socket_path);
375:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
376:         // Try to create directory
377:         match std::fs::create_dir_all(parent) {
378:             Ok(_) => {}
379:             Err(e) => {
380:                 warn!("Cannot create directory {}: {}", parent.display(), e);
381:             }
382:         }
383:     }
384:     // Try to bind, if fails try alternative locations
385:     let actual_socket_path: String;
386:     let listener = match UnixListener::bind(&socket_path) {
387:         Ok(l) => {
388:             actual_socket_path = socket_path.clone();
389:             l
390:         }
391:         Err(_) => {
392:             // Try alternative: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR or /tmp
393:             let alt_dir = std::env::var("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR")
394:                 .map(|d| std::path::PathBuf::from(d))
395:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| std::env::temp_dir());
396:             let alt_socket_path = alt_dir.join("vyoma.sock");
397:             warn!("Cannot bind to {}. Trying alternative: {}", socket_path, alt_socket_path.display());
398:             let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&alt_socket_path);
399:             match UnixListener::bind(&alt_socket_path) {
400:                 Ok(l) => {
401:                     actual_socket_path = alt_socket_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
402:                     warn!("Using alternative socket at {}", actual_socket_path);
403:                     l
404:                 }
405:                 Err(e) => {
406:                     error!("Failed to bind socket at any location: {}", e);
407:                     std::process::exit(1);
408:                 }
409:             }
410:         }
411:     };
412:     // Set socket permissions: root:vyoma (0660) - users in vyoma group can access
413:     let permissions = std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o660);
414:     if let Err(e) = std::fs::set_permissions(&actual_socket_path, permissions) {
415:         warn!("Could not set 0660 permissions on socket: {}", e);
416:     }
417:     // Change socket ownership to vyoma:vyoma so CLI can access it
418:     let pw = unsafe { libc::getpwnam(b"vyoma\0".as_ptr() as *const _) };
419:     if !pw.is_null() {
420:         let uid = unsafe { (*pw).pw_uid };
421:         let gid = unsafe { (*pw).pw_gid };
422:         let path_c = std::ffi::CString::new(actual_socket_path.clone()).unwrap();
423:         unsafe { libc::chown(path_c.as_ptr(), uid, gid); }
424:         info!("Socket ownership changed to vyoma:vyoma");
425:     }
426:     info!("Daemon listening on Unix Socket {}", actual_socket_path);
427:     // Privileges are now dropped before Tokio runtime initialization
428:     // Start HTTP server for dashboard if port is not 0
429:     if args.http_port > 0 {
430:         let http_app = app.clone();
431:         let api_token = args.api_token.clone();
432:         tokio::spawn(async move {
433:             let addr = format!("{}:{}", args.http_bind_ip, args.http_port);
434:             // Warn if binding to non-localhost address
435:             if !args.http_bind_ip.starts_with("127.") && args.http_bind_ip != "::1" && args.http_bind_ip != "localhost" {
436:                 if api_token.is_none() {
437:                     warn!("HTTP server bound on non-localhost address {} WITHOUT authentication! Use --api-token for security", addr);
438:                 } else {
439:                     warn!("HTTP server bound on non-localhost address {} with authentication enabled", addr);
440:                 }
441:             }
442:             info!("Dashboard available at http://{}", addr);
443:             let listener = match tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(&addr).await {
444:                 Ok(l) => l,
445:                 Err(e) => {
446:                     error!("HTTP server failed to bind on {}: {}", addr, e);
447:                     return; // exit the spawned task gracefully
448:                 }
449:             };
450:             loop {
451:                 match listener.accept().await {
452:                     Ok((stream, _)) => {
453:                         let io = TokioIo::new(stream);
454:                         let tower_service = http_app.clone();
455:                         tokio::spawn(async move {
456:                             let hyper_service = hyper::service::service_fn(move |request| {
457:                                 tower_service.clone().call(request)
458:                             });
459:                             let _ = auto::Builder::new(TokioExecutor::new())
460:                                 .serve_connection(io, hyper_service)
461:                                 .await;
462:                         });
463:                     }
464:                     Err(e) => error!("HTTP accept error: {}", e),
465:                 }
466:             }
467:         });
468:     }
469:     let grpc_state = Arc::new(state);
470:     tokio::spawn(async move {
471:         let addr = "[::1]:7071".parse().unwrap();
472:         info!("gRPC interface available at {}", addr);
473:         use vyoma_proto::v1::vm_service_server::VmServiceServer;
474:         let svc = VmServiceServer::new(grpc::GrpcVmService::new(grpc_state.clone()));
475:         if let Err(e) = tonic::transport::Server::builder()
476:             .add_service(svc)
477:             .serve(addr)
478:             .await
479:         {
480:             error!("gRPC server error: {}", e);
481:         }
482:     });
483:     let shutdown_rx = handlers::shutdown_signal(shutdown_state);
484:     let mut shutdown_flag = Box::pin(shutdown_rx);
485:     loop {
486:         tokio::select! {
487:             result = listener.accept() => {
488:                 match result {
489:                     Ok((stream, _)) => {
490:                         let io = TokioIo::new(stream);
491:                         let tower_service = app.clone();
492:                         tokio::spawn(async move {
493:                             let hyper_service = hyper::service::service_fn(move |request: axum::extract::Request<hyper::body::Incoming>| {
494:                                 tower_service.clone().call(request)
495:                             });
496:                             if let Err(err) = auto::Builder::new(TokioExecutor::new())
497:                                 .serve_connection(io, hyper_service)
498:                                 .await
499:                             {
500:                                 error!("Error parsing connection: {:?}", err);
501:                             }
502:                         });
503:                     }
504:                     Err(e) => error!("Failed to accept connection: {}", e),
505:                 }
506:             }
507:             _ = &mut shutdown_flag => {
508:                 info!("Daemon shutting down gracefully...");
509:                 break;
510:             }
511:         }
512:     }
513:     let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&socket_path);
514: }

  20: /// Resolve socket path with fallback to user-writable location
  21: fn resolve_socket_path(default_path: &str) -> String {
  22:     // Try default path first
  23:     if Path::new(default_path).exists() {
  24:         return default_path.to_string();
  25:     }
  26:     // Fallback to user-specific runtime directory
  27:     if let Ok(xdg) = std::env::var("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR") {
  28:         let user_socket = format!("{}/vyoma.sock", xdg);
  29:         if Path::new(&user_socket).exists() {
  30:             return user_socket;
  31:         }
  32:     }
  33:     // Fallback to /tmp (for development)
  34:     let tmp_socket = format!("{}/vyoma.sock", std::env::temp_dir().display());
  35:     if Path::new(&tmp_socket).exists() {
  36:         return tmp_socket;
  37:     }
  38:     // Return default path anyway - let it fail with clear error
  39:     default_path.to_string()
  40: }
