 308: struct RunResponse {
 309:     vm_id: String,
 310:     status: String,
 311: }
 312: #[tokio::main]
 313: async fn main() -> Result<()> {
 314:     tracing_subscriber::fmt::init();
 315:     let cli = Cli::parse();
 316:     // Resolve socket path with fallback to user-writable location
 317:     let socket_path = resolve_socket_path(&cli.socket_path);
 318:     info!("Using socket path: {}", socket_path);
 319:     // Connect via Unix Socket
 320:     let client = Client::builder()
 321:         .unix_socket(socket_path.as_str())
 322:         .build()?;
 323:     // Daemon URL for HTTP requests (goes through Unix Socket proxy)
 324:     let daemon_url = format!("http://localhost:{}", cli.http_port);
 325:     match cli.command {
 326:         Commands::Pull { image } => {
 327:             info!("Requesting to pull image: {}", image);
 328:             let resp = client
 329:                 .post(format!("{}/pull", daemon_url))
 330:                 .json(&serde_json::json!({ "image": image }))
 331:                 .send()
 332:                 .await;
 333:             handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 334:         }
 335:         Commands::Run {
 336:             image,
 337:             vcpu,
 338:             memory,
 339:             ports,
 340:             volumes,
 341:             hostname,
 342:             labels,
 343:         } => {
 344:             info!("Requesting to run image: {}", image);
 345:             let mut port_mappings = Vec::new();
 346:             for p in ports {
 347:                 let parts: Vec<&str> = p.split(':').collect();
 348:                 if parts.len() != 2 {
 349:                     error!("Invalid port format: {}. Use host:vm (e.g., 8080:80)", p);
 350:                     return Ok(());
 351:                 }
 352:                 let host_port = parts[0]
 353:                     .parse::<u16>()
 354:                     .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("Invalid host port: {}", parts[0]))?;
 355:                 let vm_port = parts[1]
 356:                     .parse::<u16>()
 357:                     .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("Invalid vm port: {}", parts[1]))?;
 358:                 port_mappings.push(PortMapping { host_port, vm_port });
 359:             }
 360:             let mut volume_mounts = Vec::new();
 361:             for v in volumes {
 362:                 let parts: Vec<&str> = v.split(':').collect();
 363:                 if parts.len() != 2 {
 364:                     error!(
 365:                         "Invalid volume format: {}. Use host:vm (e.g., /foo:/bar)",
 366:                         v
 367:                     );
 368:                     return Ok(());
 369:                 }
 370:                 volume_mounts.push(VolumeMount {
 371:                     host_path: parts[0].to_string(),
 372:                     vm_path: parts[1].to_string(),
 373:                     read_only: false, // Default RW for now
 374:                 });
 375:             }
 376:             let mut label_map = HashMap::new();
 377:             for l in labels {
 378:                 if let Some((k, v)) = l.split_once('=') {
 379:                     label_map.insert(k.to_string(), v.to_string());
 380:                 } else {
 381:                     label_map.insert(l.clone(), "".to_string());
 382:                 }
 383:             }
 384:             let payload = RunRequest {
 385:                 image,
 386:                 vcpu,
 387:                 mem_size_mib: memory,
 388:                 ports: port_mappings,
 389:                 volumes: volume_mounts,
 390:                 hostname,
 391:                 labels: label_map,
 392:             };
 393:             let resp = client
 394:                 .post(format!("{}/run", daemon_url))
 395:                 .json(&payload)
 396:                 .send()
 397:                 .await;
 398:             handle_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 399:         }
 400:         Commands::Commit { id, new_image_name } => {
 401:             info!("Requesting to commit VM {} to image {}", id, new_image_name);
 402:             let payload = serde_json::json!({
 403:                 "new_image_name": new_image_name
 404:             });
 405:             let resp = client
 406:                 .post(format!("{}/commit/{}", daemon_url, id))
 407:                 .json(&payload)
 408:                 .send()
 409:                 .await;
 410:             handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 411:         }
 412:         Commands::Stop { id } => {
 413:             info!("Requesting to stop VM: {}", id);
 414:             let resp = client
 415:                 .post(format!("{}/stop/{}", daemon_url, id))
 416:                 .send()
 417:                 .await;
 418:             handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 419:         }
 420:         Commands::Pause { id } => {
 421:             info!("Requesting to pause VM: {}", id);
 422:             let resp = client
 423:                 .post(format!("{}/pause/{}", daemon_url, id))
 424:                 .send()
 425:                 .await;
 426:             handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 427:         }
 428:         Commands::Resume { id } => {
 429:             info!("Requesting to resume VM: {}", id);
 430:             let resp = client
 431:                 .post(format!("{}/resume/{}", daemon_url, id))
 432:                 .send()
 433:                 .await;
 434:             handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 435:         }
 436:         Commands::Exec { id, cmd } => {
 437:             // 1. Resolve ID (if Name provided)
 438:             let mut target_id = id.clone();
 439:             let resp = client.get(format!("{}/ps", daemon_url)).send().await;
 440:             if let Ok(r) = resp {
 441:                 if let Ok(list) = r.json::<ListResponse>().await {
 442:                     for vm in list.vms {
 443:                         if vm.id == id
 444:                             || vm.hostname.as_deref() == Some(id.as_str())
 445:                             || vm.labels.get("vyoma.service").map(|s| s.as_str())
 446:                                 == Some(id.as_str())
 447:                         {
 448:                             target_id = vm.id;
 449:                             break;
 450:                         }
 451:                     }
 452:                 }
 453:             }
 454:             let payload = serde_json::json!({
 455:                 "command": cmd
 456:             });
 457:             info!("Executing command in VM {}...", target_id);
 458:             let resp = client
 459:                 .post(format!("{}/exec/{}", daemon_url, target_id))
 460:                 .json(&payload)
 461:                 .send()
 462:                 .await;
 463:             match resp {
 464:                 Ok(response) => {
 465:                     if response.status().is_success() {
 466:                         #[derive(Deserialize)]
 467:                         struct ExecResp {
 468:                             stdout: String,
 469:                             stderr: String,
 470:                             exit_code: i32,
 471:                         }
 472:                         if let Ok(exec_result) = response.json::<ExecResp>().await {
 473:                             if !exec_result.stdout.is_empty() {
 474:                                 print!("{}", exec_result.stdout);
 475:                             }
 476:                             if !exec_result.stderr.is_empty() {
 477:                                 eprint!("{}", exec_result.stderr);
 478:                             }
 479:                             std::process::exit(exec_result.exit_code);
 480:                         } else {
 481:                             error!("Failed to parse execution response");
 482:                             std::process::exit(1);
 483:                         }
 484:                     } else {
 485:                         let error_msg = response.text().await.unwrap_or_else(|_| "Unknown error".to_string());
 486:                         error!("Execution failed: {}", error_msg);
 487:                         std::process::exit(1);
 488:                     }
 489:                 }
 490:                 Err(e) => {
 491:                     error!("Failed to connect to daemon at {}: {}", daemon_url, e);
 492:                     std::process::exit(1);
 493:                 }
 494:             }
 495:         }
 496:         Commands::Restart { id } => {
 497:             // 1. Resolve ID (if Name provided)
 498:             let mut target_id = id.clone();
 499:             let resp = client.get(format!("{}/ps", daemon_url)).send().await;
 500:             if let Ok(r) = resp {
 501:                 if let Ok(list) = r.json::<ListResponse>().await {
 502:                     for vm in list.vms {
 503:                         if vm.id == id
 504:                             || vm.hostname.as_deref() == Some(id.as_str())
 505:                             || vm.labels.get("vyoma.service").map(|s| s.as_str())
 506:                                 == Some(id.as_str())
 507:                         {
 508:                             target_id = vm.id;
 509:                             break;
 510:                         }
 511:                     }
 512:                 }
 513:             }
 514:             // 2. Inspect (to get config)
 515:             info!("Restarting VM {} (Fetching config...)", target_id);
 516:             let resp = client
 517:                 .get(format!("{}/vms/{}", daemon_url, target_id))
 518:                 .send()
 519:                 .await;
 520:             match resp {
 521:                 Ok(r) => {
 522:                     if !r.status().is_success() {
 523:                         error!("Failed to inspect VM {}: {}", target_id, r.status());
 524:                         return Ok(());
 525:                     }
 526:                     let vm_state: VmState = r.json().await?;
 527:                     // 3. Stop
 528:                     info!("Stopping VM {}...", target_id);
 529:                     let _ = client
 530:                         .post(format!("{}/stop/{}", daemon_url, target_id))
 531:                         .send()
 532:                         .await;
 533:                     // 4. Run (New)
 534:                     info!("Starting replacement VM...");
 535:                     let payload = RunRequest {
 536:                         image: vm_state.base_image_path, // Pass resolved path
 537:                         vcpu: vm_state.vcpu,
 538:                         mem_size_mib: vm_state.mem_size_mib,
 539:                         ports: vm_state.ports,
 540:                         volumes: vm_state.volumes,
 541:                         hostname: vm_state.hostname,
 542:                         labels: vm_state.labels,
 543:                     };
 544:                     let resp = client
 545:                         .post(format!("{}/run", daemon_url))
 546:                         .json(&payload)
 547:                         .send()
 548:                         .await;
 549:                     handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 550:                 }
 551:                 Err(e) => error!("Failed to connect to daemon: {}", e),
 552:             }
 553:         }
 554:         Commands::Ps => {
 555:             let resp = client.get(format!("{}/ps", daemon_url)).send().await;
 556:             match resp {
 557:                 Ok(response) => {
 558:                     if response.status().is_success() {
 559:                         let body: ListResponse = response.json().await?;
 560:                         println!(
 561:                             "{:<36} {:<15} {:<15} {:<15} {:<30}",
 562:                             "VM ID", "IP ADDRESS", "HOSTNAME", "ATTESTATION", "LABELS"
 563:                         );
 564:                         for vm in body.vms {
 565:                             let labels_str = vm
 566:                                 .labels
 567:                                 .iter()
 568:                                 .map(|(k, v)| {
 569:                                     if v.is_empty() {
 570:                                         k.clone()
 571:                                     } else {
 572:                                         format!("{}={}", k, v)
 573:                                     }
 574:                                 })
 575:                                  .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 576:                                  .join(", ");
 577:                             let hostname_str = vm.hostname.unwrap_or_else(|| "-".to_string());
 578:                             let attest_str = vm.attestation_status.unwrap_or_else(|| "-".to_string());
 579:                             println!(
 580:                                 "{:<36} {:<15} {:<15} {:<15} {:<30}",
 581:                                 vm.id, vm.ip_address, hostname_str, attest_str, labels_str
 582:                             );
 583:                         }
 584:                     } else {
 585:                         error!("Daemon returned error: {}", response.status());
 586:                     }
 587:                 }
 588:                 Err(e) => {
 589:                     error!("Failed to connect to daemon at {}: {}", daemon_url, e);
 590:                 }
 591:             }
 592:         }
 593:         Commands::Attest { id, .. } => {
 594:             info!("Requesting attestation for VM: {}", id);
 595:             let resp = client
 596:                 .post(format!("{}/attest/{}", daemon_url, id))
 597:                 .send()
 598:                 .await;
 599:             match resp {
 600:                 Ok(response) => {
 601:                     if response.status().is_success() {
 602:                         let attest_resp: serde_json::Value = response.json().await?;
 603:                         let verified = attest_resp.get("verified")
 604:                             .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
 605:                             .unwrap_or(false);
 606:                         let vm_id = attest_resp.get("vm_id")
 607:                             .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 608:                             .unwrap_or(&id);
 609:                         if verified {
 610:                             println!("VM {} attestation: {}", vm_id, "VERIFIED".green());
 611:                         } else {
 612:                             println!("VM {} attestation: {}", vm_id, "FAILED".red());
 613:                         }
 614:                         if let Some(pcr_results) = attest_resp.get("pcr_results").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
 615:                             println!("\nPCR Results:");
 616:                             println!("{:<10} {:<64} {:<64} {:<12}",
 617:                                 "PCR Index", "Expected", "Actual", "Verified");
 618:                             for pcr in pcr_results {
 619:                                 let pcr_index = pcr.get("pcr_index").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0);
 620:                                 let expected = pcr.get("expected").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
 621:                                 let actual = pcr.get("actual").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
 622:                                 let verified = pcr.get("verified").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false);
 623:                                 let status = if verified { "✓".green() } else { "✗".red() };
 624:                                 println!(
 625:                                     "{:<10} {:<64} {:<64} {:<12}",
 626:                                     pcr_index, expected, actual, status
 627:                                 );
 628:                             }
 629:                         }
 630:                         if let Some(error) = attest_resp.get("error").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
 631:                             println!("\nError: {}", error.red());
 632:                         }
 633:                     } else {
 634:                         let error_msg = response.text().await.unwrap_or_else(|_| "Unknown error".to_string());
 635:                         error!("Attestation failed: {}", error_msg);
 636:                     }
 637:                 }
 638:                 Err(e) => {
 639:                     error!("Failed to connect to daemon at {}: {}", daemon_url, e);
 640:                 }
 641:             }
 642:         }
 643:         Commands::Snapshot { id } => {
 644:             info!("Requesting to snapshot VM: {}", id);
 645:             let resp = client
 646:                 .post(format!("{}/snapshot/{}", daemon_url, id))
 647:                 .send()
 648:                 .await;
 649:             handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 650:         }
 651:         Commands::History { id } => {
 652:             let resp = client.get(format!("{}/history/{}", daemon_url, id)).send().await;
 653:             match resp {
 654:                 Ok(response) => {
 655:                     if response.status().is_success() {
 656:                         let json: serde_json::Value = response.json().await?;
 657:                         println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&json)?);
 658:                     } else {
 659:                         error!("Daemon returned error: {}", response.status());
 660:                     }
 661:                 }
 662:                 Err(e) => error!("Failed to connect: {}", e),
 663:             }
 664:         }
 665:         Commands::TimeTravel { id, to } => {
 666:             info!("Requesting to time-travel VM {} to snapshot: {}", id, to);
 667:             let payload = TimeTravelRequest {
 668:                 vm_id: id,
 669:                 snapshot_id: to,
 670:             };
 671:             let resp = client
 672:                 .post(format!("{}/time-travel", daemon_url))
 673:                 .json(&payload)
 674:                 .send()
 675:                 .await;
 676:             handle_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 677:         }
 678:         Commands::Save { id, output } => {
 679:             info!("Saving VM {} to {}", id, output);
 680:             export_vm(&id, &output)?;
 681:         }
 682:         Commands::Load { input } => {
 683:             info!("Loading VM from {}", input);
 684:             import_vm(&input, &daemon_url).await?;
 685:         }
 686:         Commands::Teleport { id, target, bandwidth, progress } => {
 687:             info!("Initiating Live Teleportation for VM {} to target {}", id, target);
 688:             let target_daemon = format!("http://{}:3000", target);
 689:             let status_check = client.get(format!("{}/teleport/status/test", target_daemon)).send().await;
 690:             let use_live_migration = status_check.map(|r| r.status().as_u16() != 404).unwrap_or(false);
 691:             if !use_live_migration {
 692:                 warn!("Target node {} doesn't support live migration, falling back to snapshot/stream mode", target);
 693:                 // Start receiver on the target node
 694:                 let receiver_payload = serde_json::json!({
 695:                     "vm_id": id
 696:                 });
 697:                 let recv_resp = client
 698:                     .post(format!("{}/receive-teleport", target_daemon))
 699:                     .json(&receiver_payload)
 700:                     .send()
 701:                     .await;
 702:                 if let Err(e) = recv_resp {
 703:                     error!("Failed to start receiver on target {}: {}", target, e);
 704:                     return Ok(());
 705:                 }
 706:                 let recv_resp = recv_resp.unwrap();
 707:                 if !recv_resp.status().is_success() {
 708:                     error!("Target refused to start receiver: {}", recv_resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default());
 709:                     return Ok(());
 710:                 }
 711:                 info!("Receiver started on target: {}", recv_resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default());
 712:                 // Send migration from source
 713:                 let payload = serde_json::json!({
 714:                     "vm_id": id,
 715:                     "target_node_ip": target
 716:                 });
 717:                 let resp = client
 718:                     .post(format!("{}/teleport", daemon_url))
 719:                     .json(&payload)
 720:                     .send()
 721:                     .await?;
 722:                 if !resp.status().is_success() {
 723:                     error!("Teleport (fallback) failed: {}", resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default());
 724:                     return Ok(());
 725:                 }
 726:                 println!("{}", resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default());
 727:                 return Ok(());
 728:             }
 729:             let payload = serde_json::json!({
 730:                 "vm_id": id,
 731:                 "target_node_ip": target,
 732:                 "bandwidth_mbps": bandwidth
 733:             });
 734:             let resp = client
 735:                 .post(format!("{}/teleport", daemon_url))
 736:                 .json(&payload)
 737:                 .send()
 738:                 .await?;
 739:             if !resp.status().is_success() {
 740:                 error!("Teleport failed: {}", resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default());
 741:                 return Ok(());
 742:             }
 743:             let text = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
 744:             println!("{}", text);
 745:             if progress {
 746:                 if let Ok(data) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&text) {
 747:                     if let Some(session_id) = data.get("session_id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
 748:                         show_migration_progress(&client, &daemon_url, session_id).await;
 749:                     }
 750:                 }
 751:             }
 752:         }
 753:         Commands::Logs { id, follow: _ } => {
 754:             // 1. Resolve ID (if Name provided)
 755:             let mut target_id = id.clone();
 756:             let resp = client.get(format!("{}/ps", daemon_url)).send().await;
 757:             if let Ok(r) = resp {
 758:                 if let Ok(list) = r.json::<ListResponse>().await {
 759:                     for vm in list.vms {
 760:                         if vm.id == id
 761:                             || vm.hostname.as_deref() == Some(id.as_str())
 762:                             || vm.labels.get("vyoma.service").map(|s| s.as_str())
 763:                                 == Some(id.as_str())
 764:                         {
 765:                             target_id = vm.id;
 766:                             break;
 767:                         }
 768:                     }
 769:                 }
 770:             }
 771:             let resp = client
 772:                 .get(format!("{}/logs/{}", daemon_url, target_id))
 773:                 .send()
 774:                 .await?;
 775:             if !resp.status().is_success() {
 776:                 error!("Failed to get logs: {}", resp.status());
 777:                 return Ok(());
 778:             }
 779:             let mut stream = resp.bytes_stream();
 780:             let mut buffer = String::new();
 781:             while let Some(item) = stream.next().await {
 782:                 let bytes = item?;
 783:                 let chunk = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes);
 784:                 buffer.push_str(&chunk);
 785:                 while let Some(idx) = buffer.find('\n') {
 786:                     let line = buffer[..idx].to_string();
 787:                     buffer = buffer[idx + 1..].to_string();
 788:                     if line.starts_with("data: ") {
 789:                         println!("{}", &line[6..]);
 790:                     }
 791:                 }
 792:             }
 793:         }
 794:         Commands::Build { path, measured, signing_key: _ } => {
 795:             info!("Building image from context: {} (measured={})", path, measured);
 796:             build_image_with_client(&path, &client, &daemon_url, measured).await?;
 797:         }
 798:         Commands::Doctor => {
 799:             run_doctor().await?;
 800:         }
 801:         Commands::Network { command } => match command {
 802:             NetworkCommands::Ls => {
 803:                 let resp = client.get(format!("{}/networks", daemon_url)).send().await;
 804:                 match resp {
 805:                     Ok(response) => {
 806:                         if response.status().is_success() {
 807:                             let networks: Vec<String> = response.json().await?;
 808:                             println!("NETWORKS:");
 809:                             for net in networks {
 810:                                 println!("{}", net);
 811:                             }
 812:                         } else {
 813:                             error!("Daemon returned error: {}", response.status());
 814:                         }
 815:                     }
 816:                     Err(e) => error!("Failed to list networks: {}", e),
 817:                 }
 818:             }
 819:             NetworkCommands::Create {
 820:                 name,
 821:                 subnet,
 822:                 driver,
 823:             } => {
 824:                 let payload = serde_json::json!({
 825:                     "name": name,
 826:                     "subnet": subnet,
 827:                     "driver": driver
 828:                 });
 829:                 let resp = client
 830:                     .post(format!("{}/networks", daemon_url))
 831:                     .json(&payload)
 832:                     .send()
 833:                     .await;
 834:                 handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 835:             }
 836:             NetworkCommands::Rm { name } => {
 837:                 let resp = client
 838:                     .delete(format!("{}/networks/{}", daemon_url, name))
 839:                     .send()
 840:                     .await;
 841:                 handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 842:             }
 843:         },
 844:         Commands::Swarm { command } => match command {
 845:             SwarmCommands::Init => {
 846:                 info!("Initializing swarm...");
 847:                 let resp = client
 848:                     .post(format!("{}/swarm/init", daemon_url))
 849:                     .send()
 850:                     .await;
 851:                 handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 852:             }
 853:             SwarmCommands::Join { ip } => {
 854:                 info!("Joining swarm at {}...", ip);
 855:                 let payload = serde_json::json!({ "seed_ip": ip });
 856:                 let resp = client
 857:                     .post(format!("{}/swarm/join", daemon_url))
 858:                     .json(&payload)
 859:                     .send()
 860:                     .await;
 861:                 handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 862:             }
 863:             SwarmCommands::Ls => {
 864:                 let resp = client
 865:                     .get(format!("{}/swarm/nodes", daemon_url))
 866:                     .send()
 867:                     .await;
 868:                 // Just print raw JSON for MVP
 869:                 handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
 870:             }
 871:         },
 872:         Commands::Up { file, detach } => {
 873:             info!("Processing compose file: {}", file);
 874:             match VyomaCompose::from_file(&file) {
 875:                 Ok(compose) => {
 876:                     println!("Vyoma Compose v{}", compose.version);
 877:                     let stack_name = std::env::current_dir()
 878:                         .ok()
 879:                         .and_then(|p| p.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string()))
 880:                         .unwrap_or_else(|| "default".to_string());
 881:                     let service_order = match compose.start_order() {
 882:                         Ok(o) => o,
 883:                         Err(e) => {
 884:                             error!("Dependency resolution failed: {}", e);
 885:                             return Ok(());
 886:                         }
 887:                     };
 888:                     println!("Services found: {}", service_order.len());
 889:                     // Provision Networks
 890:                     let mut created_networks = HashMap::new();
 891:                     for (net_name, net_config) in &compose.networks {
 892:                         let full_net_name = format!("{}_{}", stack_name, net_name);
 893:                         let req = serde_json::json!({
 894:                             "name": full_net_name,
 895:                             "subnet": net_config.ipam.config.first().and_then(|c| c.subnet.clone()).unwrap_or_else(|| "".to_string()),
 896:                             "driver": net_config.driver.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "bridge".to_string())
 897:                         });
 898:                         let resp = client.post(format!("{}/networks", daemon_url))
 899:                             .json(&req)
 900:                             .send()
 901:                             .await;
 902:                         if let Ok(r) = resp {
 903:                             if r.status().is_success() {
 904:                                 info!("Network {} provisioned", full_net_name);
 905:                             } else {
 906:                                 warn!("Failed to provision network {}: {}", full_net_name, r.text().await.unwrap_or_default());
 907:                             }
 908:                         }
 909:                         created_networks.insert(net_name.clone(), full_net_name);
 910:                     }
 911:                     // Pre-check running services via Daemon
 912:                     let mut service_ids = HashMap::new();
 913:                     let resp = client.get(format!("{}/ps", daemon_url)).send().await;
 914:                     if let Ok(r) = resp {
 915:                         if let Ok(list) = r.json::<ListResponse>().await {
 916:                             for vm in list.vms {
 917:                                 if let Some(s) = vm.labels.get("vyoma.stack") {
 918:                                     if s == &stack_name {
 919:                                         let service_name = vm
 920:                                             .labels
 921:                                             .get("vyoma.service")
 922:                                             .cloned()
 923:                                             .unwrap_or(vm.id.clone());
 924:                                         service_ids.insert(service_name, vm.id);
 925:                                     }
 926:                                 }
 927:                             }
 928:                         }
 929:                     }
 930:                     for (name, service) in service_order {
 931:                         if service_ids.contains_key(&name) {
 932:                             info!("Service '{}' is already running.", name);
 933:                             continue;
 934:                         }
 935:                         info!("Starting service: {}", name);
 936:                         let image_target = if let Some(ref build) = service.build {
 937:                             let context = match build {
 938:                                 vyoma_compose::BuildSource::Path(p) => p.clone(),
 939:                                 vyoma_compose::BuildSource::Config(c) => c.context.clone(),
 940:                             };
 941:                             info!("Building service '{}' from {}", name, context);
 942:                             build_image_with_client(&context, &client, &daemon_url, false).await?
 943:                         } else if let Some(ref img) = service.image {
 944:                             img.clone()
 945:                         } else {
 946:                             error!("Service '{}' has no image or build context", name);
 947:                             continue;
 948:                         };
 949:                         // Prepare Ports
 950:                         let mut port_mappings = Vec::new();
 951:                         if let Some(ports) = service.ports {
 952:                             for p in ports {
 953:                                 let parts: Vec<&str> = p.split(':').collect();
 954:                                 if parts.len() == 2 {
 955:                                     let h = parts[0].parse().unwrap_or(0);
 956:                                     let v = parts[1].parse().unwrap_or(0);
 957:                                     port_mappings.push(PortMapping {
 958:                                         host_port: h,
 959:                                         vm_port: v,
 960:                                     });
 961:                                 }
 962:                             }
 963:                         }
 964:                         // Prepare Volumes
 965:                         let mut volume_mounts = Vec::new();
 966:                         if let Some(vols) = service.volumes {
 967:                             for v in vols {
 968:                                 let parts: Vec<&str> = v.split(':').collect();
 969:                                 if parts.len() == 2 {
 970:                                     volume_mounts.push(VolumeMount {
 971:                                         host_path: parts[0].to_string(),
 972:                                         vm_path: parts[1].to_string(),
 973:                                         read_only: false,
 974:                                     });
 975:                                 }
 976:                             }
 977:                         }
 978:                         let payload = RunRequest {
 979:                             image: image_target,
 980:                             vcpu: service.cpus.unwrap_or(1),
 981:                             mem_size_mib: service.memory.unwrap_or(512),
 982:                             ports: port_mappings,
 983:                             volumes: volume_mounts,
 984:                             hostname: Some(name.clone()),
 985:                             labels: {
 986:                                 let mut l = HashMap::new();
 987:                                 l.insert("vyoma.stack".to_string(), stack_name.clone());
 988:                                 l.insert("vyoma.service".to_string(), name.clone());
 989:                                 l
 990:                             },
 991:                         };
 992:                         let resp = client
 993:                             .post(format!("{}/run", daemon_url))
 994:                             .json(&payload)
 995:                             .send()
 996:                             .await;
 997:                         match resp {
 998:                             Ok(r) => {
 999:                                 if r.status().is_success() {
1000:                                     let body: RunResponse = r.json().await?;
1001:                                     info!("Service '{}' started as VM {}", name, body.vm_id);
1002:                                     service_ids.insert(name.clone(), body.vm_id);
1003:                                 } else {
1004:                                     error!("Failed to start service '{}': {}", name, r.status());
1005:                                 }
1006:                             }
1007:                             Err(e) => error!("Failed to request start for '{}': {}", name, e),
1008:                         }
1009:                     }
1010:                     if detach {
1011:                         println!("(Detached mode selected)");
1012:                     }
1013:                 }
1014:                 Err(e) => error!("Failed to parse compose file '{}': {}", file, e),
1015:             }
1016:         }
1017:         Commands::Down { file } => {
1018:             // 1. Identify Stack Name
1019:             let stack_name = std::env::current_dir()
1020:                 .ok()
1021:                 .and_then(|p| p.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string()))
1022:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "default".to_string());
1023:             info!("Stopping stack: {}", stack_name);
1024:             // 2. Fetch all VMs to find stack members
1025:             let mut vms_to_stop = HashMap::new(); // name -> id
1026:             let resp = client.get(format!("{}/ps", daemon_url)).send().await;
1027:             if let Ok(r) = resp {
1028:                 if let Ok(list) = r.json::<ListResponse>().await {
1029:                     for vm in list.vms {
1030:                         if let Some(s) = vm.labels.get("vyoma.stack") {
1031:                             if s == &stack_name {
1032:                                 // Found a VM belonging to this stack
1033:                                 let service_name = vm
1034:                                     .labels
1035:                                     .get("vyoma.service")
1036:                                     .cloned()
1037:                                     .unwrap_or(vm.id.clone());
1038:                                 vms_to_stop.insert(service_name, vm.id);
1039:                             }
1040:                         }
1041:                     }
1042:                 }
1043:             }
1044:             if vms_to_stop.is_empty() {
1045:                 println!("No running services found for stack '{}'.", stack_name);
1046:                 let _ = std::fs::remove_file("vyoma-compose.state");
1047:                 return Ok(());
1048:             }
1049:             // 3. Determine Order
1050:             let mut stop_order = Vec::new();
1051:             if let Ok(compose) = VyomaCompose::from_file(&file) {
1052:                 if let Ok(order) = compose.start_order() {
1053:                     stop_order = order.into_iter().rev().map(|(n, _)| n).collect();
1054:                 }
1055:             }
1056:             // Add any remaining services from running list not in stop_order
1057:             for name in vms_to_stop.keys() {
1058:                 if !stop_order.contains(name) {
1059:                     stop_order.push(name.clone());
1060:                 }
1061:             }
1062:             for name in stop_order {
1063:                 if let Some(id) = vms_to_stop.get(&name) {
1064:                     info!("Stopping service '{}' (VM {})", name, id);
1065:                     let resp = client
1066:                         .post(format!("{}/stop/{}", daemon_url, id))
1067:                         .send()
1068:                         .await;
1069:                     match resp {
1070:                         Ok(r) => {
1071:                             if !r.status().is_success() {
1072:                                 error!("Failed to stop VM {}: {}", id, r.status());
1073:                             }
1074:                         }
1075:                         Err(e) => error!("Failed to stop VM {}: {}", id, e),
1076:                     }
1077:                 }
1078:             }
1079:             let _ = std::fs::remove_file("vyoma-compose.state");
1080:             println!("Stack stopped and removed.");
1081:         }
1082:         Commands::Scale { replicas, file } => {
1083:             // 1. Load Compose File
1084:             let compose = match VyomaCompose::from_file(&file) {
1085:                 Ok(c) => c,
1086:                 Err(e) => {
1087:                     error!(
1088:                         "Validation Error: Cannot scale without valid {}: {}",
1089:                         file, e
1090:                     );
1091:                     return Ok(());
1092:                 }
1093:             };
1094:             // 2. Identify Stack Name
1095:             let stack_name = std::env::current_dir()
1096:                 .ok()
1097:                 .and_then(|p| p.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string()))
1098:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "default".to_string());
1099:             // 3. Process scale args
1100:             let mut scale_map = HashMap::new();
1101:             for r in replicas {
1102:                 if let Some((svc, count_str)) = r.split_once('=') {
1103:                     if let Ok(count) = count_str.parse::<usize>() {
1104:                         if compose.services.contains_key(svc) {
1105:                             scale_map.insert(svc.to_string(), count);
1106:                         } else {
1107:                             error!("Service '{}' not defined in compose file.", svc);
1108:                         }
1109:                     } else {
1110:                         error!("Invalid count format for '{}'. Expected integer.", svc);
1111:                     }
1112:                 } else {
1113:                     error!("Invalid format: {}. Expected service=count", r);
1114:                 }
1115:             }
1116:             if scale_map.is_empty() {
1117:                 println!("No valid scaling instructions provided.");
1118:                 return Ok(());
1119:             }
1120:             // 4. Get Current State
1121:             let mut current_state: HashMap<String, Vec<String>> = HashMap::new();
1122:             let resp = client.get(format!("{}/ps", daemon_url)).send().await;
1123:             if let Ok(r) = resp {
1124:                 if let Ok(list) = r.json::<ListResponse>().await {
1125:                     for vm in list.vms {
1126:                         if let Some(s) = vm.labels.get("vyoma.stack") {
1127:                             if s == &stack_name {
1128:                                 if let Some(svc) = vm.labels.get("vyoma.service") {
1129:                                     current_state.entry(svc.clone()).or_default().push(vm.id);
1130:                                 }
1131:                             }
1132:                         }
1133:                     }
1134:                 }
1135:             }
1136:             // 5. Reconcile
1137:             for (svc_name, target_count) in scale_map {
1138:                 let running_list = current_state.get(&svc_name).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
1139:                 let running_count = running_list.len();
1140:                 info!(
1141:                     "Scaling {} from {} to {}",
1142:                     svc_name, running_count, target_count
1143:                 );
1144:                 if target_count > running_count {
1145:                     let needed = target_count - running_count;
1146:                     let service = compose.services.get(&svc_name).unwrap();
1147:                     for i in 0..needed {
1148:                         info!("Starting replica {}/{}", i + 1, needed);
1149:                         start_service_helper(&client, &daemon_url, &stack_name, &svc_name, service)
1150:                             .await?;
1151:                     }
1152:                 } else if running_count > target_count {
1153:                     let remove_count = running_count - target_count;
1154:                     // Stop the LAST N instances
1155:                     for i in 0..remove_count {
1156:                         if let Some(id) = running_list.get(running_count - 1 - i) {
1157:                             info!("Stopping replica {} (VM {})", running_count - i, id);
1158:                             let resp = client
1159:                                 .post(format!("{}/stop/{}", daemon_url, id))
1160:                                 .send()
1161:                                 .await;
1162:                             handle_simple_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
1163:                         }
1164:                     }
1165:                 } else {
1166:                     println!(
1167:                         "Service {} is already at target scale ({}).",
1168:                         svc_name, target_count
1169:                     );
1170:                 }
1171:             }
1172:         }
1173:         Commands::Attest { id, manifest, trust_keys, no_verify_signature, format, nonce: _ } => {
1174:             let json_output = format == "json";
1175:             match run_attest(&client, &daemon_url, &id, manifest.as_deref(), trust_keys.as_deref(), no_verify_signature, json_output).await {
1176:                 Ok(verified) => {
1177:                     if !verified {
1178:                         std::process::exit(1);
1179:                     }
1180:                 }
1181:                 Err(e) => {
1182:                     error!("{}", e);
1183:                     std::process::exit(1);
1184:                 }
1185:             }
1186:         }
1187:         Commands::Stats { id, interval, no_stream } => {
1188:             let mut actual_id = id.clone();
1189:             let resp = client.get(format!("{}/ps", daemon_url)).send().await;
1190:             if let Ok(r) = resp {
1191:                 if let Ok(list) = r.json::<ListResponse>().await {
1192:                     for vm in list.vms {
1193:                         if vm.id == id || vm.hostname.as_deref() == Some(id.as_str()) || vm.labels.get("vyoma.service").map(|s| s.as_str()) == Some(id.as_str()) {
1194:                             actual_id = vm.id;
1195:                             break;
1196:                         }
1197:                     }
1198:                 }
1199:             }
1200:             let url = format!("{}/vms/{}/stats", daemon_url, actual_id);
1201:             if no_stream {
1202:                 let resp = client.get(&url).send().await;
1203:                 if let Ok(r) = resp {
1204:                     if r.status().is_success() {
1205:                         if let Ok(stats) = r.json::<vyoma_core::api::VmStatsResponse>().await {
1206:                             println!("{:<15} {:<10} {:<25} {:<10}", "CONTAINER", "CPU %", "MEM USAGE / LIMIT", "MEM %");
1207:                             let limit_str = if stats.memory_limit_bytes > 0 {
1208:                                 format!("{:.2}MiB", stats.memory_limit_bytes as f64 / 1048576.0)
1209:                             } else {
1210:                                 "unlimited".to_string()
1211:                             };
1212:                             let usage_str = format!("{:.2}MiB", stats.memory_usage_bytes as f64 / 1048576.0);
1213:                             println!("{:<15} {:<9.2}% {:<25} {:<9.2}%", 
1214:                                 &stats.vm_id[..12.min(stats.vm_id.len())],
1215:                                 stats.cpu_percent,
1216:                                 format!("{} / {}", usage_str, limit_str),
1217:                                 stats.memory_percent
1218:                             );
1219:                         }
1220:                     } else {
1221:                         handle_response(Ok(r), &daemon_url).await?;
1222:                     }
1223:                 } else {
1224:                     handle_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
1225:                 }
1226:             } else {
1227:                 loop {
1228:                     let resp = client.get(&url).send().await;
1229:                     if let Ok(r) = resp {
1230:                         if r.status().is_success() {
1231:                             if let Ok(stats) = r.json::<vyoma_core::api::VmStatsResponse>().await {
1232:                                 // Clear screen and move to top
1233:                                 print!("\x1B[2J\x1B[1;1H");
1234:                                 println!("{:<15} {:<10} {:<25} {:<10}", "CONTAINER", "CPU %", "MEM USAGE / LIMIT", "MEM %");
1235:                                 let limit_str = if stats.memory_limit_bytes > 0 {
1236:                                     format!("{:.2}MiB", stats.memory_limit_bytes as f64 / 1048576.0)
1237:                                 } else {
1238:                                     "unlimited".to_string()
1239:                                 };
1240:                                 let usage_str = format!("{:.2}MiB", stats.memory_usage_bytes as f64 / 1048576.0);
1241:                                 println!("{:<15} {:<9.2}% {:<25} {:<9.2}%", 
1242:                                     &stats.vm_id[..12.min(stats.vm_id.len())],
1243:                                     stats.cpu_percent,
1244:                                     format!("{} / {}", usage_str, limit_str),
1245:                                     stats.memory_percent
1246:                                 );
1247:                             }
1248:                         } else if r.status() == reqwest::StatusCode::NOT_FOUND {
1249:                             error!("VM {} not found", actual_id);
1250:                             std::process::exit(1);
1251:                         }
1252:                     }
1253:                     tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(interval)).await;
1254:                 }
1255:             }
1256:         }
1257:     }
1258:     Ok(())
1259: }
1260: async fn run_doctor() -> Result<()> {
1261:     println!(
1262:         "{}",
1263:         "Vyoma Doctor - System Health Check".bold().underline()
1264:     );
1265:     println!();
1266:     let mut all_passed = true;
1267:     // Helper to print status
1268:     let check = |name: &str, result: Result<bool>, required: bool| -> bool {
1269:         match result {
1270:             Ok(true) => {
1271:                 println!("{} {}", "[OK]".green().bold(), name);
1272:                 true
1273:             }
1274:             Ok(false) => {
1275:                 if required {
1276:                     println!("{} {}", "[FAIL]".red().bold(), name);
1277:                     false
1278:                 } else {
1279:                     println!("{} {}", "[WARN]".yellow().bold(), name);
1280:                     true // Warn doesn't fail overall
1281:                 }
1282:             }
1283:             Err(e) => {
1284:                 if required {
1285:                     println!("{} {} ({})", "[FAIL]".red().bold(), name, e);
1286:                     false
1287:                 } else {
1288:                     println!("{} {} ({})", "[WARN]".yellow().bold(), name, e);
1289:                     true
1290:                 }
1291:             }
1292:         }
1293:     };
1294:     // 1. KVM Access
1295:     if !check("KVM Device Access (/dev/kvm)", check_kvm(), true) {
1296:         all_passed = false;
1297:     }
1298:     // 2. Cgroups
1299:     if !check("Cgroups v2 (/sys/fs/cgroup)", check_cgroups(), true) {
1300:         all_passed = false;
1301:     }
1302:     // 3. Binaries
1303:     if !check("Cloud Hypervisor Binary", check_binary("cloud-hypervisor"), true) {
1304:         all_passed = false;
1305:     }
1306:     if !check("Virtiofsd Binary", check_binary("virtiofsd"), true) {
1307:         all_passed = false;
1308:     }
1309:     // 4. Networking
1310:     if !check("Vyoma Bridge (vyoma0)", check_bridge("vyoma0"), false) {} // Warn only
1311:     // 5. Rootless Tools
1312:     if !check("debugfs (e2fsprogs)", check_binary("debugfs"), false) {} // Needed for rootless build
1313:     println!();
1314:     if all_passed {
1315:         println!("{}", "Your system is ready for Vyoma!".green().bold());
1316:     } else {
1317:         println!(
1318:             "{}",
1319:             "Some checks failed. Please review the errors above."
1320:                 .red()
1321:                 .bold()
1322:         );
1323:     }
1324:     Ok(())
1325: }
1326: fn check_kvm() -> Result<bool> {
1327:     use std::fs::OpenOptions;
1328:     let path = Path::new("/dev/kvm");
1329:     if !path.exists() {
1330:         return Ok(false);
1331:     }
1332:     // Try to open R/W
1333:     OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(path)?;
1334:     Ok(true)
1335: }
1336: fn check_cgroups() -> Result<bool> {
1337:     // Just check if mount point exists and is cgroup2
1338:     // Simple check: /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers should exist
1339:     let path = Path::new("/sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers");
1340:     Ok(path.exists())
1341: }
1342: fn check_binary(name: &str) -> Result<bool> {
1343:     use std::path::Path;
1344:     // Check standard packaging paths (ADR 021)
1345:     if Path::new(&format!("/opt/vyoma/bin/{}", name)).exists() {
1346:         return Ok(true);
1347:     }
1348:     if Path::new(&format!("/usr/libexec/vyoma/{}", name)).exists() {
1349:         return Ok(true);
1350:     }
1351:     // Check bundled path from package
1352:     if Path::new(&format!("/usr/lib/vyoma/{}", name)).exists() {
1353:         return Ok(true);
1354:     }
1355:     // Check local development path
1356:     if Path::new(&format!("bin/{}", name)).exists() {
1357:         return Ok(true);
1358:     }
1359:     // Check system PATH
1360:     let status = std::process::Command::new("which")
1361:         .arg(name)
1362:         .output()?
1363:         .status;
1364:     Ok(status.success())
1365: }
1366: fn command_exists(name: &str) -> bool {
1367:     std::process::Command::new("which")
1368:         .arg(name)
1369:         .output()
1370:         .map(|o| o.status.success())
1371:         .unwrap_or(false)
1372: }
1373: fn check_bridge(bridge_name: &str) -> Result<bool> {
1374:     let output = std::process::Command::new("ip")
1375:         .arg("link")
1376:         .arg("show")
1377:         .arg(bridge_name)
1378:         .output()?;
1379:     Ok(output.status.success())
1380: }
1381: async fn build_image_with_client(context_path: &str, client: &Client, daemon_url: &str, measured: bool) -> Result<String> {
1382:     let context_path = Path::new(context_path);
1383:     if !context_path.exists() {
1384:         return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
1385:             "Context path does not exist: {:?}",
1386:             context_path
1387:         ));
1388:     }
1389:     // Create tarball to temp file
1390:     let temp_dir = tempfile::tempdir()?;
1391:     let tar_path = temp_dir.path().join("context.tar.gz");
1392:     // Create tar.gz using subprocess for reliability
1393:     let status = std::process::Command::new("tar")
1394:         .arg("-czf")
1395:         .arg(&tar_path)
1396:         .arg("-C")
1397:         .arg(context_path)
1398:         .arg(".")
1399:         .status()?;
1400:     if !status.success() {
1401:         return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to create tarball"));
1402:     }
1403:     // Send to daemon
1404:     let file = tokio::fs::File::open(&tar_path).await?;
1405:     let stream = tokio_util::codec::FramedRead::new(file, tokio_util::codec::BytesCodec::new());
1406:     let body = reqwest::Body::wrap_stream(stream);
1407:     let measured_query = if measured { "?measured=true" } else { "" };
1408:     let resp = client
1409:         .post(format!("{}/build{}", daemon_url, measured_query))
1410:         .body(body)
1411:         .send()
1412:         .await?;
1413:     if !resp.status().is_success() {
1414:         let status = resp.status();
1415:         let text = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
1416:         return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("Build failed ({}): {}", status, text));
1417:     }
1418:     let image_id = resp.text().await?;
1419:     info!("Build complete. Image ID: {}", image_id);
1420:     Ok(image_id)
1421: }
1422: async fn build_image(context_path: &str, daemon_url: &str) -> Result<String> {
1423:     let client = Client::new();
1424:     build_image_with_client(context_path, &client, daemon_url, false).await
1425: }
1426: async fn run_attest(
1427:     client: &Client,
1428:     daemon_url: &str,
1429:     vm_id: &str,
1430:     manifest_path: Option<&str>,
1431:     trust_keys_path: Option<&str>,
1432:     no_verify_signature: bool,
1433:     json_output: bool,
1434: ) -> Result<bool> {
1435:     info!("Attesting VM: {}", vm_id);
1436:     let home = dirs::home_dir().ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("No home directory"))?;
1437:     let (signed_manifest, manifest_source) = if let Some(ref mpath) = manifest_path {
1438:         let path = PathBuf::from(mpath);
1439:         let signed = SignedManifest::load_from_file(&path)
1440:             .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to load manifest from {}: {}", mpath, e))?;
1441:         (signed, format!("explicit: {}", mpath))
1442:     } else {
1443:         let inspect_url = format!("{}/vm/{}", daemon_url, vm_id);
1444:         let resp = client.get(&inspect_url).send().await
1445:             .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to inspect VM {}: {}", vm_id, e))?;
1446:         if resp.status() != StatusCode::OK {
1447:             return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("VM {} not found (daemon returned {})", vm_id, resp.status()));
1448:         }
1449:         #[derive(Deserialize)]
1450:         struct VmInspect { base_image_path: String }
1451:         let vm_info: VmInspect = resp.json().await
1452:             .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to parse VM info: {}", e))?;
1453:         let image_name = std::path::Path::new(&vm_info.base_image_path)
1454:             .file_name()
1455:             .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string())
1456:             .unwrap_or_else(|| vm_info.base_image_path.clone());
1457:         let candidates = [
1458:             home.join(".vyoma").join("images").join(&image_name),
1459:             home.join(".vyoma").join("images").join(&image_name),
1460:         ];
1461:         let mut loaded = None;
1462:         let mut source = String::new();
1463:         for dir in &candidates {
1464:             let sig_path = dir.join("vyoma.toml.sig");
1465:             if sig_path.exists() {
1466:                 match SignedManifest::load_from_file(&sig_path) {
1467:                     Ok(sm) => {
1468:                         loaded = Some(sm);
1469:                         source = format!("auto-discovered signed: {}", sig_path.display());
1470:                         break;
1471:                     }
1472:                     Err(e) => warn!("Failed to load {}: {}", sig_path.display(), e),
1473:                 }
1474:             }
1475:             let plain_path = dir.join("vyoma.toml");
1476:             if plain_path.exists() {
1477:                 match vyoma_image::VmifConverter::load_signed_manifest(&plain_path) {
1478:                     Ok(sm) => {
1479:                         loaded = Some(sm);
1480:                         source = format!("auto-discovered: {}", plain_path.display());
1481:                         break;
1482:                     }
1483:                     Err(e) => warn!("Failed to load {}: {}", plain_path.display(), e),
1484:                 }
1485:             }
1486:         }
1487:         match loaded {
1488:             Some(sm) => (sm, source),
1489:             None => return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
1490:                 "No manifest found for image '{}'. Searched: {:?}. Build image first.",
1491:                 image_name, candidates
1492:             )),
1493:         }
1494:     };
1495:     if !no_verify_signature {
1496:         let mut policy = TrustPolicy::new(true);
1497:         let keys_dir = if let Some(ref kp) = trust_keys_path {
1498:             PathBuf::from(kp)
1499:         } else {
1500:             home.join(".vyoma").join("keys").join("trusted")
1501:         };
1502:         policy.load_trusted_keys_from_dir(keys_dir.clone())
1503:             .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to load trusted keys from {:?}: {}", keys_dir, e))?;
1504:         match policy.verify(&signed_manifest) {
1505:             Ok(()) => {
1506:                 let key_hex: String = signed_manifest.public_key.iter()
1507:                     .map(|b| format!("{:02x}", b))
1508:                     .collect::<String>();
1509:                 info!("Manifest signature verified. Signing key: {}...", &key_hex[..16]);
1510:                 if !json_output {
1511:                     println!("  {}", format!("Manifest signed by: {}...", &key_hex[..16]).green());
1512:                 }
1513:             }
1514:             Err(e) => {
1515:                 error!("Manifest signature verification FAILED: {}", e);
1516:                 return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("Signature verification failed: {}. Use --no-verify-signature to skip.", e));
1517:             }
1518:         }
1519:     } else if !json_output {
1520:         println!("  Note: Signature verification skipped (--no-verify-signature)");
1521:     }
1522:     if !json_output {
1523:         println!("  Manifest: {}", manifest_source);
1524:     }
1525:     let url = format!("{}/attest/{}", daemon_url, vm_id);
1526:     let resp = client.post(&url).send().await
1527:         .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to contact daemon at {}: {}", daemon_url, e))?;
1528:     let status = resp.status();
1529:     if status != StatusCode::OK {
1530:         let body = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
1531:         return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("Attestation request failed ({}): {}", status, body));
1532:     }
1533:     #[derive(serde::Deserialize, serde::Serialize)]
1534:     struct AttestResponse {
1535:         vm_id: String,
1536:         verified: bool,
1537:         pcr_results: Vec<PcrResult>,
1538:         error: Option<String>,
1539:     }
1540:     #[derive(serde::Deserialize, serde::Serialize)]
1541:     struct PcrResult {
1542:         pcr_index: u32,
1543:         expected: String,
1544:         actual: String,
1545:         verified: bool,
1546:     }
1547:     let attest_resp: AttestResponse = resp.json().await
1548:         .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to parse attest response: {}", e))?;
1549:     if json_output {
1550:         #[derive(serde::Serialize)]
1551:         struct JsonOutput<'a> {
1552:             vm_id: &'a str,
1553:             verified: bool,
1554:             pcr_results: &'a Vec<PcrResult>,
1555:             error: &'a Option<String>,
1556:             manifest: String,
1557:         }
1558:         let out = JsonOutput {
1559:             vm_id: &attest_resp.vm_id,
1560:             verified: attest_resp.verified,
1561:             pcr_results: &attest_resp.pcr_results,
1562:             error: &attest_resp.error,
1563:             manifest: manifest_source.clone(),
1564:         };
1565:         println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&out).unwrap());
1566:         return Ok(attest_resp.verified);
1567:     }
1568:     // Human-readable output
1569:     println!("\n{}", "╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗".cyan());
1570:     println!("{}", "║              VM Attestation Report                      ║".cyan());
1571:     println!("{}", "╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝".cyan());
1572:     println!("VM ID: {}", attest_resp.vm_id);
1573:     println!();
1574:     let pcr_names = [
1575:         (0u32, "PCR-0 (Firmware)"),
1576:         (1, "PCR-1 (Firmware Config)"),
1577:         (4, "PCR-4 (Boot Manager)"),
1578:         (5, "PCR-5 (Boot Manager Config)"),
1579:         (7, "PCR-7 (Secure Boot State)"),
1580:         (9, "PCR-9 (Kernel)"),
1581:         (10, "PCR-10 (Initrd)"),
1582:         (14, "PCR-14 (Rootfs)"),
1583:     ];
1584:     let mut passed = 0;
1585:     let mut failed = 0;
1586:     for result in &attest_resp.pcr_results {
1587:         let pcr_name = if let Some((_, name)) = pcr_names.iter().find(|(idx, _)| *idx == result.pcr_index) {
1588:         *name
1589:     } else {
1590:         return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("Unknown PCR index: {}", result.pcr_index));
1591:     };
1592:         if result.verified {
1593:             println!("  [{}] {}: {}", "OK".green(), pcr_name, result.actual.yellow());
1594:             passed += 1;
1595:         } else {
1596:             println!("  [{}] {}: {}", "FAIL".red(), pcr_name, result.actual.red());
1597:             println!("         Expected: {}", result.expected.yellow());
1598:             failed += 1;
1599:         }
1600:     }
1601:     println!();
1602:     println!("PCRs verified: {}/{}", passed, passed + failed);
1603:     println!();
1604:     if attest_resp.verified {
1605:         println!("{}", "  Attestation: VERIFIED".green().bold());
1606:         println!("  VM {} boot integrity is confirmed.", vm_id);
1607:     } else {
1608:         println!("{}", "  Attestation: FAILED".red().bold());
1609:         if let Some(ref err) = attest_resp.error {
1610:             println!("  Error: {}", err);
1611:         }
1612:         if failed > 0 {
1613:             println!("  {} PCR(s) did not match expected values.", failed);
1614:         }
1615:     }
1616:     println!("  Manifest: {}", manifest_source);
1617:     Ok(attest_resp.verified)
1618: }
1619: fn export_vm(vm_id: &str, output_path: &str) -> Result<()> {
1620:     // 1. Locate VM dir
1621:     // HACK: Accessing .vyoma directly. CLI normally shouldn't allow this if daemon is remote.
1622:     // But for MVP, we assume local access.
1623:     let home = dirs::home_dir().ok_or(anyhow::anyhow!("No home dir"))?;
1624:     let vm_dir = home.join(".vyoma").join("vms").join(vm_id);
1625:     if !vm_dir.exists() {
1626:         return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("VM directory not found: {:?}", vm_dir));
1627:     }
1628:     // Check files
1629:     let snap_path = vm_dir.join("snapshot.snap");
1630:     let mem_path = vm_dir.join("memory.mem");
1631:     let cow_path = vm_dir.join("diff.cow");
1632:     if !snap_path.exists() || !mem_path.exists() {
1633:         return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
1634:             "Snapshot files missing. Did you run 'vyoma snapshot <id>' first?"
1635:         ));
1636:     }
1637:     // 2. Create Tarball
1638:     let tar_file = File::create(output_path)?;
1639:     let enc = GzEncoder::new(tar_file, Compression::default());
1640:     let mut tar = tar::Builder::new(enc);
1641:     // Add files with specific names for portability
1642:     tar.append_path_with_name(&snap_path, "snapshot.snap")?;
1643:     tar.append_path_with_name(&mem_path, "memory.mem")?;
1644:     tar.append_path_with_name(&cow_path, "diff.cow")?;
1645:     tar.finish()?;
1646:     info!("Export complete: {}", output_path);
1647:     Ok(())
1648: }
1649: async fn import_vm(input_path: &str, daemon_url: &str) -> Result<()> {
1650:     // 1. Unpack to temp dir
1651:     let file = File::open(input_path)?;
1652:     let tar = GzDecoder::new(file);
1653:     let mut archive = Archive::new(tar);
1654:     let temp_dir = tempfile::tempdir()?;
1655:     info!("Unpacking to temporary location: {:?}", temp_dir.path());
1656:     archive.unpack(temp_dir.path())?;
1657:     // 2. Verify files
1658:     let snap_path = temp_dir.path().join("snapshot.snap");
1659:     let mem_path = temp_dir.path().join("memory.mem");
1660:     let cow_path = temp_dir.path().join("diff.cow");
1661:     if !snap_path.exists() || !mem_path.exists() || !cow_path.exists() {
1662:         return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
1663:             "Invalid export archive. Missing core files."
1664:         ));
1665:     }
1666:     // 3. Call Restore API
1667:     // Need absolute paths for Daemon to access them (Daemon must be on same FS)
1668:     let client = Client::new();
1669:     let payload = RestoreRequest {
1670:         snapshot_path: snap_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
1671:         mem_path: mem_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
1672:         cow_path: cow_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
1673:         original_vm_id: "imported".to_string(),
1674:     };
1675:     let resp = client
1676:         .post(format!("{}/restore", daemon_url))
1677:         .json(&payload)
1678:         .send()
1679:         .await;
1680:     handle_response(resp, &daemon_url).await?;
1681:     // NOTE: TempDir will be deleted when it goes out of scope!
1682:     // But Restore API copies the COW file, so that's fine for COW.
1683:     // However, Snapshot and Mem files are LOADED by Firecracker.
1684:     // Firecracker keeps them open? Or does it read them?
1685:     // Firecracker `load_snapshot` usually loads them.
1686:     // If we delete them too early, restoration might fail if it's async?
1687:     // Actually, `restore_vm` awaits `load_snapshot`.
1688:     // But does `load_snapshot` keep file handle or read into RAM?
1689:     // Firecracker loads into RAM.
1690:     // To be safe, we should probably PERSIST these unpacked files into a new VM directory BEFORE calling restore.
1691:     // But the Daemon creates the new VM directory.
1692:     // Ideally, Daemon should handle import upload.
1693:     // For MVP, we will rely on TempDir not being deleted until function returns,
1694:     // and `restore_vm` waits for success.
1695:     // But wait, `Cow` is copied. `Snapshot/Mem` are READ.
1696:     // If `restore_vm` finishes, the VM is running.
1697:     // Does Firecracker need `memory.mem` to stay on disk after load?
1698:     // Docs say: "The file is mmap()-ed". So YES, it must exist while VM is running?
1699:     // Actually, if it's MAP_PRIVATE, maybe not.
1700:     // If it's backing memory, deleting it is BAD.
1701:     // Safer Approach:
1702:     // Move these files to a permanent location?
1703:     // Since Daemon doesn't know about "Import", we are stuck.
1704:     // Let's rely on standard practice: The User (CLI) is responsible for data validity.
1705:     // We should unpack to a PERMANENT "imports" folder in .vyoma/imports/<uuid>/ ?
1706:     Ok(()) // temp_dir drop here.
1707: }

1737: async fn handle_response(resp: Result<reqwest::Response, reqwest::Error>, url: &str) -> Result<()> {
1738:     match resp {
1739:         Ok(response) => {
1740:             if response.status().is_success() {
1741:                 let body: RunResponse = response.json().await?;
1742:                 info!("Success! VM ID: {}, Status: {}", body.vm_id, body.status);
1743:             } else {
1744:                 let status = response.status();
1745:                 let text = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
1746:                 error!("Daemon returned error: {} - {}", status, text);
1747:             }
1748:         }
1749:         Err(e) => {
1750:             error!("Failed to connect to daemon at {}: {}", url, e);
1751:             info!("Is 'vyomad' running?");
1752:         }
1753:     }
1754:     Ok(())
1755: }

1757:     resp: Result<reqwest::Response, reqwest::Error>,
1758:     url: &str,
1759: ) -> Result<()> {
1760:     match resp {
1761:         Ok(response) => {
1762:             if response.status().is_success() {
1763:                 let text = response.text().await?;
1764:                 info!("Success: {}", text);
1765:             } else {
1766:                 let status = response.status();
1767:                 let text = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
1768:                 error!("Daemon returned error: {} - {}", status, text);
1769:             }
1770:         }
1771:         Err(e) => {
1772:             error!("Failed to connect to daemon at {}: {}", url, e);
1773:             info!("Is 'vyomad' running?");
1774:         }
1775:     }
1776:     Ok(())
1777: }
1778: async fn start_service_helper(
1779:     client: &Client,
1780:     daemon_url: &str,
1781:     stack_name: &str,
1782:     name: &str,
1783:     service: &vyoma_compose::Service,
1784: ) -> Result<()> {
1785:     let image_target = if let Some(ref build) = service.build {
1786:         let context = match build {
1787:             vyoma_compose::BuildSource::Path(p) => p.clone(),
1788:             vyoma_compose::BuildSource::Config(c) => c.context.clone(),
1789:         };
1790:         info!("Building service '{}' from {}", name, context);
1791:         build_image_with_client(&context, client, daemon_url, false).await?
1792:     } else if let Some(ref img) = service.image {
1793:         img.clone()
1794:     } else {
1795:         error!("Service '{}' has no image or build context", name);
1796:         return Ok(());
1797:     };
1798:     // Prepare Ports
1799:     let mut port_mappings = Vec::new();
1800:     if let Some(ref ports) = service.ports {
1801:         for p in ports {
1802:             let parts: Vec<&str> = p.split(':').collect();
1803:             if parts.len() == 2 {
1804:                 let h = parts[0].parse().unwrap_or(0);
1805:                 let v = parts[1].parse().unwrap_or(0);
1806:                 port_mappings.push(PortMapping {
1807:                     host_port: h,
1808:                     vm_port: v,
1809:                 });
1810:             }
1811:         }
1812:     }
1813:     // Prepare Volumes
1814:     let mut volume_mounts = Vec::new();
1815:     if let Some(ref vols) = service.volumes {
1816:         for v in vols {
1817:             let parts: Vec<&str> = v.split(':').collect();
1818:             if parts.len() == 2 {
1819:                 volume_mounts.push(VolumeMount {
1820:                     host_path: parts[0].to_string(),
1821:                     vm_path: parts[1].to_string(),
1822:                     read_only: false,
1823:                 });
1824:             }
1825:         }
1826:     }
1827:     let payload = RunRequest {
1828:         image: image_target,
1829:         vcpu: service.cpus.unwrap_or(1),
1830:         mem_size_mib: service.memory.unwrap_or(512),
1831:         ports: port_mappings,
1832:         volumes: volume_mounts,
1833:         hostname: Some(name.to_string()),
1834:         labels: {
1835:             let mut l = HashMap::new();
1836:             l.insert("vyoma.stack".to_string(), stack_name.to_string());
1837:             l.insert("vyoma.service".to_string(), name.to_string());
1838:             l
1839:         },
1840:     };
1841:     let resp = client
1842:         .post(format!("{}/run", daemon_url))
1843:         .json(&payload)
1844:         .send()
1845:         .await;
1846:     match resp {
1847:         Ok(r) => {
1848:             if r.status().is_success() {
1849:                 let body: RunResponse = r.json().await?;
1850:                 info!("Service '{}' started as VM {}", name, body.vm_id);
1851:             } else {
1852:                 error!("Failed to start service '{}': {}", name, r.status());
1853:             }
1854:         }
1855:         Err(e) => error!("Failed to request start for '{}': {}", name, e),
1856:     }
1857:     Ok(())
1858: }
1859: async fn show_migration_progress(client: &reqwest::Client, daemon_url: &str, session_id: &str) {
1860:     use std::io::{self, Write};
1861:     let status_url = format!("{}/teleport/status/{}", daemon_url, session_id);
1862:     println!("\nMigration progress:");
1863:     println!("{}", "=".repeat(50));
1864:     loop {
1865:         let resp = client.get(&status_url).send().await;
1866:         match resp {
1867:             Ok(r) if r.status().is_success() => {
1868:                 if let Ok(data) = r.json::<serde_json::Value>().await {
1869:                     let status = data.get("status").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("unknown");
1870:                     let vm_id = data.get("vm_id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
1871:                     println!("\rVM: {:20} Status: {:20}", vm_id, status);
1872:                     if let Some(progress) = data.get("progress") {
1873:                         let total = progress.get("total_pages").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0);
1874:                         let transferred = progress.get("transferred_pages").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0);
1875:                         let dirty = progress.get("dirty_pages").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0);
1876:                         let round = progress.get("round").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0);
1877:                         if total > 0 {
1878:                             let pct = (transferred as f64 / total as f64) * 100.0;
1879:                             let bar_len = 30;
1880:                             let filled = ((pct / 100.0) * bar_len as f64) as usize;
1881:                             let bar: String = format!("{}{}", "█".repeat(filled), "░".repeat(bar_len - filled));
1882:                             io::stdout().write_all(format!("\r[{}] {:5.1}% (round {}, dirty: {} pages)\r", bar, pct, round, dirty).as_bytes()).ok();
1883:                             io::stdout().flush().ok();
1884:                         }
1885:                     }
1886:                     if status == "completed" || status == "source_cleaned" {
1887:                         println!("\n\nMigration completed successfully!");
1888:                         break;
1889:                     }
1890:                     if status == "failed" {
1891:                         println!("\n\nMigration failed!");
1892:                         break;
1893:                     }
1894:                 }
1895:             }
1896:             _ => break,
1897:         }
1898:         tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
1899:     }
1900: }

  63: pub async fn shutdown_signal(state: AppState) {
  64:     let ctrl_c = async {
  65:         let _ = tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await;
  66:     };
  67:     #[cfg(unix)]
  68:     let terminate = async {
  69:         let _ = tokio::signal::unix::signal(tokio::signal::unix::SignalKind::terminate())
  70:             .expect("failed to install signal handler")
  71:             .recv()
  72:             .await;
  73:     };
  74:     #[cfg(not(unix))]
  75:     let terminate = std::future::pending::<()>();
  76:     tokio::select! {
  77:         _ = ctrl_c => {},
  78:         _ = terminate => {},
  79:     }
  80:     info!("Signal received, starting graceful shutdown...");
  81:     let ids: Vec<String> = {
  82:         let map = state.vms.lock().await;
  83:         map.keys().cloned().collect()
  84:     };
  85:     if !ids.is_empty() {
  86:         info!("Cleaning up {} active VMs...", ids.len());
  87:         for id in ids {
  88:             let vm_arc = {
  89:                 let mut map = state.vms.lock().await;
  90:                 map.remove(&id)
  91:             };
  92:             if let Some(vm_mutex) = vm_arc {
  93:                 let mut vm = vm_mutex.lock().await;
  94:                 vm.cleanup(&state.cni_manager).await;
  95:                 // WAL: Log VM stop
  96:         if let Err(e) = state.wal.append(&WalEntry::vm_stop(id.clone())) {
  97:             error!("Failed to write WAL entry: {}", e);
  98:         }
  99:             }
 100:         }
 101:     }
 102:     info!("Graceful shutdown complete.");
 103: }
