 154: pub async fn exec_in_vm(
 155:     State(state): State<AppState>,
 156:     Path(id): Path<String>,
 157:     Json(payload): Json<ExecRequest>,
 158: ) -> Result<Json<ExecResponse>, (StatusCode, String)> {
 159:     info!("Request to execute command in VM: {}", id);
 160:     let vm_ip = {
 161:         let vms = state.vms.lock().await;
 162:         if let Some(vm_arc) = vms.get(&id) {
 163:             let vm = vm_arc.lock().await;
 164:             vm.ip_address.clone()
 165:         } else {
 166:             return Err((StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "VM not found".to_string()));
 167:         }
 168:     };
 169:     // Clean IP in case of CIDR notation
 170:     let target_ip = vm_ip.split('/').next().unwrap_or(&vm_ip).to_string();
 171:     let target_addr = format!("{}:9999", target_ip);
 172:     let mut last_error = String::new();
 173:     let mut stream_opt = None;
 174:     for attempt in 0..10 {
 175:         if attempt > 0 {
 176:             tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500)).await;
 177:         }
 178:         match tokio::time::timeout(
 179:             std::time::Duration::from_secs(2),
 180:             tokio::net::TcpStream::connect(&target_addr),
 181:         )
 182:         .await
 183:         {
 184:             Ok(Ok(s)) => {
 185:                 stream_opt = Some(s);
 186:                 break;
 187:             }
 188:             Ok(Err(e)) => {
 189:                 last_error = e.to_string();
 190:             }
 191:             Err(_) => {
 192:                 last_error = "Connection timeout to agent".to_string();
 193:             }
 194:         };
 195:     }
 196:     let mut stream = match stream_opt {
 197:         Some(s) => s,
 198:         None => return Err((StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, format!("Connection failed after retries: {}", last_error))),
 199:     };
 200:     let req = AgentRequest::ExecCommand {
 201:         cmd: payload.command,
 202:         env: HashMap::new(),
 203:         workdir: None,
 204:     };
 205:     let req_json = serde_json::to_vec(&req).map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 206:     let len_prefix = (req_json.len() as u32).to_be_bytes();
 207:     use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
 208:     stream.write_all(&len_prefix).await.map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 209:     stream.write_all(&req_json).await.map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 210:     let mut resp_len_buf = [0u8; 4];
 211:     stream.read_exact(&mut resp_len_buf).await.map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 212:     let resp_len = u32::from_be_bytes(resp_len_buf) as usize;
 213:     let mut resp_buf = vec![0u8; resp_len];
 214:     stream.read_exact(&mut resp_buf).await.map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 215:     let resp: AgentResponse = serde_json::from_slice(&resp_buf).map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 216:     match resp {
 217:         AgentResponse::ExecOutput { stdout, stderr, exit_code } => {
 218:             Ok(Json(ExecResponse {
 219:                 stdout: String::from_utf8_lossy(&stdout).into_owned(),
 220:                 stderr: String::from_utf8_lossy(&stderr).into_owned(),
 221:                 exit_code,
 222:             }))
 223:         }
 224:         AgentResponse::Error { message } => Err((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Agent error: {}", message))),
 225:         _ => Err((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Unexpected agent response".to_string())),
 226:     }
 227: }

 301: pub async fn restore_vm(
 302:     State(state): State<AppState>,
 303:     Json(payload): Json<RestoreRequest>,
 304: ) -> Result<Json<RunResponse>, (StatusCode, String)> {
 305:     info!(
 306:         "Request to restore VM from snapshot: {}",
 307:         payload.snapshot_path
 308:     );
 309:     let home = dirs::home_dir().ok_or((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "No home dir".into()))?;
 310:     let vyoma_root = home.join(".vyoma");
 311:     let images_root = vyoma_root.join("images");
 312:     let vms_root = vyoma_root.join("vms");
 313:     // We still assume alpine:latest base for MVP clone
 314:     let safe_image_name = "alpine_latest";
 315:     let image_store_path = images_root.join(&safe_image_name);
 316:     let base_image_file = image_store_path.join("base.ext4");
 317:     // 2. New VM ID & Dir (Clone from Snapshot)
 318:     let vm_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
 319:     let vm_dir = vms_root.join(&vm_id);
 320:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&vm_dir)
 321:         .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 322:     // 3. New COW File
 323:     let cow_file = vm_dir.join("diff.cow");
 324:     info!("Restoring disk state from {:?}", payload.cow_path);
 325:     std::fs::copy(&payload.cow_path, &cow_file).map_err(|e| {
 326:         (
 327:             StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 328:             format!("Failed to copy COW file: {}", e),
 329:         )
 330:     })?;
 331:     // We don't create empty cow file anymore
 332:     // StorageManager::create_cow_file(&cow_file, size_mb)...
 333:     // 4. Setup Storage Stack
 334:     let base_loop = StorageManager::setup_loop_device(&base_image_file).map_err(|e| {
 335:         (
 336:             StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 337:             format!("Loop base: {}", e),
 338:         )
 339:     })?;
 340:     let cow_loop = StorageManager::setup_loop_device(&cow_file).map_err(|e| {
 341:         (
 342:             StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 343:             format!("Loop cow: {}", e),
 344:         )
 345:     })?;
 346:         use vyoma_storage::DmManager;
 347:         let dm_name = format!("vyoma-{}", vm_id);
 348:         let dm_manager = DmManager::new().map_err(|e| {
 349:             (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("DM init: {}", e))
 350:         })?;
 351:         let base_path = std::path::Path::new(&base_loop);
 352:         let cow_path = std::path::Path::new(&cow_loop);
 353:         let dm_device = dm_manager.create_snapshot(&dm_name, base_path, cow_path)
 354:             .map_err(|e| {
 355:                 (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("DM create: {}", e))
 356:             })?;
 357:         let dm_path = dm_device.path().to_string_lossy().to_string();
 358:     // 5. Setup Network
 359:     // Ensure bridge exists (idempotent-ish)
 360:     let bridge_name = "ign0";
 361:     let bridge_cidr = "172.16.0.1/24";
 362:     // We skip bridge setup here assuming it's up from previous run, or we should just call it safe.
 363:     // NetworkManager::setup_bridge(bridge_name, bridge_cidr)...
 364:     let tap_name = format!("tap{}", &vm_id[0..8]);
 365:     NetworkManager::setup_tap(&tap_name, bridge_name).await.map_err(|e| {
 366:         (
 367:             StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 368:             format!("TAP setup: {}", e),
 369:         )
 370:     })?;
 371:     let random_octet = rand::random::<u8>();
 372:     let safe_octet = std::cmp::max(2, std::cmp::min(254, random_octet));
 373:     let vm_ip = format!("172.16.0.{}", safe_octet);
 374:     // 6. Cloud Hypervisor VMM
 375:     let socket_path = vm_dir.join("ch.sock").to_string_lossy().to_string();
 376:     let mut vmm = VmmManager::new(&socket_path);
 377:     if let Err(e) = vmm.start_daemon(&format!("{}/bin/cloud-hypervisor", state.data_dir), None, false) {
 378:         return Err((
 379:             StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 380:             format!("Failed to start Cloud Hypervisor: {}", e),
 381:         ));
 382:     }
 383:     // 7. Load Snapshot INSTEAD of Boot Source
 384:     if let Err(e) = vmm
 385:         .load_snapshot(&payload.snapshot_path, &payload.mem_path)
 386:         .await
 387:     {
 388:         let _ = vmm.kill();
 389:         return Err((
 390:             StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 391:             format!("Load snapshot: {}", e),
 392:         ));
 393:     }
 394:     // 8. Add Drives (Must match configuration of snapped VM usually, but we are attaching NEW cow)
 395:     // Firecracker snapshot restoration often involves re-attaching block devices.
 396:     // The device ID "rootfs" must match.
 397:     if let Err(e) = vmm.add_drive("rootfs", &dm_path, true).await {
 398:         let _ = vmm.kill();
 399:         return Err((
 400:             StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 401:             format!("Add drive: {}", e),
 402:         ));
 403:     }
 404:     // 9. Add Network
 405:     if let Err(e) = vmm.add_network_interface("eth0", &tap_name, None).await {
 406:         let _ = vmm.kill();
 407:         return Err((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Add net: {}", e)));
 408:     }
 409:     // 10. Resume
 410:     if let Err(e) = vmm.resume_instance().await {
 411:         let _ = vmm.kill();
 412:         return Err((
 413:             StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 414:             format!("Resume instance: {}", e),
 415:         ));
 416:     }
 417:     // Success - Store State
 418:     let proxy_tasks = Vec::new(); // No ports restored for now
 419:     let instance = VmInstance {
 420:         vmm,
 421:         id: vm_id.clone(),
 422:         status: VmStatus::Running, // Restored VMs are considered running
 423:         ch_socket_path: socket_path.clone(),
 424:         tap_name: tap_name.clone(),
 425:         dm_name: dm_name.clone(),
 426:         loop_devices: vec![base_loop, cow_loop],
 427:         cow_file_path: cow_file.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 428:         ip_address: vm_ip.clone(),
 429:         proxy_tasks,
 430:         fs_managers: Vec::new(),
 431:         cgroup_path: {
 432:             let default_vcpu = 2u32;
 433:             let default_mem_mib = 1024u32;
 434:             match crate::vm_service::setup_cgroups(&state, &vm_id, default_vcpu, default_mem_mib) {
 435:                 Ok(path) => path,
 436:                 Err(e) => {
 437:                     warn!("Failed to setup cgroups for restored VM: {}", e);
 438:                     None
 439:                 }
 440:             }
 441:         },
 442:         netns_path: None, // Simplified restore lacks CNI for now
 443:         config_ports: vec![],
 444:         config_volumes: vec![],
 445:         hostname: None,
 446:         labels: HashMap::new(),
 447:         base_image_path: String::new(),
 448:         vcpu: 1,
 449:         mem_size_mib: 512,
 450:         networks: vec![],
 451:         vtpm_manager: None,
 452:         attestation_status: None,
 453:         attestation_task: None,
 454:         last_cpu_sample: None,
 455:     };
 456:     {
 457:         let mut vms = state.vms.lock().await;
 458:         vms.insert(vm_id.clone(), Arc::new(TokioMutex::new(instance)));
 459:     // WAL: Log VM creation and start
 460:     if let Err(e) = state.wal.append(&WalEntry::vm_create(vm_id.clone())) {
 461:         error!("Failed to write WAL entry: {}", e);
 462:     }
 463:     if let Err(e) = state.wal.append(&WalEntry::vm_start(vm_id.clone())) {
 464:         error!("Failed to write WAL entry: {}", e);
 465:     }
 466:     }
 467:     Ok(Json(RunResponse {
 468:         vm_id,
 469:         status: "Restored".to_string(),
 470:         ip_address: vm_ip,
 471:     }))
 472: }
 473: pub async fn time_travel_vm(
 474:     State(state): State<AppState>,
 475:     Json(payload): Json<TimeTravelRequest>,
 476: ) -> Result<Json<RunResponse>, (StatusCode, String)> {
 477:     info!(
 478:         "Request to time-travel VM {} to snapshot: {}",
 479:         payload.vm_id, payload.snapshot_id
 480:     );
 481:     let tm = state.timemachine.read().await;
 482:     let _snapshot = tm.get_snapshot(&payload.vm_id, &payload.snapshot_id)
 483:         .ok_or((StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "Snapshot not found".to_string()))?;
 484:     let home = dirs::home_dir().ok_or((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "No home dir".into()))?;
 485:     let vms_root = home.join(".vyoma").join("vms");
 486:     let source_vm_dir = vms_root.join(&payload.vm_id);
 487:     let snaps_dir = source_vm_dir.join("snapshots").join(&payload.snapshot_id);
 488:     let snapshot_path = snaps_dir.join("snapshot.snap");
 489:     let mem_path = snaps_dir.join("memory.mem");
 490:     let cow_path = snaps_dir.join("diff.cow");
 491:     let restore_req = RestoreRequest {
 492:         snapshot_path: snapshot_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 493:         mem_path: mem_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 494:         cow_path: cow_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 495:         original_vm_id: payload.vm_id.clone(),
 496:     };
 497:     // Forward to existing restore logic
 498:     restore_vm(State(state.clone()), Json(restore_req)).await
 499: }

 548: pub async fn list_vms(State(state): State<AppState>) -> Json<ListResponse> {
 549:     let instances: Vec<Arc<TokioMutex<VmInstance>>> = {
 550:         let vms_map = state.vms.lock().await;
 551:         vms_map.values().cloned().collect()
 552:     };
 553:     let mut summaries = Vec::new();
 554:     for arc_inst in instances {
 555:         let inst = arc_inst.lock().await;
 556:         summaries.push(VmSummary {
 557:             id: inst.id.clone(),
 558:             status: inst.status.to_string(),
 559:             ip_address: inst.ip_address.clone(),
 560:             hostname: inst.hostname.clone(),
 561:             labels: inst.labels.clone(),
 562:             attestation_status: inst.attestation_status.clone(),
 563:             base_image_path: inst.base_image_path.clone(),
 564:             vcpu: inst.vcpu,
 565:             mem_size_mib: inst.mem_size_mib,
 566:         });
 567:     }
 568:     Json(ListResponse { vms: summaries })
 569: }
 570: pub async fn stream_logs(
 571:     State(state): State<AppState>,
 572:     Path(id): Path<String>,
 573: ) -> Result<Sse<impl Stream<Item = Result<Event, Infallible>>>, (StatusCode, String)> {
 574:     info!("Request to stream logs for VM: {}", id);
 575:     let vm_arc = {
 576:         let vms = state.vms.lock().await;
 577:         vms.get(&id).cloned()
 578:     };
 579:     if let Some(vm_mutex) = vm_arc {
 580:         let vm = vm_mutex.lock().await;
 581:         let rx = vm.vmm.subscribe_logs();
 582:         let stream = tokio_stream::StreamExt::filter_map(
 583:             BroadcastStream::new(rx),
 584:             |try_msg| {
 585:                 match try_msg {
 586:                     Ok(msg) => Some(Ok(Event::default().data(msg))),
 587:                     Err(_) => None,
 588:                 }
 589:             },
 590:         );
 591:         Ok(Sse::new(stream).keep_alive(axum::response::sse::KeepAlive::default()))
 592:     } else {
 593:         Err((StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "VM not found".to_string()))
 594:     }
 595: }
 596: pub async fn inspect_vm_handler(
 597:     State(state): State<AppState>,
 598:     Path(id): Path<String>,
 599: ) -> Result<String, (StatusCode, String)> {
 600:     // 1. Check running
 601:     let vm_arc = {
 602:         let vms = state.vms.lock().await;
 603:         vms.get(&id).cloned()
 604:     };
 605:     if let Some(vm_mutex) = vm_arc {
 606:         let vm = vm_mutex.lock().await;
 607:         // ... build json ...
 608:         let (status_str, error_reason) = match &vm.status {
 609:             VmStatus::PendingAttestation => ("pending_attestation", None),
 610:             VmStatus::Running => ("running", None),
 611:             VmStatus::AttestationFailed { reason } => ("attestation_failed", Some(reason.clone())),
 612:             VmStatus::Error { reason } => ("error", Some(reason.clone())),
 613:         };
 614:         let val = serde_json::json!({
 615:             "id": vm.id,
 616:             "status": status_str,
 617:             "error_reason": error_reason,
 618:             "tap_name": vm.tap_name,
 619:             "dm_name": vm.dm_name,
 620:             "loop_devices": vm.loop_devices,
 621:             "cow_file_path": vm.cow_file_path,
 622:             "ip_address": vm.ip_address,
 623:             "cgroup_path": vm.cgroup_path,
 624:             "netns_path": vm.netns_path,
 625:             "ports": vm.config_ports,
 626:             "volumes": vm.config_volumes,
 627:             "hostname": vm.hostname,
 628:             "labels": vm.labels,
 629:             "base_image_path": vm.base_image_path,
 630:             "vcpu": vm.vcpu,
 631:             "mem_size_mib": vm.mem_size_mib,
 632:         });
 633:         return Ok(val.to_string());
 634:     }
 635:     // 2. Check disk (stopped)
 636:     let home = dirs::home_dir().ok_or((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "No home dir".into()))?;
 637:     let state_file = home
 638:         .join(".vyoma")
 639:         .join("vms")
 640:         .join(&id)
 641:         .join("state.json");
 642:     if state_file.exists() {
 643:         let f = std::fs::File::open(state_file)
 644:             .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 645:         let s: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_reader(f)
 646:             .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 647:         return Ok(s.to_string());
 648:     }
 649:     Err((StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "VM not found".to_string()))
 650: }
 651: pub async fn build_image(
 652:     State(state): State<AppState>,
 653:     Query(params): Query<HashMap<String, String>>,
 654:     body: Body,
 655: ) -> Result<String, (StatusCode, String)> {
 656:     info!("Received build request using VM-isolated build system");
 657:     let measured = params.get("measured").map(|v| v == "true").unwrap_or(false);
 658:     if measured {
 659:         info!("Measured build requested via query parameter");
 660:     }
 661:     // 1. Stream body to a temp file (tar.gz)
 662:     let temp_dir =
 663:         tempfile::tempdir().map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 664:     let tar_path = temp_dir.path().join("context.tar.gz");
 665:     {
 666:         // Convert Body stream to AsyncRead
 667:         use futures::StreamExt;
 668:         let stream = body
 669:             .into_data_stream()
 670:             .map(|b| b.map_err(|e| std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e)));
 671:         let mut reader = StreamReader::new(stream);
 672:         let mut file = tokio::fs::File::create(&tar_path)
 673:             .await
 674:             .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 675:         tokio::io::copy(&mut reader, &mut file)
 676:             .await
 677:             .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 678:     }
 679:     // 2. Unpack context
 680:     let tar_file = std::fs::File::open(&tar_path)
 681:         .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 682:     let decoder = GzDecoder::new(tar_file);
 683:     let mut archive = Archive::new(decoder);
 684:     let context_dir = temp_dir.path().join("context");
 685:     std::fs::create_dir(&context_dir)
 686:         .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 687:     archive.unpack(&context_dir).map_err(|e| {
 688:         (
 689:             StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 690:             format!("Unpack failed: {}", e),
 691:         )
 692:     })?;
 693:     // 3. Parse Vyomafile
 694:     let vyomafile_path = context_dir.join("Vyomafile");
 695:     if !vyomafile_path.exists() {
 696:         return Err((
 697:             StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
 698:             "Vyomafile not found in build context".to_string(),
 699:         ));
 700:     }
 701:     let vyomafile = vyoma_build::Vyomafile::parse(&vyomafile_path)
 702:         .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, format!("Failed to parse Vyomafile: {}", e)))?;
 703:     // Check if Vyomafile requests measured boot
 704:     let vyomafile_measured = vyomafile.has_measured_boot();
 705:     if vyomafile_measured {
 706:         info!("Measured build requested via VM_MEASURED_BOOT directive in Vyomafile");
 707:     }
 708:     // Measured build is enabled if either query parameter or Vyomafile directive specifies it
 709:     let measured = measured || vyomafile_measured;
 710:     // 4. Generate build ID and prepare work directory
 711:     let build_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
 712:     let work_dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(&state.data_dir);
 713:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&work_dir)
 714:         .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
 715:     // 5. Determine signing key path from policy config
 716:     let signing_key_path = {
 717:         let policy = state.policy_manager.lock().unwrap();
 718:         policy.get_config().measured_boot.build_signing_key_path.clone()
 719:     };
 720:     // 6. Execute build using VM-isolated BuildRunner
 721:     let mut build_runner = vyoma_build::BuildRunner::new(work_dir.clone())
 722:         .with_measured(measured, signing_key_path)
 723:         .with_cgroups(Arc::clone(&state.cgroups));
 724:     let build_result = build_runner
 725:         .build(&vyomafile_path, &context_dir, &build_id)
 726:         .await
 727:         .map_err(|e| {
 728:             (
 729:                 StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
 730:                 format!("Build failed: {:?}", e),
 731:             )
 732:         })?;
 733:     info!(
 734:         "Build completed successfully: {} -> {}",
 735:         build_id,
 736:         build_result.rootfs_path.display()
 737:     );
 738:     // 7. Return the build ID
 739:     Ok(build_id)
 740: }
 741: pub async fn start_process_monitor(state: AppState) {
 742:     tokio::spawn(async move {
 743:         // Check every 5 seconds
 744:         let mut interval = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5));
 745:         loop {
 746:             interval.tick().await;
 747:             let ids: Vec<String> = {
 748:                 let map = state.vms.lock().await;
 749:                 map.keys().cloned().collect()
 750:             };
 751:             for id in ids {
 752:                 // Get VM Arc
 753:                 let vm_arc = {
 754:                     let map = state.vms.lock().await;
 755:                     map.get(&id).cloned()
 756:                 };
 757:                 if let Some(vm_mutex) = vm_arc {
 758:                     let mut vm = vm_mutex.lock().await;
 759:                     // 1. Check Cloud Hypervisor
 760:                     match vm.vmm.try_wait() {
 761:                         Ok(Some(status)) => {
 762:                             let mut msg = format!(
 763:                                 "Monitor: VM {} Cloud Hypervisor process EXITED (Reaped): {}",
 764:                                 id, status
 765:                             );
 766:                             // Check for OOM
 767:                             if let Ok(count) = state.cgroups.get_oom_kill_count(&id) {
 768:                                 if count > 0 {
 769:                                     msg.push_str(&format!(
 770:                                         " [WARNING: OOM Kill Detected: {}]",
 771:                                         count
 772:                                     ));
 773:                                 }
 774:                             }
 775:                             error!("{}", msg);
 776:                         }
 777:                         Ok(None) => {
 778:                             // Still running
 779:                         }
 780:                         Err(e) => {
 781:                             error!("Monitor: VM {} wait error: {}", id, e);
 782:                         }
 783:                     }
 784:                     // 2. Check VirtioFS
 785:                     let fs_count = vm.fs_managers.len();
 786:                     for idx in 0..fs_count {
 787:                         // Check status with scoped mutable borrow
 788:                         let exit_status = {
 789:                             let fs = &mut vm.fs_managers[idx];
 790:                             match fs.try_wait() {
 791:                                 Ok(Some(s)) => Some(s),
 792:                                 Err(e) => {
 793:                                     error!("Monitor Check Error for FS {}: {}", id, e);
 794:                                     None
 795:                                 }
 796:                                 Ok(None) => None,
 797:                             }
 798:                         };
 799:                         if let Some(status) = exit_status {
 800:                             warn!(
 801:                                 "Monitor: VM {} VirtioFS (vol{}) EXITED with {}. Restarting...",
 802:                                 id, idx, status
 803:                             );
 804:                             // Get Config (Immutable borrow OK now)
 805:                             let host_path = vm.config_volumes.get(idx).map(|v| v.host_path.clone());
 806:                             if let Some(path) = host_path {
 807:                                 let fs = &mut vm.fs_managers[idx]; // Re-borrow mutably
 808:                                 if let Err(e) = fs.start(&path) {
 809:                                     error!(
 810:                                         "Monitor: FAILED to auto-restart VirtioFS for VM {}: {}",
 811:                                         id, e
 812:                                     );
 813:                                 } else {
 814:                                     info!("Monitor: RESTARTED VirtioFS for VM {} (vol{})", id, idx);
 815:                                 }
 816:                             } else {
 817:                                 error!(
 818:                                     "Monitor: Cannot restart VirtioFS (vol{}), config not found.",
 819:                                     idx
 820:                                 );
 821:                             }
 822:                         }
 823:                     }
 824:                 }
 825:             }
 826:         }
 827:     });
 828: }

 896:     pub node_id: u64,
 897:     pub subnet_id: u8,
 898:     pub peers: Vec<swarm::NodeInfo>,
 899: }
 900: fn get_outbound_ip() -> String {
 901:     match std::net::UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0") {
 902:         Ok(s) => match s.connect("8.8.8.8:80") {
 903:             Ok(_) => s.local_addr().map(|a| a.ip().to_string()).unwrap_or("127.0.0.1".to_string()),
 904:             Err(_) => "127.0.0.1".to_string(),
 905:         },
 906:         Err(_) => "127.0.0.1".to_string(),
 907:     }
 908: }
 909: pub async fn swarm_init_handler(State(state): State<AppState>) -> Result<Json<InitResponse>, (StatusCode, String)> {
 910:     let node_id = 1u64;
 911:     let addr = format!("{}:7946", get_outbound_ip());
 912:     let mut swarm_raft = state.swarm_raft.lock().await;
 913:     swarm_raft.bootstrap(addr, format!("init_key_{}", node_id), None, None)
 914:         .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("SwarmRaft Error: {}", e)))?;
 915:     let subnet_id = ((node_id % 254) + 1) as u8;
 916:     info!("Swarm initialized - Node ID: {}, Subnet: 10.42.{}.0/24", node_id, subnet_id);
 917:     Ok(Json(InitResponse {
 918:         node_id,
 919:         subnet_id,
 920:         wireguard_port: None,
 921:         wireguard_key: None,
 922:     }))
 923: }
 924: pub async fn swarm_join_handler(
 925:     State(state): State<AppState>,
 926:     Json(payload): Json<JoinRequest>,
 927: ) -> Result<Json<JoinResponse>, (StatusCode, String)> {
 928:     let client = reqwest::Client::new();
 929:     let leader_addr = payload.addr.clone();
 930:     let join_url = format!("http://{}/swarm/join-propose", leader_addr);
 931:     let req = serde_json::json!({
 932:         "node_id": payload.node_id,
 933:         "addr": payload.addr,
 934:         "public_key": payload.public_key,
 935:         "wireguard_key": payload.wireguard_key,
 936:         "wireguard_port": payload.wireguard_port,
 937:     });
 938:     let response = client.post(&join_url)
 939:         .json(&req)
 940:         .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10))
 941:         .send()
 942:         .await
 943:         .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Failed to contact leader: {}", e)))?;
 944:     if !response.status().is_success() {
 945:         return Err((StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, format!("Join rejected: {}", response.text().await.unwrap_or_default())));
 946:     }
 947:     let subnet_id = ((payload.node_id % 254) + 1) as u8;
 948:     {
 949:         let mut swarm_raft = state.swarm_raft.lock().await;
 950:         if !swarm_raft.is_initialized() {
 951:             let addr = format!("{}:7946", get_outbound_ip());
 952:             swarm_raft.bootstrap(addr, format!("init_key_{}", payload.node_id), None, None)
 953:                 .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e))?;
 954:         }
 955:         swarm_raft.add_node(
 956:             payload.node_id,
 957:             payload.addr,
 958:             payload.public_key,
 959:             payload.wireguard_key.clone(),
 960:             payload.wireguard_port,
 961:         ).map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Failed to add node locally: {}", e)))?;
 962:     }
 963:     let peers: Vec<swarm::NodeInfo> = {
 964:         let swarm_raft = state.swarm_raft.lock().await;
 965:         swarm_raft.get_nodes().iter().map(|n| (*n).clone()).collect()
 966:     };
 967:     info!("Node {} joined swarm - Subnet: 10.42.{}.0/24, Peers: {}", payload.node_id, subnet_id, peers.len());
 968:     Ok(Json(JoinResponse {
 969:         node_id: payload.node_id,
 970:         subnet_id,
 971:         peers,
 972:     }))
 973: }

1005: pub async fn events_handler(
1006:     State(state): State<AppState>,
1007: ) -> Sse<impl Stream<Item = Result<Event, Infallible>>> {
1008:     let rx = state.events_tx.subscribe();
1009:     let stream = BroadcastStream::new(rx);
1010:     Sse::new(tokio_stream::StreamExt::filter_map(stream, |msg| {
1011:             match msg {
1012:                 Ok(data) => Some(Ok(Event::default().data(data))),
1013:                 Err(_) => Some(Ok(Event::default().comment("missed message"))),
1014:             }
1015:         })
1016:     )
1017:     .keep_alive(axum::response::sse::KeepAlive::default())
1018: }

1055:     pub vm_id: String,

1057:     pub bandwidth_mbps: Option<u32>,
1058: }
1059: #[derive(Serialize)]
1060: pub struct TeleportResponse {
1061:     pub session_id: String,
1062:     pub status: String,
1063:     pub message: String,
1064: }
1065: #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
1066: pub struct AdoptTeleportRequest {
1067:     pub vm_id: String,
1068: }
1069: pub async fn adopt_teleported_vm(
1070:     State(state): State<AppState>,
1071:     Json(payload): Json<AdoptTeleportRequest>,
1072: ) -> Result<Json<TeleportResponse>, (StatusCode, String)> {
1073:     info!("Handling POST /adopt-teleported-vm for VM {}", payload.vm_id);
1074:     let home = dirs::home_dir().ok_or((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "No home dir".into()))?;
1075:     let vm_dir = home.join(".vyoma").join("vms").join(&payload.vm_id);
1076:     if !vm_dir.exists() {
1077:         return Err((StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, format!("VM directory not found for {}", payload.vm_id)));
1078:     }
1079:     let ch_socket = vm_dir.join("ch.sock").to_string_lossy().to_string();
1080:     // Query the VM info from the now-running Cloud Hypervisor
1081:     let client = Client::builder()
1082:         .timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
1083:         .unix_socket(ch_socket.as_str())
1084:         .build()
1085:         .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Failed to build socket client: {}", e)))?;
1086:     let response = client
1087:         .request(Method::GET, "http://localhost/api/v1/vm.info")
1088:         .send()
1089:         .await
1090:         .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Failed to query vm.info: {}", e)))?;
1091:     let vm_info: VmInfo = response
1092:         .json()
1093:         .await
1094:         .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Failed to parse vm.info: {}", e)))?;
1095:     // Ensure VM is running
1096:     if vm_info.state != "Running" {
1097:         // Try to resume it
1098:         client
1099:             .request(Method::PUT, "http://localhost/api/v1/vm.resume")
1100:             .send()
1101:             .await
1102:             .map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Failed to resume VM: {}", e)))?;
1103:     }
1104:     // Register the adopted VM in the daemon state
1105:     let vmm = VmmManager::new(&ch_socket);
1106:     let instance = Arc::new(TokioMutex::new(VmInstance {
1107:         vmm,
1108:         id: payload.vm_id.clone(),
1109:         status: VmStatus::Running, // Adopted VMs are considered running
1110:         attestation_status: None,
1111:         ch_socket_path: ch_socket,
1112:         tap_name: String::new(),
1113:         dm_name: String::new(),
1114:         loop_devices: Vec::new(),
1115:         cow_file_path: String::new(),
1116:         ip_address: String::new(),
1117:         proxy_tasks: Vec::new(),
1118:         fs_managers: Vec::new(),
1119:         cgroup_path: None,
1120:         netns_path: None,
1121:         config_ports: Vec::new(),
1122:         config_volumes: Vec::new(),
1123:         hostname: None,
1124:         labels: HashMap::new(),
1125:         networks: Vec::new(),
1126:         base_image_path: String::new(),
1127:         vcpu: 1,
1128:         mem_size_mib: 512,
1129:         vtpm_manager: None,
1130:         attestation_task: None,
1131:         last_cpu_sample: None,
1132:     }));
1133:     {
1134:         let mut vms = state.vms.lock().await;
1135:         vms.insert(payload.vm_id.clone(), instance);
1136:     }
1137:     info!("Adopted VM {} into local state", payload.vm_id);
1138:     Ok(Json(TeleportResponse {
1139:         session_id: payload.vm_id.clone(),
1140:         status: "adopted".to_string(),
1141:         message: format!("VM {} adopted successfully", payload.vm_id),
1142:     }))
1143: }
1144: pub async fn teleport_handler(
1145:     State(state): State<AppState>,
1146:     Json(payload): Json<TeleportRequest>,
1147: ) -> Result<Json<TeleportResponse>, (StatusCode, String)> {
1148:     info!("Handling POST /teleport for VM {} to {}", payload.vm_id, payload.target_node_ip);
1149:     let session_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
1150:     let started_at = SystemTime::now()
1151:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
1152:         .map(|d| d.as_secs())
1153:         .unwrap_or(0);
1154:     let migration_session = MigrationSession {
1155:         session_id: session_id.clone(),
1156:         vm_id: payload.vm_id.clone(),
1157:         source_node: "local".to_string(),
1158:         target_node: payload.target_node_ip.clone(),
1159:         status: "initiating".to_string(),
1160:         progress: None,
1161:         started_at,
1162:         completed_at: None,
1163:     };
1164:     {
1165:         let sessions = get_migration_sessions();
1166:         let mut sessions = sessions.lock().unwrap();
1167:         sessions.insert(session_id.clone(), migration_session.clone());
1168:     }
1169:     let vm_arc = {
1170:         let vms = state.vms.lock().await;
1171:         vms.get(&payload.vm_id).cloned()
1172:     };
1173:     if let Some(vm_mutex) = vm_arc {
1174:         let (ch_socket, mem_size_mib_for_spawn) = {
1175:             let vm = vm_mutex.lock().await;
1176:             (vm.ch_socket_path.clone(), vm.mem_size_mib)
1177:         };
1178:         let target_url = payload.target_node_ip.clone();
1179:         let vms_for_cleanup = Arc::clone(&state.vms);
1180:         // Get local WireGuard IP for trusted source restriction
1181:         let local_wg_ip = state.network_integration
1182:             .lock()
1183:             .await
1184:             .as_ref()
1185:             .and_then(|ni| ni.get_local_wireguard_ip());
1186:         let trusted_ips = local_wg_ip.map(|ip| vec![ip.to_string()]);
1187:         let http_client = reqwest::Client::new();
1188:         let target_api = format!("http://{}:3000/receive-teleport", target_url);
1189:         info!("Telling target node at {} to prepare for reception (trusted IPs: {:?})...", target_api, trusted_ips);
1190:         let res = http_client.post(&target_api)
1191:             .json(&ReceiveTeleportRequest {
1192:                 vm_id: payload.vm_id.clone(),
1193:                 trusted_source_ips: trusted_ips,
1194:             })
1195:             .send()
1196:             .await;
1197:         if let Err(e) = res {
1198:             {
1199:                 let sessions = get_migration_sessions();
1200:                 let mut sessions = sessions.lock().unwrap();
1201:                 if let Some(s) = sessions.get_mut(&session_id) {
1202:                     s.status = "failed".to_string();
1203:                 }
1204:             }
1205:             return Err((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Target node unreachable: {}", e)));
1206:         } else if let Ok(resp) = res {
1207:             if !resp.status().is_success() {
1208:                 {
1209:                     let sessions = get_migration_sessions();
1210:                     let mut sessions = sessions.lock().unwrap();
1211:                     if let Some(s) = sessions.get_mut(&session_id) {
1212:                         s.status = "failed".to_string();
1213:                     }
1214:                 }
1215:                 return Err((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Target node refused: {:?}", resp.text().await)));
1216:             }
1217:         }
1218:         let bandwidth = payload.bandwidth_mbps;
1219:         let session_id_clone = session_id.clone();
1220:         let progress_callback = Box::new(move |progress: TeleportProgress| {
1221:             let sessions = get_migration_sessions();
1222:             if let Ok(mut sessions) = sessions.lock() {
1223:                 if let Some(session) = sessions.get_mut(&session_id_clone) {
1224:                     session.status = progress.status.clone();
1225:                     session.progress = Some(progress);
1226:                 }
1227:             }
1228:         });
1229:         let ch_socket_for_spawn = ch_socket.clone();
1230:         let session_id_for_spawn = session_id.clone();
1231:         let target_url_for_spawn = target_url.clone();
1232:         let adopt_url_for_spawn = format!("http://{}:3000/adopt-teleported-vm", target_url_for_spawn);
1233:         let vm_id_for_cleanup = payload.vm_id.clone();
1234:         let vms_for_cleanup = vms_for_cleanup.clone();
1235:         tokio::spawn(async move {
1236:             let teleporter = vyoma_teleport::sender::Teleporter::new(
1237:                 payload.vm_id.clone(),
1238:                 target_url_for_spawn,
1239:                 mem_size_mib_for_spawn as u64,
1240:             );
1241:             let result = teleporter.teleport_vm_with_config(
1242:                 &ch_socket_for_spawn,
1243:                 bandwidth,
1244:                 Some(progress_callback),
1245:             ).await;
1246:             if result.is_ok() {
1247:                  // Stop the source VM after successful migration
1248:                  {
1249:                      let vm_arc_opt = {
1250:                          let vms = vms_for_cleanup.lock().await;
1251:                          vms.get(&vm_id_for_cleanup).cloned()
1252:                      };
1253:                     if let Some(vm_arc) = vm_arc_opt {
1254:                         let mut vm = vm_arc.lock().await;
1255:                         if let Err(e) = vm.vmm.pause_instance().await {
1256:                             error!("Failed to pause source VM {}: {}", vm_id_for_cleanup, e);
1257:                         }
1258:                         info!("Source VM {} paused after successful live migration", vm_id_for_cleanup);
1259:                     }
1260:                 }
1261:                  // Remove from registry
1262:                  if let Some(_vm_arc) = vms_for_cleanup.lock().await.remove(&vm_id_for_cleanup) {
1263:                      info!("Source VM {} removed from registry after migration", vm_id_for_cleanup);
1264:                  }
1265:                 // Notify target node to adopt the VM
1266:                 let adopt_resp = reqwest::Client::new()
1267:                     .post(&adopt_url_for_spawn)
1268:                     .json(&AdoptTeleportRequest { vm_id: vm_id_for_cleanup.clone() })
1269:                     .send()
1270:                     .await;
1271:                 match adopt_resp {
1272:                     Ok(r) if r.status().is_success() => {
1273:                         info!("Target node adopted VM {}", vm_id_for_cleanup);
1274:                     }
1275:                     Ok(r) => {
1276:                         warn!("Target adoption returned non-success: {}", r.status());
1277:                     }
1278:                     Err(e) => {
1279:                         warn!("Failed to notify target to adopt VM {}: {}", vm_id_for_cleanup, e);
1280:                     }
1281:                 }
1282:                 let sessions = get_migration_sessions();
1283:                 if let Ok(mut sessions) = sessions.lock() {
1284:                     if let Some(session) = sessions.get_mut(&session_id_for_spawn) {
1285:                         session.status = "completed".to_string();
1286:                         session.completed_at = Some(
1287:                             SystemTime::now()
1288:                                 .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
1289:                                 .map(|d| d.as_secs())
1290:                                 .unwrap_or(0)
1291:                         );
1292:                     }
1293:                 }
1294:             } else {
1295:                  // Resume source VM on migration failure
1296:                  {
1297:                      let vm_arc_opt = {
1298:                          let vms = vms_for_cleanup.lock().await;
1299:                          vms.get(&vm_id_for_cleanup).cloned()
1300:                      };
1301:                     if let Some(vm_arc) = vm_arc_opt {
1302:                         let mut vm = vm_arc.lock().await;
1303:                         if let Err(e) = vm.vmm.resume_instance().await {
1304:                             error!("Failed to resume source VM {}: {}", vm_id_for_cleanup, e);
1305:                         } else {
1306:                             info!("Source VM {} resumed after migration failure", vm_id_for_cleanup);
1307:                         }
1308:                     }
1309:                 }
1310:                 let sessions = get_migration_sessions();
1311:                 if let Ok(mut sessions) = sessions.lock() {
1312:                     if let Some(session) = sessions.get_mut(&session_id_for_spawn) {
1313:                         session.status = "failed".to_string();
1314:                     }
1315:                 }
1316:             }
1317:             match result {
1318:                 Ok(_) => info!("Teleportation of VM {} succeeded!", payload.vm_id),
1319:                 Err(e) => error!("Teleportation of VM {} failed: {}", payload.vm_id, e),
1320:             }
1321:         });
1322:         {
1323:             let sessions = get_migration_sessions();
1324:             let mut sessions = sessions.lock().unwrap();
1325:             if let Some(s) = sessions.get_mut(&session_id) {
1326:                 s.status = "in_progress".to_string();
1327:             }
1328:         }
1329:         Ok(Json(TeleportResponse {
1330:             session_id,
1331:             status: "in_progress".to_string(),
1332:             message: "Live migration initiated".to_string(),
1333:         }))
1334:     } else {
1335:         {
1336:             let sessions = get_migration_sessions();
1337:             let mut sessions = sessions.lock().unwrap();
1338:             if let Some(s) = sessions.get_mut(&session_id) {
1339:                 s.status = "failed".to_string();
1340:             }
1341:         }
1342:         Err((StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "VM not found".to_string()))
1343:     }
1344: }
1345: #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
1346: pub struct ReceiveTeleportRequest {
1347:     pub vm_id: String,
1348:     #[serde(default)]
1349:     pub trusted_source_ips: Option<Vec<String>>,
1350: }
1351: pub async fn receive_teleport_handler(
1352:     State(state): State<AppState>,
1353:     Json(payload): Json<ReceiveTeleportRequest>,
1354: ) -> Result<String, (StatusCode, String)> {
1355:     info!("Handling POST /receive-teleport for VM {}", payload.vm_id);
1356:     // Warn if no trusted source IPs provided (insecure mode)
1357:     if payload.trusted_source_ips.is_none() {
1358:         warn!("Receiving teleport for VM {} WITHOUT trusted source IPs; migration port is open to any host!", payload.vm_id);
1359:     } else {
1360:         info!("Receiving teleport with trusted source IPs: {:?}", payload.trusted_source_ips);
1361:     }
1362:     // Create directories
1363:     let home = dirs::home_dir().ok_or((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "No home dir".into()))?;
1364:     let vm_dir = home.join(".vyoma").join("vms").join(&payload.vm_id);
1365:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&vm_dir).map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e.to_string()))?;
1366:     let ch_socket = vm_dir.join("ch.sock").to_string_lossy().to_string();
1367:     let mut vmm = VmmManager::new(&ch_socket);
1368:     // Start Cloud Hypervisor
1369:     if let Err(e) = vmm.start_daemon(&format!("{}/bin/cloud-hypervisor", state.data_dir), None, false) {
1370:         return Err((
1371:             StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
1372:             format!("Failed to start Cloud Hypervisor: {}", e),
1373:         ));
1374:     }
1375:     // Call Receiver with trusted source IPs
1376:     let receiver = vyoma_teleport::receiver::TeleportReceiver::new(PathBuf::new(), PathBuf::new(), "0.0.0.0".to_string());
1377:     if let Err(e) = receiver.start_receiving_with_config(&ch_socket, payload.trusted_source_ips.clone()).await {
1378:         let _ = vmm.kill();
1379:         return Err((StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Failed to set receive-migration mode: {}", e)));
1380:     }
1381:     // We leave it running. Sender will connect to port 9000 and it will resume automatically.
1382:     // The VM state should probably be adopted by the daemon after migration completes.
1383:     // In a complete implementation, we would wait for it and insert into `state.vms`.
1384:     Ok(format!("Cloud Hypervisor ready to receive VM {} on TCP port 9000 (trusted sources: {:?})", payload.vm_id, payload.trusted_source_ips))
1385: }

1429: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
1430: pub struct AttestResponse {
1431:     pub vm_id: String,
1432:     pub verified: bool,
1433:     pub pcr_results: Vec<PcrResult>,
1434:     pub error: Option<String>,
1435: }
1436: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
1437: pub struct PcrResult {
1438:     pub pcr_index: u32,
1439:     pub expected: String,
1440:     pub actual: String,
1441:     pub verified: bool,
1442: }
1443: pub async fn attest_vm_handler(
1444:     State(state): State<AppState>,
1445:     Path(id): Path<String>,
1446: ) -> Result<Json<AttestResponse>, (StatusCode, String)> {
1447:     info!("Attestation request for VM {}", id);
1448:     let vm_arc = {
1449:         let vms = state.vms.lock().await;
1450:         vms.get(&id).cloned()
1451:     };
1452:     let vm_arc = match vm_arc {
1453:         Some(arc) => arc,
1454:         None => {
1455:             return Err((
1456:                 StatusCode::NOT_FOUND,
1457:                 format!("VM {} not found", id),
1458:             ));
1459:         }
1460:     };
1461:     let tpm_socket = {
1462:         let vm = vm_arc.lock().await;
1463:         vm.vtpm_manager.as_ref().map(|vtpm| vtpm.socket_path().to_string())
1464:     };
1465:     let tpm_socket = match tpm_socket {
1466:         Some(s) => s,
1467:         None => {
1468:             return Err((
1469:                 StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
1470:                 format!("VM {} has no vTPM - measured boot not enabled", id),
1471:             ));
1472:         }
1473:     };
1474:     // Build attestation config from policy (same as boot-time does)
1475:     let config = crate::vm_service::policy::build_attestation_config(&Arc::new(state.clone()));
1476:     let image_name = resolve_image_name_from_path(&vm_arc.lock().await.base_image_path);
1477:     // Call the shared verification function
1478:     let result = crate::vm_service::policy::verify_attestation_from_manifest(
1479:         &image_name,
1480:         &tpm_socket,
1481:         &config,
1482:     ).await.map_err(|e| (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, e))?;
1483:     // Map policy PcrResult to handler PcrResult
1484:     let pcr_results = result.pcr_results.into_iter().map(|pcr| PcrResult {
1485:         pcr_index: pcr.pcr_index,
1486:         expected: pcr.expected,
1487:         actual: pcr.actual,
1488:         verified: pcr.verified,
1489:     }).collect();
1490:     let verified = result.verified;
1491:     info!(
1492:         "Attestation for VM {}: {}",
1493:         id,
1494:         if verified { "VERIFIED" } else { "FAILED" }
1495:     );
1496:     // Update the VM instance's attestation status
1497:     {
1498:         let mut vm = vm_arc.lock().await;
1499:         vm.attestation_status = Some(if verified {
1500:             "VERIFIED".to_string()
1501:         } else {
1502:             "FAILED".to_string()
1503:         });
1504:     }
1505:     Ok(Json(AttestResponse {
1506:         vm_id: id,
1507:         verified,
1508:         pcr_results,
1509:         error: result.error,
1510:     }))
1511: }
1512: fn resolve_image_name_from_path(base_image_path: &str) -> String {
1513:     use std::path::Path;
1514:     if let Some(path) = Path::new(base_image_path).parent() {
1515:         if let Some(name) = path.file_name() {
1516:             return name.to_string_lossy().to_string();
1517:         }
1518:     }
1519:     base_image_path.to_string()
1520: }
1521: pub async fn set_policy_handler(
1522:     State(state): State<AppState>,
1523:     Json(payload): Json<PolicyRequest>,
1524: ) -> Result<Json<PolicyResponse>, (StatusCode, String)> {
1525:     info!("Setting policy: {} to {}", payload.policy, payload.enabled);
1526:     match payload.policy.as_str() {
1527:         "require-measured-boot" => {
1528:             let mut policy = state.policy_manager.lock().unwrap();
1529:             policy.set_require_measured_boot(payload.enabled);
1530:             let message = if payload.enabled {
1531:                 "Measured boot policy enabled. VMs will require TPM attestation."
1532:             } else {
1533:                 "Measured boot policy disabled."
1534:             };
1535:             Ok(Json(PolicyResponse {
1536:                 policy: payload.policy,
1537:                 enabled: payload.enabled,
1538:                 message: message.to_string(),
1539:             }))
1540:         }
1541:         _ => Err((
1542:             StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
1543:             format!("Unknown policy: {}", payload.policy),
1544:         )),
1545:     }
1546: }
1547: pub async fn get_policy_handler(
1548:     State(state): State<AppState>,
1549: ) -> Result<Json<Vec<PolicyResponse>>, (StatusCode, String)> {
1550:     let policy = state.policy_manager.lock().unwrap();
1551:     let config = policy.get_config();
1552:     let status = PolicyStatus::from_config(config);
1553:     let responses: Vec<PolicyResponse> = status.into_iter().map(|s| PolicyResponse {
1554:         policy: s.policy_name,
1555:         enabled: s.enabled,
1556:         message: if s.enforced { "enforced" } else { "optional" }.to_string(),
1557:     }).collect();
1558:     Ok(Json(responses))
1559: }
1560: pub async fn get_vm_stats(
1561:     State(state): State<AppState>,
1562:     Path(id): Path<String>,
1563: ) -> Result<Json<vyoma_core::api::VmStatsResponse>, (StatusCode, String)> {
1564:     let vm_arc = {
1565:         let vms = state.vms.lock().await;
1566:         vms.get(&id).cloned()
1567:     };
1568:     if vm_arc.is_none() {
1569:         return Err((StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "VM not found".into()));
1570:     }
1571:     let vm_mutex = vm_arc.unwrap();
1572:     let mut vm = vm_mutex.lock().await;
1573:     let usage_usec = state.cgroups.get_cpu_usage_usec(&vm.id).unwrap_or(0);
1574:     let now = std::time::Instant::now();
1575:     let cpu_percent = if let Some((prev_usage, prev_instant)) = vm.last_cpu_sample {
1576:         let delta_usec = usage_usec.saturating_sub(prev_usage);
1577:         let delta_time = now.duration_since(prev_instant).as_micros() as u64;
1578:         if delta_time > 0 {
1579:             let num_cpus = vm.vcpu as f64;
1580:             (delta_usec as f64 / delta_time as f64) * 100.0 * num_cpus
1581:         } else {
1582:             0.0
1583:         }
1584:     } else {
1585:         0.0 // first sample
1586:     };
1587:     vm.last_cpu_sample = Some((usage_usec, now));
1588:     let mem_current = state.cgroups.get_memory_current(&vm.id).unwrap_or(0);
1589:     let mem_max = state.cgroups.get_memory_max(&vm.id).unwrap_or(0);
1590:     let mem_percent = if mem_max > 0 {
1591:         (mem_current as f64 / mem_max as f64) * 100.0
1592:     } else {
1593:         0.0
1594:     };
1595:     Ok(Json(vyoma_core::api::VmStatsResponse {
1596:         vm_id: id,
1597:         cpu_percent,
1598:         memory_usage_bytes: mem_current,
1599:         memory_limit_bytes: mem_max,
1600:         memory_percent: mem_percent,
1601:     }))
1602: }

  1: #!/bin/bash
  2: set -e
  3: # Locate cargo (works with rustup and system installs)
  4: if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  5:     CARGO=$(command -v cargo)
  6: elif [ -f "$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo" ]; then
  7:     CARGO="$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo"
  8: else
  9:     echo "Error: cargo not found. Install Rust from https://rustup.rs"
 10:     exit 1
 11: fi
 12: VERSION="2.9.0"
 13: ARCH="amd64"
 14: PKG_NAME="vyoma"
 15: WORK_DIR="target/debian/${PKG_NAME}_${VERSION}_${ARCH}"
 16: # Hardcoded checksums for binary verification
 17: # Computed from official release sources
 18: CLOUD_HYPERVISOR_CHECKSUM="8a013003ae29f59da7b2d7ac67f19eea3ea535166dac00ff5e8c2c27ac643f8a"
 19: CNI_PLUGINS_CHECKSUM="77baa2f669980a82255ffa2f2717de823992480271ee778aa51a9c60ae89ff9b"
 20: # Verify checksum of a downloaded file
 21: # Usage: verify_checksum <file> <expected_sha256>
 22: verify_checksum() {
 23:     local file="$1"
 24:     local expected="$2"
 25:     if [ "$VYOMA_SKIP_CHECKSUM" = "1" ]; then
 26:         echo "Skipping checksum verification (VYOMA_SKIP_CHECKSUM=1)"
 27:         return 0
 28:     fi
 29:     if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
 30:         echo "Error: file $file not found for checksum verification"
 31:         return 1
 32:     fi
 33:     local actual
 34:     actual=$(sha256sum "$file" | awk '{print $1}')
 35:     if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then
 36:         echo "CHECKSUM MISMATCH for $file"
 37:         echo "Expected: $expected"
 38:         echo "Actual:   $actual"
 39:         return 1
 40:     fi
 41:     echo "Checksum OK: $file"
 42:     return 0
 43: }
 44: echo "Building Vyoma v${VERSION} for Debian..."
 45: # 1. Build Binaries
 46: "$CARGO" build --release --bin vyomad --bin vyoma
 47: rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
 48: "$CARGO" build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl --bin vyoma-agent-vm
 49: # 2. Prepare Directory Structure
 50: mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/usr/bin"
 51: mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma"
 52: mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/etc/systemd/system"
 53: mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/DEBIAN"
 54: # 3. Fetch & Copy Dependencies (Cloud Hypervisor, Virtiofsd, CNI plugins)
 55: echo "Fetching dependencies..."
 56: # Fetch Cloud Hypervisor with checksum verification
 57: if [ ! -f "cloud-hypervisor" ]; then
 58:     echo "Downloading cloud-hypervisor v41.0..."
 59:     wget -q -O cloud-hypervisor https://github.com/cloud-hypervisor/cloud-hypervisor/releases/download/v41.0/cloud-hypervisor
 60:     chmod +x cloud-hypervisor
 61: fi
 62: echo "Verifying cloud-hypervisor checksum..."
 63: if ! verify_checksum "cloud-hypervisor" "$CLOUD_HYPERVISOR_CHECKSUM"; then
 64:     echo "ERROR: cloud-hypervisor checksum verification failed!"
 65:     rm -f cloud-hypervisor
 66:     exit 1
 67: fi
 68: # Fetch CNI plugins with checksum verification
 69: CNI_VERSION="v1.5.1"
 70: CNI_DIR="${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma/cni"
 71: echo "Fetching CNI plugins..."
 72: mkdir -p "${CNI_DIR}/bin"
 73: if [ ! -f "cni-plugins.tgz" ]; then
 74:     echo "Downloading CNI plugins ${CNI_VERSION}..."
 75:     wget -q -O cni-plugins.tgz "https://github.com/containernetworking/plugins/releases/download/${CNI_VERSION}/cni-plugins-linux-amd64-${CNI_VERSION}.tgz"
 76: fi
 77: echo "Verifying CNI plugins checksum..."
 78: if ! verify_checksum "cni-plugins.tgz" "$CNI_PLUGINS_CHECKSUM"; then
 79:     echo "ERROR: CNI plugins checksum verification failed!"
 80:     rm -f cni-plugins.tgz
 81:     exit 1
 82: fi
 83: tar -xzf cni-plugins.tgz -C "${CNI_DIR}/bin/"
 84: # Fetch virtiofsd with fallback URLs (no checksum - sources unreliable)
 85: VIRTIOFSD_VERSION="1.11.1"
 86: VIRTIOFSD_DIR="${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma"
 87: echo "Fetching virtiofsd..."
 88: # Build UI (optional - requires Node.js)
 89: echo "Building UI..."
 90: if command -v npm &> /dev/null; then
 91:     cd ui
 92:     npm install
 93:     npm run build
 94:     cd ..
 95:     mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma"
 96:     cp -r ui/dist "${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma/ui"
 97:     echo "UI bundled successfully"
 98: else
 99:     echo "Skipping UI build (npm not found)"
100: fi
101: if [ ! -f "virtiofsd" ]; then
102:     # Primary: GitLab releases
103:     PRIMARY_URL="https://gitlab.com/virtio-fs/virtiofsd/-/releases/${VIRTIOFSD_VERSION}/downloads/virtiofsd-v${VIRTIOFSD_VERSION}-x86_64-musl.zip"
104:     if wget -q -O virtiofsd.zip "$PRIMARY_URL" 2>/dev/null; then
105:         unzip -q -o virtiofsd.zip
106:         mv virtiofsd virtiofsd_bin 2>/dev/null || true
107:         chmod +x virtiofsd_bin 2>/dev/null || true
108:     fi
109: fi
110: # Fallback 1: Try QEMU GitHub raw
111: if [ ! -f "virtiofsd_bin" ]; then
112:     FALLBACK_URL1="https://github.com/qemu/qemu/raw/main/contrib/virtiofsd/virtiofsd-x86_64"
113:     if wget -q -O virtiofsd "$FALLBACK_URL1" 2>/dev/null; then
114:         mv virtiofsd virtiofsd_bin
115:         chmod +x virtiofsd_bin
116:     fi
117: fi
118: # Fallback 2: Try another mirror
119: if [ ! -f "virtiofsd_bin" ]; then
120:     FALLBACK_URL2="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qemu/qemu/master/contrib/virtiofsd/virtiofsd-x86_64"
121:     if wget -q -O virtiofsd "$FALLBACK_URL2" 2>/dev/null; then
122:         mv virtiofsd virtiofsd_bin
123:         chmod +x virtiofsd_bin
124:     fi
125: fi
126: # Check if we got virtiofsd
127: if [ -f "virtiofsd_bin" ]; then
128:     echo "virtiofsd fetched successfully"
129:     cp virtiofsd_bin "${VIRTIOFSD_DIR}/virtiofsd"
130:     chmod +x "${VIRTIOFSD_DIR}/virtiofsd"
131: else
132:     echo "Warning: virtiofsd not available - volume mounts may not work"
133: fi
134: # 4. Copy Assets
135: cp target/release/vyomad "${WORK_DIR}/usr/bin/"
136: cp target/release/vyoma "${WORK_DIR}/usr/bin/"
137: cp target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/vyoma-agent-vm "${WORK_DIR}/usr/bin/vyoma-agent-vm"
138: cp cloud-hypervisor "${WORK_DIR}/usr/bin/cloud-hypervisor"
139: cp packaging/systemd/vyomad.service "${WORK_DIR}/etc/systemd/system/"
140: cp packaging/systemd/vyoma-net.service "${WORK_DIR}/etc/systemd/system/"
141: # Copy kernel and cloud-hypervisor to data directory
142: mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/var/lib/vyoma/bin"
143: KERNEL_URL="https://github.com/cloud-hypervisor/linux/releases/download/ch-release-v6.16.9-20260508/bzImage-x86_64"
144: KERNEL_DEST="${WORK_DIR}/var/lib/vyoma/bin/vmlinux"
145: if [ ! -f "kernel.bzimage" ]; then
146:     if [ -f "/tmp/vyoma-bzImage" ]; then
147:         echo "Using locally compiled custom kernel from /tmp/vyoma-bzImage..."
148:         cp /tmp/vyoma-bzImage kernel.bzimage
149:     else
150:         echo "Downloading custom Vyoma kernel..."
151:         wget -q -O kernel.bzimage "$KERNEL_URL" || curl -L -o kernel.bzimage "$KERNEL_URL"
152:     fi
153: fi
154: cp kernel.bzimage "$KERNEL_DEST"
155: chmod 644 "$KERNEL_DEST"
156: echo "Kernel binary bundled"
157: # Also place Cloud Hypervisor where the daemon expects it
158: cp cloud-hypervisor "${WORK_DIR}/var/lib/vyoma/bin/cloud-hypervisor"
159: chmod 755 "${WORK_DIR}/var/lib/vyoma/bin/cloud-hypervisor"
160: echo "Cloud Hypervisor bundled to /var/lib/vyoma/bin"
161: # Bundle virtiofsd (from system or project bin)
162: if [ -f "bin/virtiofsd" ] && [ ! -L "bin/virtiofsd" ]; then
163:     cp bin/virtiofsd "${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma/virtiofsd"
164:     chmod +x "${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma/virtiofsd"
165:     echo "virtiofsd bundled from project bin"
166: elif [ -f "/usr/libexec/virtiofsd" ]; then
167:     cp /usr/libexec/virtiofsd "${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma/virtiofsd"
168:     chmod +x "${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma/virtiofsd"
169:     echo "virtiofsd bundled from system"
170: elif [ -f "/usr/bin/virtiofsd" ]; then
171:     cp /usr/bin/virtiofsd "${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma/virtiofsd"
172:     chmod +x "${WORK_DIR}/usr/lib/vyoma/virtiofsd"
173:     echo "virtiofsd bundled from /usr/bin"
174: else
175:     echo "Warning: virtiofsd not found - volume mounts may not work"
176: fi
177: # 5. Create Control File
178: cat <<EOF > "${WORK_DIR}/DEBIAN/control"
179: Package: ${PKG_NAME}
180: Version: ${VERSION}
181: Section: admin
182: Priority: optional
183: Architecture: ${ARCH}
184: Depends: libc6, openssl, ca-certificates, iptables, kmod
185: Maintainer: Subeshrock <subesh.rock.3@gmail.com>
186: Description: Vyoma - MicroVM Ecosystem
187:  Docker-like experience for Cloud Hypervisor MicroVMs.
188:  Includes Daemon, CLI, Web UI, and virtiofsd for volume mounts.
189: EOF
190: # 6. Create Post-Install Script
191: # $2 = previous version (empty if fresh install)
192: cat <<'POSTINST' > "${WORK_DIR}/DEBIAN/postinst"
193: #!/bin/bash
194: set -e
195: # Create vyoma user (for socket ownership) - idempotent
196: if ! id vyoma >/dev/null 2>&1; then
197:     useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin --comment "Vyoma MicroVM Daemon" vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
198: fi
199: # Add installing user to vyoma, kvm and disk groups
200: if [ -n "$SUDO_USER" ]; then
201:     usermod -aG vyoma "$SUDO_USER" 2>/dev/null || true
202:     usermod -aG kvm "$SUDO_USER" 2>/dev/null || true
203:     usermod -aG disk "$SUDO_USER" 2>/dev/null || true
204:     echo "Added $SUDO_USER to vyoma, kvm and disk groups. Log out and back in to use CLI."
205: fi
206: # Add vyoma daemon user to kvm and disk groups (for /dev/kvm and /dev/mapper/control access)
207: if getent group kvm > /dev/null 2>&1; then
208:     usermod -aG kvm vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
209: fi
210: if getent group disk > /dev/null 2>&1; then
211:     usermod -aG disk vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
212: fi
213: # Fix /dev/mapper/control permissions (for device mapper/DM)
214: chmod 0660 /dev/mapper/control 2>/dev/null || true
215: chown root:disk /dev/mapper/control 2>/dev/null || true
216: # Fix /dev/kvm permissions
217: chmod 0660 /dev/kvm 2>/dev/null || true
218: chown root:kvm /dev/kvm 2>/dev/null || true
219: # Create runtime directory - owned by root:vyoma, group writable (0775)
220: mkdir -p /run/vyoma
221: chown root:vyoma /run/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
222: chmod 0775 /run/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
223: # Setup CNI plugins directory (symlink from system data dir to package location)
224: mkdir -p /var/lib/vyoma/.vyoma/cni
225: rm -rf /var/lib/vyoma/.vyoma/cni/bin 2>/dev/null || true
226: ln -sf /usr/lib/vyoma/cni/bin /var/lib/vyoma/.vyoma/cni/bin
227: # Setup Vyoma network bridge (for VM networking)
228: if ! ip link show vyoma0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
229:     ip link add vyoma0 type bridge
230:     ip addr add 172.16.0.1/24 dev vyoma0
231:     ip link set vyoma0 up
232: fi
233: # Enable service (idempotent - won't fail if already enabled)
234: systemctl daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true
235: systemctl enable vyomad.service 2>/dev/null || true
236: # Only start on fresh install ($2 = previous version, empty if first install)
237: # On upgrade, use try-restart to restart only if already running
238: if [ -z "$2" ]; then
239:     # Fresh install - start the service
240:     systemctl start vyomad.service 2>/dev/null || true
241: else
242:     # Upgrade - restart only if already running (won't disrupt if stopped)
243:     systemctl try-restart vyomad.service 2>/dev/null || true
244: fi
245: echo "Vyoma v${VERSION} installed successfully!"
246: echo "Open http://localhost:8080 for the dashboard"
247: echo "Run 'vyoma run nginx:latest' to start your first VM"
248: POSTINST
249: chmod 755 "${WORK_DIR}/DEBIAN/postinst"
250: # 7. Create Post-Remove Script
251: cat <<'POSTRM' > "${WORK_DIR}/DEBIAN/postrm"
252: #!/bin/bash
253: set -e
254: systemctl daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true
255: if [ "$1" = "purge" ]; then
256:     userdel vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
257:     rm -rf /var/lib/vyoma /run/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
258:     ip link del vyoma0 2>/dev/null || true
259: fi
260: POSTRM
261: chmod 755 "${WORK_DIR}/DEBIAN/postrm"
262: # 8. Build Package
263: mkdir -p dist
264: dpkg-deb --build "${WORK_DIR}" "dist/${PKG_NAME}_${VERSION}_${ARCH}.deb"
265: # 9. Cleanup
266: rm -f cloud-hypervisor cloud-hypervisor.tgz virtiofsd.zip virtiofsd virtiofsd_bin cni-plugins.tgz
267: rm -rf release-v1.7.0-x86_64
268: rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"
269: echo "Package created at dist/${PKG_NAME}_${VERSION}_${ARCH}.deb"

  1: #!/bin/bash

  4: GREEN='\033[0;32m'

 50:          chmod +x $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/bin/cloud-hypervisor
 51:     fi
 52:     if [ -f "$(pwd)/kernel.bzimage" ]; then
 53:          cp "$(pwd)/kernel.bzimage" $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/bin/vmlinux

 58:     else
 59:          echo -e "kernel not found. Downloading..."
 60:          wget -q -O $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/bin/vmlinux https://github.com/cloud-hypervisor/linux/releases/download/ch-release-v6.16.9-20260508/bzImage-x86_64
 61:          chmod 644 $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/bin/vmlinux
 62:     fi
 63:     mkdir -p $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/cni/bin
 64:     if [ -d "$REAL_HOME/.vyoma/cni/bin" ] && [ "$(ls -A $REAL_HOME/.vyoma/cni/bin)" ]; then
 65:          echo "Copying CNI plugins from $REAL_HOME..."
 66:          cp $REAL_HOME/.vyoma/cni/bin/* $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/cni/bin/
 67:     fi
 68:     if [ -d "/usr/lib/cni" ]; then
 69:         cp /usr/lib/cni/* $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/cni/bin/
 70:     elif [ -d "/opt/cni/bin" ]; then
 71:         cp /opt/cni/bin/* $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/cni/bin/
 72:     else
 73:         echo -e "${RED}CNI Plugins not found. Downloading...${NC}"
 74:         curl -sL https://github.com/containernetworking/plugins/releases/download/v1.3.0/cni-plugins-linux-amd64-v1.3.0.tgz | tar -xz -C $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/cni/bin
 75:     fi
 76:     if [ -f "$(pwd)/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/vyoma-agent-vm" ]; then
 77:          cp "$(pwd)/target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/vyoma-agent-vm" $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/bin/vyoma-agent-vm
 78:     elif [ -f "$(pwd)/target/release/vyoma-agent-vm" ]; then
 79:          cp "$(pwd)/target/release/vyoma-agent-vm" $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/bin/vyoma-agent-vm
 80:     fi
 81:     chmod -R 777 $TEST_HOME
 82:     ls -la $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/bin/
 83:     sudo mkdir -p /run/vyoma
 84:     sudo chown root:vyoma /run/vyoma
 85:     sudo chmod 0775 /run/vyoma
 86:     # Setup /dev/mapper/control
 87:     sudo modprobe dm_mod || true
 88:     # Run a dummy dmsetup command to ensure /dev/mapper/control is created by udev
 89:     sudo dmsetup version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 90:     if [ -e "/dev/mapper/control" ]; then
 91:         sudo chown root:disk /dev/mapper/control || true
 92:         sudo chmod 0660 /dev/mapper/control || true
 93:     else
 94:         # If it somehow doesn't exist, try to create it manually
 95:         sudo mknod /dev/mapper/control c 10 236 || true
 96:         sudo chown root:disk /dev/mapper/control || true
 97:         sudo chmod 0660 /dev/mapper/control || true
 98:     fi
 99:     # Setup cgroup for vyoma user
100:     if [ -d "/sys/fs/cgroup" ]; then
101:         sudo mkdir -p /sys/fs/cgroup/vyoma.slice
102:         sudo chown -R vyoma:vyoma /sys/fs/cgroup/vyoma.slice
103:         # Enable controllers if available
104:         local avail=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers 2>/dev/null || echo "")
105:         local to_enable=""
106:         [[ "$avail" == *"cpu"* ]] && to_enable="+cpu "
107:         [[ "$avail" == *"memory"* ]] && to_enable="+memory "
108:         [[ "$avail" == *"io"* ]] && to_enable="+io "
109:         if [ -n "$to_enable" ]; then
110:             sudo sh -c "echo '$to_enable' > /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control" || true
111:         fi
112:     fi
113: }
114: cleanup_resources() {
115:     echo -e "${YELLOW}Cleaning up test resources...${NC}"
116:     for vm_id in "${RUNNING_VMS[@]}"; do
117:         if [ -n "$vm_id" ]; then
118:             echo "Stopping VM: $vm_id"
119:             $VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock stop "$vm_id" 2>/dev/null || true
120:         fi
121:     done
122:     pkill -f "vyomad.*test.sock" 2>/dev/null || true
123:     sleep 1
124:     sudo dmsetup remove_all 2>/dev/null || true
125:     losetup -D 2>/dev/null || true
126:     rm -rf $TEST_HOME 2>/dev/null || true
127:     rm -rf /tmp/vyoma-tests-* 2>/dev/null || true
128: }
129: cleanup_env() {
130:     set +e
131:     local pid=$1
132:     echo "Dumping serial logs from $TEST_HOME in cleanup_env:"
133:     for log in $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/vms/*/serial.log; do
134:         if [ -f "$log" ]; then
135:             echo "--- $log ---"
136:             cat "$log"
137:         fi
138:     done
139:     echo "Dumping daemon.log:"
140:     if [ -f "$TEST_HOME/daemon.log" ]; then
141:         cat "$TEST_HOME/daemon.log"
142:     fi
143:     if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
144:         kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true
145:         wait $pid 2>/dev/null || true
146:     fi
147:     # Setup /dev/mapper/control
148:     sudo modprobe dm_mod || true
149:     # Run a dummy dmsetup command to ensure /dev/mapper/control is created by udev
150:     sudo dmsetup version >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
151:     if [ -e "/dev/mapper/control" ]; then
152:         sudo chown root:disk /dev/mapper/control || true
153:         sudo chmod 0660 /dev/mapper/control || true
154:     else
155:         # If it somehow doesn't exist, try to create it manually
156:         sudo mknod /dev/mapper/control c 10 236 || true
157:         sudo chown root:disk /dev/mapper/control || true
158:         sudo chmod 0660 /dev/mapper/control || true
159:     fi
160:     pkill -P $$ vyomad 2>/dev/null || true
161:     sudo dmsetup remove_all 2>/dev/null || true
162:     losetup -D 2>/dev/null || true
163:     # rm -rf $TEST_HOME 2>/dev/null || true
164: }
165: # trap cleanup_resources EXIT
166: handle_error() {
167:     echo -e "${RED}Test Error - Cleaning up...${NC}"
168:     echo "Dumping serial logs from $TEST_HOME:"
169:     for f in $TEST_HOME/.vyoma/vms/*/serial.log; do
170:         if [ -f "$f" ]; then
171:             echo "--- $f ---"
172:             cat "$f"
173:         fi
174:     done
175:     pkill vyomad 2>/dev/null || true
176:     # rm -rf /tmp/vyoma-tests-* 2>/dev/null || true
177: }
178: assert_success() {
179:     if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
180:         echo -e "${RED}Test Failed: $1${NC}"
181:         exit 1
182:     else
183:         echo -e "${GREEN}Pass: $1${NC}"
184:     fi
185: }
186: wait_for_vm_state() {
187:     local vm_id=$1
188:     local expected_state=$2
189:     local timeout=${3:-30}
190:     local interval=1
191:     local elapsed=0
192:     while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do
193:         # Extract status using curl on the daemon socket
194:         local current_state=$(sudo curl -s --unix-socket /run/vyoma/test.sock http://localhost/ps | grep -o "\"id\":\"$vm_id\"[^\}]*" | grep -o "\"status\":\"[^\"]*\"" | cut -d'"' -f4)
195:         if [ "$current_state" == "$expected_state" ]; then
196:             echo "VM $vm_id reached state: $expected_state"
197:             return 0
198:         fi
199:         sleep $interval
200:         elapsed=$((elapsed + interval))
201:     done
202:     echo -e "${RED}Timeout: VM $vm_id did not reach state $expected_state within ${timeout}s${NC}"
203:     return 1
204: }
205: wait_for_port() {
206:     local port=$1
207:     local timeout=${2:-30}
208:     local interval=1
209:     local elapsed=0
210:     while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do
211:         if ss -tln 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":$port " || ss -tln 2>/dev/null | grep -q "0.0.0.0:$port"; then
212:             echo "Port $port is now listening"
213:             return 0
214:         fi
215:         if curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:$port" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "200\|301\|302"; then
216:             echo "Port $port is responding"
217:             return 0
218:         fi
219:         sleep $interval
220:         elapsed=$((elapsed + interval))
221:     done
222:     echo -e "${RED}Timeout: Port $port not available within ${timeout}s${NC}"
223:     return 1
224: }
225: vyoma_run_and_get_id() {
226:     local extra_args="$@"
227:     local output=$($VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock run $extra_args 2>&1)
228:     local vm_id=$(echo "$output" | grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}' | tail -1 | tr -d '[:space:]')
229:     if [ -z "$vm_id" ]; then
230:         echo "vyoma run failed! Output: $output" >&2
231:         vm_id=$($VYOMA_BIN --socket-path /run/vyoma/test.sock ps 2>/dev/null | grep -E "$extra_args" | head -1 | awk '{print $1}')
232:     fi
233:     echo "$vm_id"
234: }
235: register_vm() {
236:     RUNNING_VMS+=("$1")
237: }
238: unregister_vm() {
239:     local vm_id=$1
240:     local new_array=()
241:     for v in "${RUNNING_VMS[@]}"; do
242:         [ "$v" != "$vm_id" ] && new_array+=("$v")
243:     done
244:     RUNNING_VMS=("${new_array[@]}")
245: }
246: wait_for_vm_state_from_cli() {
247:     local vyoma_cmd="$1"
248:     local vm_id=$2
249:     local expected_state=$3
250:     local timeout=${4:-30}
251:     local interval=1
252:     local elapsed=0
253:     while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do
254:         local current_state=$($vyoma_cmd ps 2>/dev/null | grep "$vm_id" | awk '{print $NF}' | tr -d '[]')
255:         if [ "$current_state" = "$expected_state" ]; then
256:             echo "VM $vm_id reached state: $expected_state"
257:             return 0
258:         fi
259:         sleep $interval
260:         elapsed=$((elapsed + interval))
261:     done
262:     echo -e "${RED}Timeout: VM $vm_id did not reach state $expected_state within ${timeout}s${NC}"
263:     return 1
264: }
