File: packaging/rpm/build.sh
================
  1: #!/bin/bash
  2: set -e
  3: # Locate cargo (works with rustup and system installs)
  4: if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  5:     CARGO=$(command -v cargo)
  6: elif [ -f "$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo" ]; then
  7:     CARGO="$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo"
  8: else
  9:     echo "Error: cargo not found. Install Rust from https://rustup.rs"
 10:     exit 1
 11: fi
 12: VERSION="2.9.0"
 13: WORK_DIR="target/rpm"
 14: SOURCES_DIR="${WORK_DIR}/SOURCES/vyoma-${VERSION}"
 15: # Hardcoded checksums for binary verification
 16: # Computed from official release sources
 17: CLOUD_HYPERVISOR_CHECKSUM="8a013003ae29f59da7b2d7ac67f19eea3ea535166dac00ff5e8c2c27ac643f8a"
 18: CNI_PLUGINS_CHECKSUM="77baa2f669980a82255ffa2f2717de823992480271ee778aa51a9c60ae89ff9b"
 19: # Verify checksum of a downloaded file
 20: # Usage: verify_checksum <file> <expected_sha256>
 21: verify_checksum() {
 22:     local file="$1"
 23:     local expected="$2"
 24:     if [ "$VYOMA_SKIP_CHECKSUM" = "1" ]; then
 25:         echo "Skipping checksum verification (VYOMA_SKIP_CHECKSUM=1)"
 26:         return 0
 27:     fi
 28:     if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
 29:         echo "Error: file $file not found for checksum verification"
 30:         return 1
 31:     fi
 32:     local actual
 33:     actual=$(sha256sum "$file" | awk '{print $1}')
 34:     if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then
 35:         echo "CHECKSUM MISMATCH for $file"
 36:         echo "Expected: $expected"
 37:         echo "Actual:   $actual"
 38:         return 1
 39:     fi
 40:     echo "Checksum OK: $file"
 41:     return 0
 42: }
 43: # Clean up any previous build
 44: rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"
 45: mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}"/{BUILD,RPMS,SOURCES,SPECS,SRPMS}
 46: mkdir -p "${SOURCES_DIR}"
 47: # 1. Build Binaries
 48: "$CARGO" build --release --bin vyomad --bin vyoma
 49: rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
 50: "$CARGO" build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl --bin vyoma-agent-vm
 51: # 2. Copy binaries to source dir
 52: cp target/release/vyomad "${SOURCES_DIR}/"
 53: cp target/release/vyoma "${SOURCES_DIR}/"
 54: cp target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/vyoma-agent-vm "${SOURCES_DIR}/vyoma-agent-vm"
 55: # 3. Fetch Dependencies with checksum verification
 56: echo "Fetching dependencies..."
 57: # Fetch Cloud Hypervisor with checksum verification
 58: if [ ! -f "cloud-hypervisor" ]; then
 59:     echo "Downloading cloud-hypervisor v41.0..."
 60:     wget -q -O cloud-hypervisor https://github.com/cloud-hypervisor/cloud-hypervisor/releases/download/v41.0/cloud-hypervisor
 61:     chmod +x cloud-hypervisor
 62: fi
 63: echo "Verifying cloud-hypervisor checksum..."
 64: if ! verify_checksum "cloud-hypervisor" "$CLOUD_HYPERVISOR_CHECKSUM"; then
 65:     echo "ERROR: cloud-hypervisor checksum verification failed!"
 66:     rm -f cloud-hypervisor
 67:     exit 1
 68: fi
 69: cp cloud-hypervisor "${SOURCES_DIR}/"
 70: cp packaging/systemd/vyomad.service "${SOURCES_DIR}/"
 71: cp packaging/systemd/vyoma-net.service "${SOURCES_DIR}/"
 72: # Fetch CNI plugins with checksum verification
 73: CNI_VERSION="v1.5.1"
 74: CNI_DIR="${SOURCES_DIR}/cni/bin"
 75: echo "Fetching CNI plugins..."
 76: mkdir -p "${CNI_DIR}"
 77: if [ ! -f "cni-plugins.tgz" ]; then
 78:     echo "Downloading CNI plugins ${CNI_VERSION}..."
 79:     wget -q -O cni-plugins.tgz "https://github.com/containernetworking/plugins/releases/download/${CNI_VERSION}/cni-plugins-linux-amd64-${CNI_VERSION}.tgz"
 80: fi
 81: echo "Verifying CNI plugins checksum..."
 82: if ! verify_checksum "cni-plugins.tgz" "$CNI_PLUGINS_CHECKSUM"; then
 83:     echo "ERROR: CNI plugins checksum verification failed!"
 84:     rm -f cni-plugins.tgz
 85:     exit 1
 86: fi
 87: tar -xzf cni-plugins.tgz -C "${CNI_DIR}/"
 88: # Copy UI (built by workflow step or locally)
 89: echo "Bundling UI..."
 90: UI_AVAILABLE=false
 91: if [ -d "ui/dist" ]; then
 92:     mkdir -p "${SOURCES_DIR}/ui/dist"
 93:     cp -r ui/dist/* "${SOURCES_DIR}/ui/dist/"
 94:     echo "UI bundled successfully"
 95:     UI_AVAILABLE=true
 96: else
 97:     echo "Warning: UI not found - dashboard will not be available"
 98: fi
 99: # Copy kernel binary
100: mkdir -p "${SOURCES_DIR}"
101: KERNEL_URL="https://github.com/cloud-hypervisor/linux/releases/download/ch-release-v6.16.9-20260508/bzImage-x86_64"
102: if [ ! -f "kernel.bzimage" ]; then
103:     if [ -f "/tmp/vyoma-bzImage" ]; then
104:         echo "Using locally compiled custom kernel from /tmp/vyoma-bzImage..."
105:         cp /tmp/vyoma-bzImage kernel.bzimage
106:     else
107:         echo "Downloading custom Vyoma kernel..."
108:         wget -q -O kernel.bzimage "$KERNEL_URL" || curl -L -o kernel.bzimage "$KERNEL_URL"
109:     fi
110: fi
111: mkdir -p "${SOURCES_DIR}/bin"
112: cp kernel.bzimage "${SOURCES_DIR}/bin/vmlinux"
113: chmod 644 "${SOURCES_DIR}/bin/vmlinux"
114: echo "Kernel binary bundled"
115: # Bundle virtiofsd
116: VIRTIOFSD_VERSION="1.11.1"
117: echo "Fetching virtiofsd..."
118: if [ ! -f "virtiofsd_bin" ]; then
119:     PRIMARY_URL="https://gitlab.com/virtio-fs/virtiofsd/-/releases/${VIRTIOFSD_VERSION}/downloads/virtiofsd-v${VIRTIOFSD_VERSION}-x86_64-musl.zip"
120:     if wget -q -O virtiofsd.zip "$PRIMARY_URL" 2>/dev/null; then
121:         unzip -q -o virtiofsd.zip
122:         mv virtiofsd virtiofsd_bin 2>/dev/null || true
123:         chmod +x virtiofsd_bin 2>/dev/null || true
124:     fi
125: fi
126: if [ ! -f "virtiofsd_bin" ]; then
127:     FALLBACK_URL1="https://github.com/qemu/qemu/raw/main/contrib/virtiofsd/virtiofsd-x86_64"
128:     if wget -q -O virtiofsd "$FALLBACK_URL1" 2>/dev/null; then
129:         mv virtiofsd virtiofsd_bin
130:         chmod +x virtiofsd_bin
131:     fi
132: fi
133: if [ ! -f "virtiofsd_bin" ]; then
134:     FALLBACK_URL2="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qemu/qemu/master/contrib/virtiofsd/virtiofsd-x86_64"
135:     if wget -q -O virtiofsd "$FALLBACK_URL2" 2>/dev/null; then
136:         mv virtiofsd virtiofsd_bin
137:         chmod +x virtiofsd_bin
138:     fi
139: fi
140: if [ -f "virtiofsd_bin" ]; then
141:     cp virtiofsd_bin "${SOURCES_DIR}/virtiofsd"
142:     chmod +x "${SOURCES_DIR}/virtiofsd"
143:     echo "virtiofsd fetched successfully"
144: elif [ -f "bin/virtiofsd" ] && [ ! -L "bin/virtiofsd" ]; then
145:     cp bin/virtiofsd "${SOURCES_DIR}/virtiofsd"
146:     chmod +x "${SOURCES_DIR}/virtiofsd"
147:     echo "virtiofsd bundled from project bin"
148: elif [ -f "/usr/libexec/virtiofsd" ]; then
149:     cp /usr/libexec/virtiofsd "${SOURCES_DIR}/virtiofsd"
150:     chmod +x "${SOURCES_DIR}/virtiofsd"
151:     echo "virtiofsd bundled from system"
152: elif [ -f "/usr/bin/virtiofsd" ]; then
153:     cp /usr/bin/virtiofsd "${SOURCES_DIR}/virtiofsd"
154:     chmod +x "${SOURCES_DIR}/virtiofsd"
155:     echo "virtiofsd bundled from /usr/bin"
156: else
157:     echo "Warning: virtiofsd not found - volume mounts may not work"
158: fi
159: # 4. Create Source Tarball
160: cd "${WORK_DIR}/SOURCES"
161: tar -czf "vyoma-${VERSION}.tar.gz" "vyoma-${VERSION}"
162: cd ../../..
163: # 5. Create SPEC File
164: SPEC_CONTENT="Name:       vyoma
165: Version:    ${VERSION}
166: Release:    1%{?dist}
167: Summary:    MicroVM Ecosystem
168: License:    MIT
169: URL:        https://github.com/Subeshrock/micro-vm-ecosystem
170: Source0:    vyoma-${VERSION}.tar.gz
171: Requires:   iptables
172: Requires:   kmod
173: %description
174: Vyoma is a lightweight MicroVM runtime for running containers
175: as lightweight virtual machines. Combines Cloud Hypervisor speed with Docker UX.
176: Includes CLI, Daemon, Web UI, CNI plugins, and virtiofsd for volume mounts.
177: %prep
178: %setup -q
179: %install
180: mkdir -p %{buildroot}/usr/bin
181: mkdir -p %{buildroot}/usr/lib/vyoma
182: mkdir -p %{buildroot}/etc/systemd/system
183: install -m 755 vyomad %{buildroot}/usr/bin/vyomad
184: install -m 755 vyoma %{buildroot}/usr/bin/vyoma
185: install -m 755 vyoma-agent-vm %{buildroot}/usr/bin/vyoma-agent-vm
186: install -m 755 cloud-hypervisor %{buildroot}/usr/bin/cloud-hypervisor
187: install -m 644 vyomad.service %{buildroot}/etc/systemd/system/vyomad.service
188: install -m 644 vyoma-net.service %{buildroot}/etc/systemd/system/vyoma-net.service
189: # Install CNI plugins
190: cp -r cni %{buildroot}/usr/lib/vyoma/cni
191: # Install kernel binary
192: mkdir -p %{buildroot}/var/lib/vyoma/bin
193: install -m 644 bin/vmlinux %{buildroot}/var/lib/vyoma/bin/vmlinux
194: install -m 755 cloud-hypervisor %{buildroot}/var/lib/vyoma/bin/cloud-hypervisor"
195: if [ "$UI_AVAILABLE" = true ]; then
196:     SPEC_CONTENT="$SPEC_CONTENT
197: # Install UI
198: cp -r ui %{buildroot}/usr/lib/vyoma/ui"
199: fi
200: if [ -f "${SOURCES_DIR}/virtiofsd" ]; then
201:     SPEC_CONTENT="$SPEC_CONTENT
202: install -m 755 virtiofsd %{buildroot}/usr/lib/vyoma/virtiofsd"
203: fi
204: SPEC_CONTENT="$SPEC_CONTENT
205: %files
206: /usr/bin/vyomad
207: /usr/bin/vyoma
208: /usr/bin/vyoma-agent-vm
209: /usr/bin/cloud-hypervisor
210: /etc/systemd/system/vyomad.service
211: /etc/systemd/system/vyoma-net.service
212: /usr/lib/vyoma/cni
213: /var/lib/vyoma/bin/vmlinux
214: /var/lib/vyoma/bin/cloud-hypervisor"
215: if [ "$UI_AVAILABLE" = true ]; then
216:     SPEC_CONTENT="$SPEC_CONTENT
217: /usr/lib/vyoma/ui"
218: fi
219: if [ -f "${SOURCES_DIR}/virtiofsd" ]; then
220:     SPEC_CONTENT="$SPEC_CONTENT
221: /usr/lib/vyoma/virtiofsd"
222: fi
223: SPEC_CONTENT="$SPEC_CONTENT
224: %preun
225: # Stop service before package removal (not on upgrade)
226: # \$1 = 0 means removal, \$1 = 1 means upgrade
227: if [ \$1 -eq 0 ]; then
228:     systemctl stop vyomad.service 2>/dev/null || true
229:     systemctl disable vyomad.service 2>/dev/null || true
230: fi
231: %post
232: # $1 = 1: fresh install, $1 = 2: upgrade
233: if ! getent passwd vyoma > /dev/null 2>&1; then
234:     useradd -r -s /sbin/nologin -c 'Vyoma daemon' -d /var/lib/vyoma vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
235: fi
236: # Add vyoma daemon user to kvm and disk groups (for /dev/kvm and /dev/mapper/control access)
237: if getent group kvm > /dev/null 2>&1; then
238:     usermod -aG kvm vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
239: fi
240: if getent group disk > /dev/null 2>&1; then
241:     usermod -aG disk vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
242: fi
243: # Add installing user to vyoma, kvm, disk groups
244: if [ -n "$SUDO_USER" ]; then
245:     usermod -aG vyoma "$SUDO_USER" 2>/dev/null || true
246:     usermod -aG kvm "$SUDO_USER" 2>/dev/null || true
247:     usermod -aG disk "$SUDO_USER" 2>/dev/null || true
248:     printf 'Added %s to vyoma, kvm, disk groups. Log out and back in to use CLI.\n' "$SUDO_USER"
249: fi
250: # Fix /dev/kvm permissions
251: chmod 0660 /dev/kvm 2>/dev/null || true
252: chown root:kvm /dev/kvm 2>/dev/null || true
253: # Fix /dev/mapper/control permissions (for device mapper/DM)
254: chmod 0660 /dev/mapper/control 2>/dev/null || true
255: chown root:disk /dev/mapper/control 2>/dev/null || true
256: # Create runtime directory - owned by root:vyoma, group writable (0775)
257: mkdir -p /run/vyoma
258: chown root:vyoma /run/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
259: chmod 0775 /run/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
260: # Setup CNI plugins directory (symlink from system data dir to package location)
261: mkdir -p /var/lib/vyoma/.vyoma/cni 2>/dev/null || true
262: rm -rf /var/lib/vyoma/.vyoma/cni/bin 2>/dev/null || true
263: ln -sf /usr/lib/vyoma/cni/bin /var/lib/vyoma/.vyoma/cni/bin 2>/dev/null || true
264: # Setup Vyoma network bridge (for VM networking)
265: if ! ip link show vyoma0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
266:     ip link add vyoma0 type bridge
267:     ip addr add 172.16.0.1/24 dev vyoma0
268:     ip link set vyoma0 up
269: fi
270: # Reload systemd and enable service (idempotent)
271: systemctl daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true
272: systemctl enable vyomad.service 2>/dev/null || true
273: # Only start on fresh install (\$1 = 1); on upgrade (\$1 = 2), try-restart if running
274: if [ \$1 -eq 1 ]; then
275:     systemctl start vyomad.service 2>/dev/null || true
276: else
277:     systemctl try-restart vyomad.service 2>/dev/null || true
278: fi
279: %postun
280: # \$1 = 0: package removal, \$1 = 1: upgrade
281: if [ \$1 -eq 0 ]; then
282:     # Package removal - cleanup (not on upgrade)
283:     userdel vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
284:     rm -rf /var/lib/vyoma /run/vyoma 2>/dev/null || true
285:     ip link del vyoma0 2>/dev/null || true
286:     systemctl daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true
287: fi
288: %changelog
289: * Wed Apr 01 2026 Subeshrock <subesh.rock.3@gmail.com> - ${VERSION}-1
290: - Run daemon as root with capabilities (no sudo needed)
291: - Remove sudoers configuration
292: - Fix socket and KVM permissions
293: - Bundle CNI plugins for networking
294: - Bundle UI in package
295: - Fix /run/vyoma directory permissions (0775)
296: "
297: echo "$SPEC_CONTENT" > "${WORK_DIR}/SPECS/vyoma.spec"
298: # 6. Build RPM
299: rpmbuild --define "_topdir $(pwd)/${WORK_DIR}" -bb "${WORK_DIR}/SPECS/vyoma.spec"
300: # 7. Move to dist
301: mkdir -p dist
302: mv ${WORK_DIR}/RPMS/x86_64/*.rpm dist/
303: # 8. Cleanup
304: rm -f cloud-hypervisor cloud-hypervisor.tgz virtiofsd.zip virtiofsd virtiofsd_bin cni-plugins.tgz
305: rm -rf release-v1.7.0-x86_64
306: rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"
307: echo "RPM created in dist/"
